Bava Metzia 75b:5-13: Gemara tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, veeno ragil lehakedim lo shalom, sheasur lehakedim lo shalom – talmud lomar: "neshech kol davar asher yishshach" – afillu dibbur asur.

Veellu ovrin, amar abbaye: malve over bechullan. love over mishshum "lo tashshich leachicha". "uleachicha lo tashshich", "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". arev vehaedim en ovrin ella mishshum "lo tesimun alav neshech".

Tanya, rabbi shimon omer: malve ribbit yoter mimma shemmarvichim – mafsidim. velo od ella shemmesimim moshe rabbenu chacham vetorato emet. veomrin: illu haya yodea moshe rabbenu sheyyihye revach baddavar lo haya kotvo.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, veyodea sheen lo, sheasur laavor lefanav – talmud lomar: "lo tihye lo kenoshe".
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayyhu keillu dano bishne dinin, shenneemar: "hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim – over mishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". veresh lakish amar: gorem kelala leatzmo, shenneemar: "tealamna sifte shaker haddovrot al tzaddik atak".

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe: ka mekayyem ravina kol ma daamur rabbanan. shelach leh bahade panya demaale shabbeta: lishaddar li mar asra zuze deitremi li kattina deara lemizban. shelach leh: nayte mar sahade venichtov ketava. shelach leh: afillu ana name? shelach leh: kol shekken mar ditrid begirseh mishtele vegorem kelala leatzmo.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha tzoakin veenan naanin, veellu hen: mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim, vehakkone adon leatzmo, umi sheishto moshelet alav.
Kona adon leatzmo may hi? ikka deamri: tole nechasav begoy. ikka deamri: hakkotev nechasav levanav bechayyav. ikka deamri: devish leh beha mata vela azel lemata achariti.
Berakhot 7b:28-8a:7: Amar leh may kulle hay? amar leh deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay:
May dichtiv "vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon". ematay et ratzon — beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin.
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "ko amar Adonai beet ratzon aniticha".
Rabbi acha berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "hen el kabbir velo yimas": uchetiv: "pada veshalom nafshi mikkerav li ki verabbim hayu immadi".

Tanya name hachi, rabbi natan omer: minnayin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu moes bitfillatan shel rabbim shenneemar: "hen el kabbir velo yimas", uchetiv: "pada veshalom nafshi mikkerav li" vegomer, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim umitpallel im hatztzibbur — maale ani alav keillu pedaani, li ulevanay, mibben ummot haolam.

Amar resh lakish: kol mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro, veeno nichnas sham lehitpallel, nikra "shachen ra", shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai al kol shechenay haraim hannogim bannachala asher hinchalti et ammi et yisrael". velo od ella sheggorem galut lo ulevanav, shenneemar: "hinni notsham meal admatam veet bet yehuda ettosh mittocham".

Amaru leh lerabbi yochanan: ikka save bevavel. tema vaamar: "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem al haadama" ketiv, aval bechutza laaretz — la? kevan deamri leh mekaddemi umechashshechi leve chenishta, amar: hayeynu deahani lehu.

Deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi livneh: kaddimu vechashshichu veayyilu leve chenishta, ki hechi detorchu chayye. amar rabbi acha berabbi chanina: may kera — "ashre adam shomea li lishkod al daltotay yom yom lishmor mezuzot petachay", uchetiv batreh: "ki motzi matza chayyim".
Judges 3:30-4:4: Vattikkana moav bayyom hahu tachat yad yisrael vattishkot haaretz shemonim shana {p}
Veacharav haya shamgar ben-anat vayyach et-pelishtim shesh-meot ish bemalmad habbakar vayyosha gam-hu et-yisrael {p}
Vayyosifu bene yisrael laasot hara beene Adonai veehud met
Vayyimkerem Adonai beyad yavin melech-kenaan asher malach bechatzor vesar-tzevao sisra vehu yoshev bacharoshet haggoyim
Vayyitzaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai ki tesha meot rechev-barzel lo vehu lachatz et-bene yisrael bechozka esrim shana {p}
Udevora ishsha nevia eshet lappidot hi shofta et-yisrael baet hahi
Judges 4:14-19: Vattomer devora el-barak kum ki ze hayyom asher natan Adonai et-sisra beyadecha halo Adonai yatza lefanecha vayyered barak mehar tavor vaaseret alafim ish acharav
Vayyahom Adonai et-sisra veet-kol-harechev veet-kol-hammachane lefi-cherev lifne varak vayyered sisra meal hammerkava vayyanos beraglav
Uvarak radaf achare harechev veachare hammachane ad charoshet haggoyim vayyippol kol-machane sisra lefi-cherev lo nishar ad-echad
Vesisra nas beraglav el-ohel yael eshet chever hakkeni ki shalom ben yavin melech-chatzor uven bet chever hakkeni
Vattetze yael likrat sisra vattomer elav sura adoni sura elay al-tira vayyasar eleha haohela vattechassehu bassemicha
Vayyomer eleha hashekini-na meat-mayim ki tzameti vattiftach et-novd hechalav vattashkehu vattechassehu
Judges 4:20-24: Vayyomer eleha amod petach haohel vehaya im-ish yavo usheelech veamar hayesh-po ish veamart ayin
Vattikkach yael eshet-chever et-yetad haohel vattasem et-hammakkevet beyadah vattavo elav ballat vattitka et-hayyated berakkato vattitznach baaretz vehu-nirdam vayyaaf vayyamot
Vehinne varak rodef et-sisra vattetze yael likrato vattomer lo lech vearekka et-haish asher-atta mevakkesh vayyavo eleha vehinne sisra nofel met vehayyated berakkato
Vayyachna elohim bayyom hahu et yavin melech-kenaan lifne bene yisrael
Vattelech yad bene-yisrael haloch vekasha al yavin melech-kenaan ad asher hichritu et yavin melech-kenaan {p}
Judges 4:5-8: Vehi yoshevet tachat-tomer devora ben harama uven bet-el behar efrayim vayyaalu eleha bene yisrael lammishpat

Vattishlach vattikra levarak ben-avinoam mikkedesh naftali vattomer elav halo tzivva ׀ Adonai elohe-yisrael lech umashachta behar tavor velakachta immecha aseret alafim ish mibbene naftali umibbene zevulun
Umashachti elecha el-nachal kishon et-sisra sar-tzeva yavin veet-richbo veet-hamono unetattihu beyadecha
Vayyomer eleha barak im-telchi immi vehalachti veim-lo telchi immi lo elech
Judges 4:9-13: Vattomer haloch elech immach efes ki lo tihye tifartecha al-hadderech asher atta holech ki veyad-ishsha yimkor Adonai et-sisra vattakom devora vattelech im-barak kedsha
Vayyazek barak et-zevulun veet-naftali kedsha vayyaal beraglav aseret alfe ish vattaal immo devora
Vechever hakkeni nifrad mikkayin mibbene chovav choten moshe vayyet oholo ad-elon (batzeaneym) [betzaanannim] asher et-kedesh
Vayyaggidu lesisra ki ala barak ben-avinoam har-tavor
Vayyazek sisra et-kol-richbo tesha meot rechev barzel veet-kol-haam asher itto mecharoshet haggoyim el-nachal kishon
Menachot 29a:8-15: Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "al hammenora hattehora", sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora. ella meatta, "al hashshulchan hattahor" sheyyardu maasav mimmakom tahor? ella tahor – mikkelal shehu tame, hacha name tehora – mikkelal shehi temea.

Bishlama hatam, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "al hashshulchan hattahor", mikkelal shehu tame? keli etz heasuy lenachat hu, vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tumea! ella melammed shemmagbihin oto leole regalim, umarim lahem lechem happanim, veomer lahem: reu chibbatchem lifne hammakom.
May chibbatchem? kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nes gadol naasa belechem happanim, silluko kesidduro, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".
Ella hacha, "tehora" mikkelal shehi temea? peshita, kele mattachot ninhu, uchele mattachot mekabbelin tumea! ella, sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora.
Tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: aron shel esh veshulchan shel esh umenora shel esh yardu min hashshamayim, veraa moshe veasa kemotam, shenneemar: "uree vaase ketavnitam asher atta more bahar".
Ella meatta, "vahakemota et hammishkan kemishpato asher horeta bahar", hachi name? hacha ketiv "kemishpato", hatam ketiv "ketavnitam".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: gavriel chagur kemin pesikya haya, vehera lo lemoshe maase menora, dichtiv: "veze maase hammenora".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: shelosha devarim hayu kashin lo lemoshe, ad shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu beetzbao, veellu hen: menora, verosh chodesh, usheratzim. menora – dichtiv: "veze maase hammenora", rosh chodesh – dichtiv: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim", sheratzim – dichtiv: "veze lachem hattame". veyesh omrim: af hilchot shechita, shenneemar: "veze asher taase al hammizbeach".
Mishnah Gittin 1:1-2:
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. rabban gamliel omer, af hammevi min harekem umin hacheger. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu mikkefar ludim lelod. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, ella hammevi mimmedinat hayyam vehammolich. vehammevi mimmedina limdina vimdinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, afillu mehegmonya lehegmonya: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, merekem lammizrach, verekem kammizrach. meashkelon laddarom, veashkelon kaddarom. meakko latztzafon, veakko katztzafon. rabbi meir omer, akko keeretz yisrael laggittin:
Mishnah Gittin 1:3-6:
Hammevi get beeretz yisrael, eno tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. im yesh alav orrim, yitkayyem bechotmav. hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, im yesh alav edim, yitkayyem bechotmav: 
Echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim, shavu lammolich velammevi. vezo achad min hadderachim sheshshavu gitte nashim leshichrure avadim: 
Kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti, pasul, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. maase, sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha vehayu edav ede chutim, vehichshir. kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel goyim, af al pi shechotmehem goyim, kesherim, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. rabbi shimon omer, af ellu chesherin, lo huzkeru ella vizman shennaasu vehedyot: 
Haomer, ten get ze leishti ushetar shichrur ze leavdi, im ratza lachazor bishnehen, yachazor, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, begitte nashim, aval lo veshichrure avadim, lefi shezzachin laadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav. sheim yirtze shello lazun et avdo, rashshay. veshello lazun et ishto, eno rashshay. amar lahem, vahare hu fosel et avdo min hatteruma keshem shehu fosel et ishto. amru lo, mippene shehu kinyano. haomer, tenu get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi, umet, lo yittenu leachar mita. tenu mane leish peloni, umet, yittenu leachar mita:
Mishnah Gittin 2:1-4:
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veamar, befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam, befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav, befanay nichtav kullo uvefanay nechtam chetzyo, befanay nichtav chetzyo uvefanay nechtam kullo, pasul. echad omer befanay nichtav, veechad omer befanay nechtam, pasul. shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav, veechad omer befanay nechtam, pasul. verabbi yehuda machshir. echad omer befanay nichtav, ushenayim omrim befanenu nechtam, kasher: 
Nichtav bayyom venechtam bayyom, ballayla venechtam ballayla, ballayla venechtam bayyom, kasher. bayyom venechtam ballayla, pasul. rabbi shimon machshir, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol haggittin shennichtevu vayyom venechtemu vallayla, pesulin, chutz miggitte nashim: 
Bakkol kotvin, bidyo, besam, besikra, uvekomos, uvekankantom, uvechol davar shehu shel keyama. en kotvin lo vemashkim, velo veme ferot, velo vechol davar sheeno mitkayyem. al hakkol kotvin, al heale shel zayit, veal hakkeren shel para, venoten lah et happara, al yad shel eved, venoten lah et haaved. rabbi yose haggelili omer, en kotvin lo al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, velo al hoochalin: 
En kotvin bimchubbar lakkarka. ketavo vimchubbar, telasho vachatamo unetano lah, kasher. rabbi yehuda fosel, ad shettehe chetivato vachatimato betalush. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, en kotvin lo al hanneyar hammachuk velo al haddiftera, mippene shehu yachol lehizdayyef. vachachamim machshirin:
Mishnah Gittin 2:5-3:2:
Hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget, afillu cheresh, shote vekatan. haishsha chotevet et gittah, vehaish kotev et shovro, sheen kiyyum hagget ella vechotmav. hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan vesuma venachri: 
Kibbel hakkatan vehigdil, cheresh venitpakkeach, suma venitpatteach, shote venishtappa, nachri venitgayyer, pasul. aval pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach, patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach, shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa, kasher. ze hakkelal, kol shettechillato vesofo vedaat, kasher: 
Af hannashim sheenan neemanot lomar met balah, neemanot lehavi et gittah, chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah. ma ben get lemita, shehakketav mochiach. haishsha atzmah mevia et gittah, uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam: 
Kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha, pasul. ketzad. haya over bashshuk veshama kol sofrim makrin, ish peloni megaresh et pelonit mimmakom peloni, veamar, ze shemi veze shem ishti, pasul legaresh bo. yater mikken, katav legaresh bo et ishto venimlach, metzao ven iro veamar lo, shemi chishmecha veshem ishti cheshem ishtecha, pasul legaresh bo. yater mikken, hayu lo shete nashim ushemotehen shavot, katav legaresh bo et haggedola, lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna. yater mikken, amar lallavlar, ketov leezo sheertze agaresh, pasul legaresh bo: 
Hakkotev tafse gittin, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom hazzeman. shetare milve, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hammalve, mekom hallove, mekom hammaot umekom hazzeman. shetare mikkach, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hallokeach umekom hammocher umekom hammaot umekom hassade umekom hazzeman, mippene hattakkana. rabbi yehuda fosel bechullan. rabbi elazar machshir bechullan, chutz miggitte nashim, shenneemar (Devarim kad) vechatav lah, lishmah:
Mishnah Gittin 3:3-6:
Hammevi get veavad hemennu, metzao lealtar, kasher. veim lav, pasul. metzao vachafisa o vidluskema, im makkiro, kasher. hammevi get vehinnicho zaken o chole, notno lah bechezkat shehu kayyam. bat yisrael hannesua lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam, ochelet batteruma vechezkat shehu kayyam. hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam, makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyam: 
Shelosha devarim amar rabbi elazar ben parta lifne chachamim vekiyyemu et devarav. al ir shehikkifah karkom, veal hassefina hammittarefet bayyam, veal hayyotze liddon, shehen bechezkat kayyamin. aval ir shekkevashah karkom, usefina sheavda vayyam, vehayyotze lehareg, notnin alehen chumre chayyim vechumre metim, bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma: 
Hammevi get beeretz yisrael vechala, hare ze meshallecho veyad acher. veim amar lo tol li hemenna chefetz peloni, lo yeshallechennu veyad acher, sheen retzono sheyyehe fikdono veyad acher: 
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam vechala, ose vet din umeshallecho, veomer lifnehem, befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. veen shaliach acharon tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, ella omer, sheliach bet din ani:
Mishnah Kelim 1:1-2:
Avot hattumot, hashsheretz, veshichvat zera, uteme met, vehammetzora bime safro, ume chattat sheen bahem kede hazzaya, hare ellu metammein adam vechelim bemagga, uchele cheres baavir, veenam metammein bemassa: 
Lemala mehem, nevela, ume chattat sheyyesh bahem kede hazzaya, shehem metammein et haadam bemassa letamme vegadim bemagga, vachasuche vegadim bemagga:
Mishnah Kelim 1:3-6:
Lemala mehen, boel nidda, shehu metamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. lemala mehen, zovo shel zav verukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav, vedam hannidda, shehen metammein bemagga uvemassa. lemala mehen, merkav, shehu metamme tachat even mesama. lemala min hammerkav, mishkav, sheshshave maggao lemassao. lemala min hammishkav, hazzav, shehazzav ose mishkav, veen mishkav ose mishkav: 
Lemala min hazzav, zava, shehi metammea et boalah. lemala min hazzava, metzora, shehu metamme bevia. lemala min hammetzora, etzem kasseora, shehu metamme tumat shiva. chamur mikkullam, hammet, shehu metamme veohel, ma sheen kullam metammein: 
Eser tumot porshot min haadam. mechussar kippurim, asur bakkodesh umuttar batteruma uvammaaser. chazar lihyot tevul yom, asur bakkodesh uvatteruma umuttar bammaaser. chazar lihyot baal keri, asur bishlashtan. chazar lihyot boel nidda, metamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. chazar lihyot zav sheraa shete reiyyot, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. raa shalosh, chayyav bakkarban. chazar lihyot metzora musgar, metamme bevia, ufatur min happeria umin happerima umin hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim. veim haya muchlat, chayyav bechullan. perash mimmennu evar sheen alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme veohel. veim yesh alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. shiur basar karauy, kede lehaalot arucha. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh bemakom echad kede lehakkifo vechut erev, yesh bo lehaalot arucha: 
Eser kedushshot hen, eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkol haaratzot. uma hi kedushshatah, shemmeviim mimmenna haomer vehabbikkurim ushete hallechem, ma sheen meviim ken mikkol haaratzot:
Mishnah Kelim 1:7-2:2:
Ayarot hammukkafot choma mekuddashot mimmenna, shemmeshallechim mittochan et hammetzoraim, umesabbevin letochan met ad sheyyirtzu. yatza, en machazirin oto: 
Lifnim min hachoma mekuddash mehem, sheochlim sham kadashim kallim umaaser sheni. har habbayit mekuddash mimmennu, sheen zavim vezavot, niddot veyoldot nichnasim lesham. hachel mekuddash mimmennu, sheen goyim uteme met nichnasim lesham. ezrat nashim mekuddeshet mimmennu, sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham, veen chayyavim aleha chattat. ezrat yisrael mekuddeshet mimmenna, sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham, vechayyavin aleha chattat. ezrat hakkohanim mekuddeshet mimmenna, sheen yisrael nichnasim lesham ella vishat tzarchehem, lismicha lishchita velitnufa: 
Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna, sheen baale mumin uferue rosh nichnasim lesham. hahechol mekuddash mimmennu, sheen nichnas lesham shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim. kodesh hakkodashim mekuddash mehem, sheen nichnas lesham ella chohen gadol beyom hakkippurim bishat haavoda. amar rabbi yose, bachamishsha devarim ben haulam velammizbeach shave lahechol, sheen baale mumin, uferue rosh, ushetuye yayin, veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim nichnasim lesham, uforshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketara: 
Kele etz, uchele or, uchele etzem, uchele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorim, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehem kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. kele cheres uchele neter, tumatan shava. mittammein umetammein baavir, umittammein meachorehen, veenan mittammein miggabbehen, usheviratan hi tohoratan: 
Haddakkin shebbichle cheres, vekarkerotehen, vedafnotehen yoshvin shello mesummachin, shiuran, mikkede sichat katan vead log. millog vead sea, birviit. missea vead satayim, bachatzi log. missatayim vead shalosh vead chamesh sein, belog, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, ani eni noten bahen midda, ella, haddakkin shebbichle cheres, vekarkerotehen, vedafnotehen yoshvin shello mesummachin, shiuran mikkede sichat katan vead kederot haddakkot. mehakkederot haddakkot vead chaviyyot ludiyyot, birviit. milludiyyot vead lachmiyyot, bachatzi log. millachmiyyot vead chatzavim gedolim, belog. rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer, chatzavim gedolim, shiuran bishne luggin. happakkim haggelilim vehechaviyyonot, shiur karkerotehen kol shehen, veen lahem defanot:
Mishnah Kelim 2:3-6:
Hattehorin shebbichle cheres, tavla sheen lah lizbez, umachta ferutza, veabbuv shel kallain, vesilonot, af al pi chefufin af al pi mekabbelin, vechavkav sheasao lesal happat, utefi shehitkino laanavim, vechavit shel shayyatin, vechavit defuna veshule hammachatz, vehammitta, vehakkisse, vehassafsal, vehashshulchan, vehassefina, vehammenora shel cheres, hare ellu tehorim. ze hakkelal, kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres, en lo achorayim: 
Pannas sheyyesh bo vet kibbul shemen, tame. vesheen bo, tahor. megufat hayyotzrin shehu foteach bah, tehora. veshehu gomer bah, temea. mashpech shel baale vattim, tahor. veshel rochlin, tame, mippene shehu shel midda, divre rabbi yehuda ven betera. rabbi akiva omer, mippene shehu mattehu al tziddo umeriach bo lallokeach: 
Kissuy kadde yayin vechadde shemen, vechissuy chaviot neyarot, tehorin. veim hitkino letashmish, temeim. kesuy hallefas, bizman shehu nakuv veyesh lo chiddud, tahor. im eno nakuv veen lo chiddud, tame, mippene shehi mesannenet letocho et hayyarak. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, mippene shehi hofechet alav et haruneki: 
Gistera shennimtzet bakkivshan, ad shello nigmera melachtah, tehora. mishshennigmera melachtah, temea. titros, rabbi eliezer bar tzadok metaher. rabbi yose metamme, mippene shehu chemotzi ferutot:
Mishnah Kelim 2:7-3:2:
Hattemein shebbichle cheres, tavla sheyyesh lah lizbez, umachta shelema, vetavla shehi melea kearot. nitmet achat mehem besheretz, lo nitmeu chullam. im yesh lah lizbez odef, nitmea achat mehem, nitmeu chullan. vechen bet tevalin shel cheres, vekalmarim hammetoamot. uvet tevalin shel etz, shennitma echad bemashke, lo nitma chavero. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, cholkin et avyo. hameshammesh lattame, tame. hameshammesh lattahor, tahor. im yesh lo lizbez odef, nitma achad mehem, nitma chavero: 
Hallappid, tame. uvet shiko shel ner, mittamme vaavir. hammasrek shel tzartzur, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Shiur keli cheres littaher, heasuy leochalin, shiuro vezetim. heasuy lemashkin, shiuro vemashkin. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilin oto lechumro vezetim: 
Chavit, shiurah bigrogarot, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer, beegozim. rabbi meir omer, bezetim. hallefas vehakkedera, shiuran bezetim. happach vehattefi, shiuran beshamen. vehatztzartzur, shiuro vemayim. rabbi shimon omer, shelashtan bezeronin. ner, shiuro veshamen. rabbi eliezer omer, bifruta ketanna. ner shennittal piv, tahor. veshel adama shehussak piv bappetila, tahor:
Mishnah Kinnim 2:5-3:4: Chattat mikkan veola mikkan usetuma vaemtza, parach min haemtza latztzedadin, echad helach veechad helach, lo hifsid kelum, ella yomar, ze shehalach etzel chattaot, chattat. veze shehalach etzel olot, ola. chazar laemtza, haemtzaiyyim yamutu, ellu yikrevu chattaot, veellu yikrevu olot. chazar o shepparach min haemtza latztzedadin, hare chullan yamutu. en meviin torin keneged bene yona, velo vene yona keneged torin. ketzad. haishsha shehevia chattatah tor, veolatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah tor. olatah tor, vechattatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah ben yona. ben azzay omer, holchin achar harishon. haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta, yaviu hayyorshin olatah. olatah umeta, lo yaviu hayyorshin chattatah:

Bamme devarim amurim, bechohen nimlach. aval bechohen sheeno nimlach, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyam lemala vechetzyam lematta, et shellemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul, veet shellematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul:

Achat lazo, ushetayim lazo, veshalosh lazo, veeser lazo, umea lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, hamerubbe chasher. ze hakkelal, kol makom sheatta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin velo yehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kol makom sheen atta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin ad sheyyehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hamerubbe chasher:

Chattat lazo, veola lazo, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, shetehen pasul, sheani omer, chattat kereva lemalan veola lemattan:

Chattat veola usetuma umeforeshet, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, en kasher ella setuma, vehi mitchalleket benehen:
Mishnah Kinnim 3:5-6: Chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan chattat shebbachova. chova shenayim bechattat, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. vechattat shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova. chova shenayim beola, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. ola shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher:

Haishsha sheamra, hare alay ken kesheeled zachar, yalda zachar, mevia shete kinnim, achat lenidrah veachat lechovatah. netanatam lakkohen, vehakkohen tzarich laasot shalosh peridim milmalan veachat millemattan. lo asa chen, ella asa shetayim lemalan ushetayim lemattan velo nimlach, tzericha lehavi od perida achat, veyakrivenna lemalan, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shetayim. persha nidrah, tzericha lehavi od shalosh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi arba. kava nidrah, tzericha lehavi od chamesh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shesh. netanatam lakkohen veen yadua ma natna, halach hakkohen veasa veen yadua me asa, tzericha lehavi od arba peridim lenidrah, ushetayim lechovatah, vechattat echat. ben azzay omer, shete chattaot. amar rabbi yehoshua, ze hu sheamru, keshehu chay kolo echad, ucheshehu met kolo shiva. ketzad kolo shiva. shete karnav, shete chatzotzrot. shete shokav, shene chalilin. oro, letof. meav, linvalim. bene meav, lechinnorot. veyesh omrim, af tzamro litchelet. rabbi shimon ben akashya omer, zikne am haaretz, kol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mittarefet alehen, shenneemar (iyyov 12), mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach. aval zikne tora enan chen, ella chol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mityashshevet alehen, shenneemar (sham), bishishim chachma veorech yamim tevuna:
Mishnah Sotah 9:13-15:
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, hattohora natla et hattaam veet hareach. hammaasrot natlu et shomen haddagan. vachachamim omrim, hazzenut vehakkeshafim killu et hakkol: 
Bappulmos shel aspasyanus gazru al atrot chatanim, veal haerus. bappulmos shel titus gazru al atrot kallot, veshelo yelammed adam et beno yevanit. bappulmos haacharon gazru shello tetze hakkalla baappiryon betoch hair, verabbotenu hittiru shettetze hakkalla baappiryon betoch hair: 
Mishshemmet rabbi meir, batlu moshle meshalim. mishshemmet ben azzay, batlu hashshakdanim. mishshemmet ben zoma, batlu haddarshanim. mishshemmet rabbi yehoshua, paska tova min haolam. mishshemmet rabban shimon ben gamliel, ba govay verabbu tzarot. mishshemmet rabbi elazar ben azarya, pasak haosher min hachachamim. mishshemmet rabbi akiva, batal kevod hattora. mishshemmet rabbi chanina ben dosa, batlu anshe maase. mishshemmet rabbi yose katnuta, pasku chasidim. velamma nikra shemo katnuta, shehaya katnutan shel chasidim. mishshemmet rabban yochanan ben zakkay, batal ziv hachachma. mishshemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken, batal kevod hattora umeta tohora uferishut. mishshemmet rabbi yishmael ben pavi, batal ziv hakkehunna. mishshemmet rabbi, batla anava veyirat chet. rabbi finchas ben yair omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, boshu chaverim uvene chorin, vechafu rosham, veniddaldelu anshe maase, vegavru vaale zeroa uvaale lashon, veen doresh veen mevakkesh, veen shoel, al mi lanu lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. rabbi eliezer haggadol omer, miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, sharu chakkimayya lemeheve chesafrayya, vesafrayya kechazzana, vechazzana keamma deara, veamma deara azla vedaldela, veen mevakkesh, al mi yesh lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. beikkevot meshicha chutzpa yisge, veyoker yaamir, haggefen titten piryah vehayyayin beyoker, vehammalchut tehafech leminut, veen tochecha, bet vaad yihye liznut, vehaggalil yecherav, vehaggavlan yishshom, veanshe haggevul yesovvu meir leir velo yechonnanu, vechachmat sofrim tisrach, veyire chet yimmaasu, vehaemet tehe nederet. nearim pene zekenim yalbinu, zekenim yaamdu mippene ketannim. (Micha 7) ben menabbel av, bat kama veimmah, kalla bachamotah, oyve ish anshe veto. pene haddor kifne hakkelev, habben eno mitbayyesh meaviv. veal mi yesh lanu lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. rabbi finchas ben yair omer, zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut, unekiyyut mevia lide tohora, vetohora mevia lide ferishut, uferishut mevia lide kedushsha, ukedushsha mevia lide anava, vaanava mevia lide yirat chet, veyirat chet mevia lide chasidut, vachasidut mevia lide ruach hakkodesh, veruach hakkodesh mevia lide techiyyat hammetim, utechiyyat hammetim ba al yede eliyyahu zachur lattov, amen:
Mishnah Sotah 9:9-12:
Mishsherabbu haratzchanim, batla egla arufa, mishshebba eliezer ben dinay, utechina ben perisha haya nikra, chazru likroto ben haratzchan. mishsherabbu hamenaafim, pasku hammayim hammarim, verabban yochanan ben zakkay hifsikan, shenneemar (Hoshea 4) lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena veal kallotechem ki tenaafna ki hem vegomer. mishshemmet yose ven yoezer ish tzereda veyose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim, batlu haeshkolot, shenneemar (Micha 7) en eshkol leechol bikkura ivveta nafshi: 
Yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayat hammaaser. af hu vittel et hameorrin veet hannokfin. ad yamav haya fattish makke virushalayim. uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay: 
Mishshebbatla sanhedrin, batla hashshir mibbet hammishtaot, shenneemar (yeshaya kad) bashshir lo yishtu yayin vegomer: 
Mishshemmetu neviim harishonim, batlu urim vetummim. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, batal hashshamir venofet tzufim, ufasku anshe amana, shenneemar (tehillim 12) hoshia Adonai ki gamar chasid vegomer. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, en yom sheen bo kelala, velo yarad hattal livracha, venittal taam happerot. rabbi yose omer, af nittal shomen happerot:
Mishnah Terumot 5:6-9: Sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea veniddammeu, venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer, medammaat kitruma vadday. vachachamim omrim, en hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon, veen hamechummatz machmitz ella lefi cheshbon, veen hammayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon:
Sea teruma shennafla lemea, higbihah venafla acheret, higbihah venafla acheret, hare zo mutteret, ad shettirbe teruma al hachullin:
Sea teruma shennafla lemea, velo hispik lehagebihah ad shennafla acheret, hare zo asura. verabbi shimon mattir:

Sea teruma shennafla lemea, utechanan ufachatu, keshem sheppachatu hachullin, kach pachata hatteruma, umuttar. sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea, utechanan vehotiru, keshem shehotiru hachullin, kakk hotira hatteruma, veasur. im yadua shehachittim shel chullin yafot mishshel teruma, muttar. sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea, veachar ken naflu sham chullin, im shogeg, muttar, veim mezid, asur:
Mishnah Terumot 6:1-4: Haochel teruma shogeg, meshallem keren vechomesh. echad haochel veechad hashshote veechad hassach, echad teruma tehora veechad teruma temea, meshallem chumshah vechomesh chumshah. eno meshallem teruma, ella chullin metukkanim, vehem naasin teruma, vehattashlumin teruma. im ratza hakkohen limchol, eno mochel:

Bat yisrael sheachla teruma veachar kach nisset lechohen, im teruma shello zacha vah kohen achla, meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah. veim teruma shezzacha vah kohen achla, meshallemet keren labbealim, vechomesh leatzmah, mippene sheamru, haochel teruma shogeg, meshallem keren labbealim, vechomesh lechol mi sheyyirtze:

Hammaachil et poalav veet orchav teruma, hu meshallem et hakkeren, vehem meshallemin et hachomesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hem meshallemin keren vechomesh, vehu meshallem lahem deme seudatan:

Haggonev teruma velo achalah, meshallem tashlume chefel deme teruma. achalah, meshallem shene keranim vechomesh, keren vechomesh min hachullin, vekeren deme teruma. ganav terumat hekdesh vaachalah, meshallem shene chomashim vekeren, sheen bahekdesh tashlume chafel:
Mishnah Terumot 6:5-7:3: En meshallemin min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea umin hahefker, velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato, velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, sheen hekdesh pode et hakkodesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim mattirin baellu:

Rabbi eliezer omer, meshallemin mimmin al sheeno mino, bilvad sheyyeshallem min hayyafe al hara. verabbi akiva omer, en meshallemin ella mimmin al mino. lefichach, im achal kishshuin shel erev sheviit, yamtin lekishshuin shel motzae sheviit, vishallem mehem. mimmekom sherabbi eliezer mekel, mishsham rabbi akiva machmir, shenneemar (Vayikra 22), venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, kol shehu rauy lihyot kodesh, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi akiva omer, venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, kodesh sheachol:
Haochel teruma mezid, meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. hattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:

Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veachar kach achla teruma, meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh, umitatah bisrefa. nisset leechad mikkol happesulin, meshallemet keren vechomesh, umitatah bechenek, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, zo vazo meshallemot et hakkeren veenan meshallemot et hachomesh, umitatan bisrefa:

Hammaachil et banav ketannim, veet avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim, haochel terumat chutza laaretz, vehaochel pachot mikkazzayit teruma, meshallem et hakkeren, veeno meshallem et hachomesh. vehattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:
Mishnah Terumot 7:4-7: Ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem keren vechomesh, hattashlumin teruma, im ratza hakkohen limchol, eno mochel. vechol hameshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh, hattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:

Shete kuppot, achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin, shennafla sea teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua leezo mehen nafla, hare ani omer, letoch shel teruma nafla. en yadua ezo hi shel teruma veezo hi shel chullin, achal achat mehen, patur, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose potrah. achal acher et hashsheniyya, patur. achal echad et shetehen, meshallem kakketanna shebbishtehen:

Nafla achat mehen letoch hachullin, enah medammatan, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose poter. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher, enah medammatan. naflu shetehen lemakom echad, medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen:

Zara et achat mehen, patur, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose poter. zara acher et hashsheniyya, patur. zara echad et shetehen, bedavar shezzaro chale, muttar, uvedavar sheen zaro chale. asur:
Mishnah Terumot 8:1-4:
Haishsha shehayta ochelet bitruma, bau veamru lah, met balich o gershech, vechen haeved shehaya ochel bitruma, uvau veamru lo, met rabbach, o mecharach leyisrael, o netanach bemattana, o asaach ben chorin. vechen kohen shehaya ochel bitruma, venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter. haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach, venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, rabbi eliezer omer, kol hakkarbanot shehikriv al gabbe hammizbeach, pesulim. verabbi yehoshua machshir. noda shehu vaal mum, avodato pesula: 
Vechullam, shehayta teruma vetoch pihem, rabbi eliezer omer, yivleu. verabbi yehoshua omer, yiflotu. amru lo, nitmeta venitmet teruma, rabbi eliezer omer, yivla. verabbi yehoshua omer, yiflot. tame hayita utemea hayta teruma, o noda shehu tevel, umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, o shettaam taam pishpesh letoch piv, hare ze yiflot: 
Haya ochel beeshkol venichnas min hagginna lechatzer, rabbi eliezer omer, yigmor. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo yigmor. chashecha lele shabbat, rabbi yehoshua omer, yigmor. verabbi eliezer omer, lo yigmor: 
Yayin shel teruma shennitgalla, yishshafech, veen tzarich lomar shel chullin. shelosha mashkin asurim mishshum gilluy, hammayim vehayyayin vehechalav. ushear kol hammashkin muttarim. kamma yishhu veyihyu asurin, kede sheyyetze harachash mimmakom karov veyishte:
Mishnah Terumot 8:5-9:
Shiur hammayim hamegullin, kede shettovad bahem hammara. rabbi yose omer, bechelim, kol shehen, uvakkarkaot, arbaim sea: 
Nikkure teenim vaanavim vekishshuin vehaddeluin vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot, afillu hem kikkar, echad gadol veechad katan, echad talush veechad mechubbar, kol sheyyesh bo lecha, asur. uneshuchat hannachash, asura, mippene sakkanat nefashot: 
Hameshammeret shel yayin, asura mishshum gilluy. rabbi nechemya mattir: 
Chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tuma, rabbi eliezer omer, im hayta munnachat bimkom turpa, yannichenna bemakom hammutzna, veim hayta megulla, yechassenna. verabbi yehoshua omer, im hayta munnachat bemakom mutzna, yannichenna bimkom turpa, veim hayta mechussa, yegallenna. rabban gamliel omer, al yechaddesh bah davar: 
Chavit shennishbera baggat haelyona, vehattachtona temea, mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, sheim yecholim lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora, yatztzil. veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer, tered vetittamme, veal yetammeenna veyadav:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22::
Asur lehityached im erva min haarayot ben zekena ben yalda sheddavar ze gorem legallot erva. chutz mehaem im benah vehaav im bitto vehabbaal im ishto nidda. vechatan sheppersa ishto nidda kodem sheyyivol asur lehityached immah ella hi yeshena ben hannashim vehu yashen ben haanashim. veim ba aleha bia rishona veachar kach nitmet muttar lehityached immah: 
Lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zachur veal habbehema. lefichach en asur lehityached immahen. veim nitrachek afillu miyyichud zachur uvehema hare ze meshubbach. ugedole hachachamim hayu marchikin habbehema kede shello yityachadu immah. veissur yichud haarayot mippi hakkabbala:

Kesheera maase amnon vetamar gazar david uvet dino al yichud penuya. veaf al pi sheenah erva bichlal yichud arayot hi. veshammay vehillel gazru al yichud kutit. nimtza kol hammityached im ishsha sheasur lehityached immah ben yisreelit ben kutit makkin et shenehen makkat mardut haish vehaishsha. umachrizin alehen. chutz meeshet ish sheaf al pi sheasur lehityached immah im nityached en lokin. shello lehotzi laaz aleha shezzinneta venimtzeu motziin laaz al habbanim shehen mamzerim: 
Kol ishsha sheasur lehityached immah im hayta ishto immo hare zo mutteret lehityached mippene sheishto meshammarto. aval lo tityached yisreelit im hakkuti veaf al pi sheishto immo sheen ishto shel kuti meshammarto veen lahen busha:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 15:18-20:
Vechen tziuu chachamim al haishsha shettihye tzenua betoch betah. velo tarbe sechok vekallut rosh bifne balah. velo titba tashmish hammitta befiha. velo tihye medabberet beesek ze. velo timna mibbalah kede letzaaro ad sheyyosif beahavatah ella nishmaat lo bechol et sheyyirtze. vetizzaher mikkerovav uvene beto kede shello yaavor alav ruach kina. vetitrachek min hakkiur umin haddome lechiur: 
Vechen tziuu chachamim sheyyihye adam mechabbed et ishto yoter miggufo veohavah kegufo. veim yesh lo mamon marbe betovatah kefi mamono. velo yattil aleha ema yetera. veyihye dibburo immah benachat. velo yihye atzev velo ragzan: 
Vechen tziuu al haishsha shettihye mechabbedet et balah beyoter midday veyihye aleha mora mimmennu vetaase kol maaseha al piv. veyihye beeneha kemo sar o melech. mehallechet betaavat libbo umarcheket kol ma sheyyisna. veze derech benot yisrael uvene yisrael hakkedoshim vehattehorim beziuugan. uvidrachim ellu yihye yishshuvan nae umeshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 7:3-4: Al tomar sheen teshuva ella meaverot sheyyesh bahen maase kegon zenut vegezel ugeneva. ella keshem shetztzarich adam lashuv meellu kach hu tzarich lechappes bedeot raot sheyyesh lo velashuv min hakkaas umin haeva umin hakkina umin hahittul umerdifat hammamon vehakkavod umerdifat hammaachalot vechayyotze bahen min hakkol tzarich lachazor bitshuva. veellu haavonot kashim meotan sheyyesh bahen maase shebbizman sheadam nishka beellu kashe hu lifrosh mehem. vechen hu omer <small>(yeshaya noah 7)</small> "yaazov rasha" vegomer:

Veal yedamme adam baal teshuva shehu meruchak mimmaalat hatztzaddikim mippene haavonot vehachataot sheasa. en haddavar ken ella ahuv venechmad hu lifne habbore keillu lo chata meolam. velo od ella shessecharo harebe shehare taam taam hachet uferash mimmennu vechavash yitzro. amru chachamim makom shebbaale teshuva omdin en tzaddikim gemurin yecholin laamod bo. kelomar maalatan gedola mimmaalat ellu shello chatu meolam mippene shehen kovshim yitzram yoter mehem:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 7:5-6: Kol hanneviim kullan tziuu al hatteshuva veen yisrael nigalin ella bitshuva. uchevar hivticha tora shessof yisrael laasot teshuva besof galutan umiyyad hen nigalin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30 1)</small> "vehaya chi yavou alecha kol haddevarim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 30 b)</small> "veshavta ad Adonai elohecha" <small>(Devarim 30 3)</small> "veshav Adonai elohecha" vegomer:

Gedola teshuva shemmekarevet et haadam lashshechina shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 14 b)</small> "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha". veneemar <small>(Amos 4 6)</small> "velo shavtem aday neum Adonai". veneemar <small>(yirmeya 4 1)</small> "im tashuv yisrael neum Adonai elay tashuv". kelomar im tachazor bitshuva bi tidbak. hatteshuva mekarevet et harchokim. emesh haya ze sanouy lifne hammakom meshukkatz umeruchak vetoeva. vehayyom hu ahuv venechmad karov veyadid. vechen atta motze shebbelashon shehakkadosh baruch hu marchik hachotim bah mekarev et hashshavim ben yachid ben rabbim. shenneemar <small>(Hoshea b 1)</small> "vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay". veneemar bichanyahu berishato (ketov) [kitvu] <small>(yirmeya 22 30)</small> "et haish hazze ariri gever lo yitzlach beyamav", <small>(yirmeya 22 kad)</small> "im yihye kanyahu ben yehoyakim melech yehuda chotam al yad yemini" vegomer. vechevan sheshshav begaluto neemar bizrubbavel beno <small>(chaggay b 23)</small> "bayyom hahu neum Adonai tzevaot ekkachacha zerubbavel ben shealtiel avdi neum Adonai vesamticha kachotam":
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:1-3: Asur lomar lenachri laasot lanu melacha beshabbat af al pi sheeno metzuvve al hashshabbat. veaf al pi sheamar lo mikkodem hashshabbat. veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leotah melacha ella leachar hashshabbat. vedavar ze asur middivre sofrim kede shello tihye shabbat kalla beenehen veyavou laasot beatzman:

Nachri sheasa melacha meatzmo beshabbat im bishvil yisrael asa otah asur lehanot beotah melacha ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde shettease. vehu shello yehe haddavar befarhesya ad sheyyedu bo rabbim sheddavar ze bishvil peloni hu naasa beshabbat. veim bishvil atzmo bilvad asa muttar lehanot bah beshabbat:

Ketzad. nachri shehidlik et hanner mishtammesh leoro yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. asa nachri kevesh lered bo min hassefina yered acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. likket asavim lehaachil livhemto manniach yisrael behemto leechol mehen. vehu shello yehe oto hannachri makkir leoto yisrael shemma yarbe bimlachto bishvilo venimtza ose bishvil yisrael. vechen kol davar sheefshar leharebot bo lo yehane bo beshabbat ella im ken eno makkiro:
Niddah 17a:4-5: Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: chamishsha devarim hen shehaose otan mitchayyev benafsho vedamo berosho — haochel shum kaluf, uvatzal kaluf, uvetza kelufa, vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayla, vehallan bevet hakkevarot, vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim, vehammakkiz dam umeshammesh mittato.

Haochel shum kaluf kulei. veaf al gav demannechi besilleta umetzayyeyri vachatimi — ruach raa shora alehen. vela amaran ella dela shiyyer bahen ikkaran o kelippatan, aval shiyyer bahen ikkaran o kelippatan — let lan ba.

Toavat Adonai derech rasha umeraddef tzedaka yeehav
Shabbat 122a:5-122b:2: Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan ner, mishshum dener leechad ner lemea, aval mayim ligzar, dilma ate leapposhe bishvil yisrael. vechevesh lema li? maase derabban gamliel uzekenim ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: goy shellikket asavim — maachil acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto — mashke acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. bamme devarim amurim — sheen makkiro, aval makkiro — asur.
Ini?! vehaamar rav huna amar rabbi chanina: maamid adam behemto al gabbe asavim beshabbat, aval lo al gabbe muketze beshabbat. dekaem la beappah, veazla hi veachla.
Amar mar: bamme devarim amurim — sheen makkiro, aval makkiro — asur. ha rabban gamliel makkiro hava! amar abbaye: shello befanav hava. rava amar: afillu tema befanav, ner leechad ner lemea.
Metivi, amar lahen rabban gamliel: hoil veshello befanenu asao — nered bo. ema: hoil vaasao nered bo.

Ta shema: ir sheyyisrael vegoyim darin betochah, vehayta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat, im rov goyim — muttar lirchotz bah miyyad. im rov yisrael — yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin! hatam, ki mechammemi — addata derubba mechammemi.
Ta shema: ner haddaluk bimsibba, im rov goyim — muttar lehishtammesh leorah, im rov yisrael — asur, mechetza al mechetza — asur. hatam name, ki madleki —
Shemuel ikkela leve avi toran. ata hahu goy adlek sheraga. ahderinhu shemuel leappeh. kevan dachaza deayyti shetar veka kare, amar: addata denafsheh hu deadlek. ahderinhu ihu leappeh gabbe sheraga.
Yevamot 122b:1-11: Gemara may geriuta defunedakit? amar rav kahana: punedakit — goya hayta, umesicha lefi tumma hayta: "ze maklo, veze tarmilo, veze kever shekkevartiv bo". vechen tane abba bereh derav minyome bar chiyyay: punedakit goya hayta, umesicha lefi tumma hayta: "ze maklo, veze tarmilo, veze kever shekkevartiv bo".
Veha "ayye chaverenu" kaamri lah? kevan dachazetinhu, bachya. amru lah: "ayye chaverenu?" amra lahem: "met ukevartiv".

Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad shebba lehaid al haishsha lifne rabbi tarfon. amar lo: "beni, heach atta yodea beedut ishsha zo?" amar: "ani vahu hayinu holchim badderech, veradaf acharenu gayis, venitla beyichur shel zayit ufeshacho, vehechzir et haggayis laachorav".

"Amarti lo: 'arye! yishar kochacha. amar li: 'minnayin atta yodea shearye shemi? kach korin oti beiri: yochanan berabbi yehonatan, arye demikkefar shichya. leyamim chala umet." vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto.

Verabbi tarfon la bae derisha vachakira? vehatanya: maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi tarfon lehaid edut ishsha. amar lo: "beni, heach atta yodea edut zo?" amar lo: "ani vahu hayinu holchin badderech, veradaf acharenu gayis, venitla beyichur teena ufeshacho. vehechzir et haggayis laachorav. amarti lo: 'yishar kochacha arye!' amar li: 'yafe kivvavnta lishmi, shekkach korin oti beiri: yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya. leyamim chala umet".

Amar lo: "lo kach amrat li yochanan ben yonatan demikkefar shichya arye?" amar leh: "lo, ella kach amarti lach: yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya". vedikdek alav shenayim ushelosha peamim, vechivven et devarav, vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto.
Tannae hi. detanya: en bodkin ede nashim bidrisha vachakira, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer: bodkin.
Vekamippalgi bidrabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chanina: devar tora, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha vachakira. shenneemar: "mishpat echad yihye lachem".
Uma taam amru dine mamonot en tzerichin derisha vachakira — shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
Uvemay kamippalgi — mar savar: kevan deikka ketubba lemishkal — kedine mamonot dame, umar savar: kevan deka sharenan eshet ish lealma — kedine nefashot dame.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".
Zohar, Beshalach 28: [Parashat haman] (Shemot 16:4) vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. hay kera okimna leh, beshaata devar nash shachiv beve mareh, ha ittefas beatronya demalka, resheh bekulera, ragloy bechufesirin, (sefer acher batepaseraa) kamma chelin natrin leh, mehay gisa, umehay gisa. shayyfoy kullehu bedochaka, maggichin illen beillen. mechla itade minneh.

Behahu zimna, pakdin aleh appotrofa, lemelaf aleh zechut kame malka, dichtiv, (iyyov 33:23) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef. behahi shaata, zakkaa chulakeh debar nash deal aleh, veolif leh archa, leshezavuteh min dina. hada hu dichtiv ashre maskil el dal.

Vehecha yachil leshezava leh, lemelaf leh archoy dechayye, leatava lekame mareh, keden itavid appotrofosa aleh leella. may agreh. beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. davar acher, ashre maskil el dal, kamma takkifa agra demiskena, kame kudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, tavavhna al hay kera dichtiv, (Tehillim 69:34) ki shomea el evyonim Adonai, vechi el evyonim shomea velo leachara. amar ribbi shimon, begin deinnun kerivin yattir lemalka, dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:19) lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze. velet lach bealma, deihu tavir libba kemiskena. tu amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, kol innun beni alma, itchazyayn kame kudesha berich hu, begufa venafsha, umiskena la itchaze ella benafsha bilchodoy, vekudesha berich hu kariv lenafsha yattir miggufa.

Miskena chad hava bishvivuteh der yesa, vela hava man deashgach beh, vehu hava achsif, vela takkif bivne nasha, yoma chad challash, al aleh ribbi yesa, shama chad kala deamar, tilka tilka, ha nafsha parcha gabbay, vela matu yomoy. vavy livni mateh dela ishtechach behu deyativ nafsheh legabbeh. kam ribbi yesa, shadde befumeh, mayya degargerin, afuta dekuneta (sefer acher dakevapetaa) itbeza ziyia beanpoy, vetav rucheh legabbeh.

Levatar ata veshail leh, amar chayyecha ribbi, nafsha nafkat minnay, umatu lah kame kuresyay demalka, uvaat leishtaara tamman, ella devaa kudesha berich hu lezakkaa lach, veachrizu alach, zammin hu ribbi (Vayikra 79 amud alef 150 amud alef) yesa, lesalleka rucheh, uleitkeshshera bechad idra kaddisha dizminin chavrayyay leitteara beara, veha atkinu telat kurseyan, dekayymin lach ulechavrach. mehahu yoma havo mashgichin beh bene mateh.

Tu, miskena achara avar kameh der yitzchak, vahava bideh pelag mea dechesef. amar leh leribbi yitzchak, ashlim li velivnay velivnatay nafshaan. amar leh vehech ashlim nafshayychu, deha la ishtechach gabbay bar pelag mea. amar leh, beda ashlimna, biflag achara deit gabbay, afkeh veyahaveh leh.

Achziu leh bechelmeh, dehava avar bisfata deyamma rabba, uvaan lemishdeyeh begavvevy, (vaychi 218 amud alef) chama leribbi shimon, dehava oshit yedoy lokovleh, veate hahu miskena veafkeh, veyahaveh bidoy deribbi shimon, veishteziv. kad ittear, nafal befumeh, hay kera, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai.

Veta chaze, kol yoma veyoma, natif talla meattika kaddisha lizer appin, umitbarchan kol chakal tappuchin kaddishin. umehahu talla angid leinun diltatta, umalachin kaddishin ittezanu minneh, kol chad vechad kefum mechaleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 78:25) lechem abbirim achal ish, umehahu mezona achlu yisrael bemadbera.

Amar ribbi shimon, kamma bene nasha mittezanin behay zimna minneh, uman innun. illen chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, yome velele. vechi salleka datach mehahu mezona mammash. la. ella keen hahu mezona mammash, deshakil al chad teren.

Ta chaze, yisrael kad alu veitdevaku bemalka kaddisha, begin gilluya dirshima kaddisha, keden zachu lemechal nahama achara illaa, yattir mimma dehava bekadmita. bekadmita kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, alu benahama, deikre matztza, vehasheta zachu, vealu lemechal nahama achara illaa yattir, meatar illaa, dichtiv hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. min hashshamayim mammash. uvehahu zimna ishtechach lehu leyisrael. meatar da. chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, meatar achara illaa yattir ittezanu. may hu. kema dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. atar illaa yattir.

Amar leh Rabbi elazar, i hachi, amay chalsha nafshayyhu yattir mishshear bene alma, deha shear bene nasha, bechela vetukepa yattir itchazun leishtakkecha. (sefer acher inun yattir) amar leh yeot shailta.

Ta chaze, kol mezoni divne alma milleella ka atyayn. hahu mezona deate min shemayya veara, da mezona dechol alma, vehu mezona dechola, vehu mezona gas veav. vehahu mezona deate yattir meella, hu mezona yattir dakik, kaatya meatar dedina ishtechach, veda hu mezona deachlu yisrael kad nafku mimmitzrayim. (yattir dekika) mezona deishtechach lehu leyisrael, behahu zimna bemadbera, meatar illaa deikre shamayim, hu mezona yattir dekika, deayil yattir lenafsha mikkolla, umitperash yattir miggufa, veikre lechem abbirim.

Mezona illaa yattir mikkolla, hu mezona dechavrayyay, innun demishtaddele beorayyta, deachle mezona derucha venishmeta, vela achle mezona degufa kelal, vehayeynu meatar illaa yakkira al kolla, veikre chachma. begine kach chalish gufa dechavrayyay, yattir mibbene alma, deha la achle mezona degufa kelal. veachle mezona derucha venishmeta, meatar rechika illaa, yakkira mikkolla. uvegine kach hahu mezona dakik min dekika, yattir mikkolla. zakkaa chulakehon, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. zakkaa chulaka degufa, deyachil leittezana bimzona denafsha.

Amar leh Rabbi elazar, vadday hachi hu. aval behay zimna, ech ishtakkeche mezone illen. amar leh vadday yeot shailta. ta chaze, veda hu beriru demilla, mezona kadmaa, hu mezona dechol alma, hahu deatya min shemayya veara, vehu mezona degufa. (sefer acher decholla)

Mezona dehu illaa minneh, hahu deihu dekika yattir, veata meatar dedina sharya, deikre tzedek, veda hu mezona demiskene. veraza demilla, man deashlim lemiskena, ashlim leh at chad, veitavid tzedaka, veraza da (Mishlei 11:17) gomel nafsho ish chesed. gemilut chasadim mashma, deha bedina sharya, veashlim leh chesed, keden hu rachame.

Mezona illaa yattir meillen, hu mezona illaa veyakkira, meatar deikre shamayim, vehu dakik mikkullehu, vehu mezona divne mare, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 41:4) Adonai yisadennu al eres devay kol mishkavo hafachta vechalyo. Adonai, dayyka, may tama. begin dehane bene mare, la ittezne ella behahu dekudesha berich hu mammash. (umay ihu, chelev vedam. hada hu dichtiv (Yechezkel 45) lehakeriv li chelev vedam. veda hu mezona meatar deikre shamayim, vehu yakkira vaayleah dakik mikkolla)
Mezona illaa kaddisha veyakkira da hu mezone deruchin venishmatin, vehu mezona daatar rechika illaa, (sefer acher mehahu atar deikre noam Adonai.)

Veyakkira mikkolla, hu mezona dechavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, vehu mezona deate mechachma illaa. may tama meatar da. begin deorayyta nafka (Bereshit 47 amud bet, Vayikra 186 amud bet 198 amud bet) mechachma illaa, veinnun demishtaddele beorayyta, ayyle beikara desharshaha, veal da, mezona dilhon, mehahu atar illaa kaddisha ka atya.

Ata Rabbi elazar, venashik yedoy. amar, zakkaa chulaki dekaimna bemillin illen. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velele, dezache lon behay alma, uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha.

(Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 145:16) poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon. ma ketiv leella, ene chol elecha yesabberu. kol innun beni alma, metzappan vezakfan ayynin lekudesha berich hu, begin kach, (sefer acher aval) kol innun bene mehemanuta baan (sefer acher atzetareyken lemive) bechol yoma veyoma, leshaala mezonayyhu mikudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelotehon aleh.

May tama. begin dechol man dimtzale tzeloteh legabbe kudesha berich hu al mezoneh, garim deyitbarech kol yoma al yedoy, hahu ilana demazon decholla beh. (vetama demilla (Tehillim 68:20) baruch Adonai yom yom) veaf al gav deishtechach immeh, bae lemishal kame kudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelota al mezona kol yoma, begin deyishtechachu al yedoy birkan kol yoma veyoma leella, veda hu baruch Adonai yom yom.

Val da, la livae leh leeynash levashshela mezona, min yoma leyoma acharina, dela leakkev yoma leyoma achara. hada hu dichtiv veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beyomo. yom beyomo, dayyka. bar meerev shabbat leshabbat, kema deokimna. ucheden ishtechach kudesha berich hu male birkan bechol yoma. ucheden ketiv poteach et yadecha vegomer. may ratzon. hahu ratzon deishtechach meattika kaddisha, venafik minneh ratzon, leishtakkecha mezone lecholla. uman deshail mezone bechol yoma veyoma, hahu ikre bera mehemana, beraza divgineh mishtachchan birkan leella.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 147:11) rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo, kamma it lehu livne nasha lemehach bearchoy demalka kaddisha, ulemehach bearchoy deorayyta, begin deyishtakkechun birkan lechullehu, leillae uletattae.

Detanya, maydichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar. etpaar vday. may mashma. divgin yisrael letatta, kudesha berich hu mitpaar leella. umay peera dileh. deitchabbash bitfilin, demitchabbera gavvni leitpaara.

Tana, rotze Adonai et yereav, rotze Adonai bireav mibbae leh. may rotze Adonai et yereav, ella rotze Adonai et yereav, kelomar, appik hay ratzon, umitrae (nusach acher vaataydaa) behu kudesha berich hu, lireav dedachalin leh. uman innun yereav deappik lon hay ratzon. hadar veamar, et hameyachalim lechasdo, innun dimtzafan umechakkan bechol yoma veyoma, lemibbae mezonayyhu min kudesha berich hu, mashma dichtiv et hameyachalim lechasdo.

Ribbi yesa sava, la atkin seudata bechol yoma, ad devaa bauteh kame kudesha berich hu, al mezone. amar, la natkin seudata, ad detityehiv mibbe malka. levatar devae bauteh kame kudesha berich hu, hava mechakke shaata chada, amar ha idan detityehiv mibbe malka, mikkan ulehala atkinu seudata. veda hu archa, deinnun dachale kudesha berich hu, dachale chattaa.

Innun chayyayvayya deazlin akimin bearche orayyta, ma ketiv behu. (Yeshayahu Adonai:11) hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu. veal da rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo. lechasdo dayyka. (sefer acher uveha) ishtemodan innun bene mehemanuta bechol yoma veyoma, hada hu dichtiv, veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beyomo. yom beyomo kaamar, velo devar yom leyom acher.

Vechol kach lamma. lemaan anassennu hayelech betorati im lo bechan ishtemodan innun bene mehemanuta, dechol yoma veyoma innun azle beorach meshar beorayyta. ribbi yitzchak amar mehacha, (Mishlei 13:25) tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho, batar desava nafsheh milletzalle ulemikre beorayyta.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ad la yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, avchin ben innun beni mehemanuta, uven innun chayyayvayya delav innun beni mehemanuta, vela kayymin beorayyta. uvamme avchin lon. bamman. kema deittemar anassennu. vechol innun deishtechachu deinnun bene mehemanuta, rashim leh kudesha berich hu, birshimu dechitra dechesed, kema deat amer hameyachalim lechasdo, veal da lemaan anassennu. vechol innun dela mishtakkeche beni mehemanuta, ade minnayyhu kitra illaa da. umana achriz veamar, (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. veim kol da lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir.

Tana, behahu shaata ishtelimu yisrael letatta, kegavvna dilella, kema deokimna, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:27) vayyavou elima vesham shetem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim vegomer. veittakkaf ilana kaddisha, bitresar techumin, bearba sitre alma. veittakkaf beshivin anfin, vecholla kegavvna dilella.

Behahi shaata, natif talla kaddisha, meattika setimaa, umalya leresheh dizer anpin, atar deikre shamayim. umehahu talla dinhora illaa kaddisha, hava nagid venachit mana letatta. vechad hava nachit, hava mitperash gelidin gelidin, veakrish letatta. hada hu dichtiv dak kakkefor al haaretz.

Kol innun bene mehemanuta, nafke velakte, umevarchan shema kaddisha aleh. vehahu mana, hava salik rechin dechol busemin deginta deeden, deha beh itmeshach venachit letatta. shavye lekameh, bechol taama deihu bae, hachi taim leh, umevarech lemalka kaddisha illaa.
Ucheden mitbarech bemeoy, vahava mistakkel veyada leella, veistache bechachma illaa, veal da ikrun dor dea. veillen havo bene mehemanuta, ulehon ityehivat orayyta leistakkela bah, uleminda archaha.

Veinnun dela ishtechachu beni mehemanuta, ma ketiv behu, (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu. may shatu. shetuta havo nasbe legarmayyhu, begin dela havo bene mehemanuta. ma ketiv behu. vetachanu varechayim o dachu bammedocha vegomer. man atrach lon kol hay. ella deinnun la havo bene mehemanuta.

Kegavvna da, innun dela mehemne beh bekudesha berich hu, la baan leistakkela bearchoy, veinnun baan leatrecha garmayyhu kol yoma batar mezona, yemama velele, dilma la salik bidayyhu pitta denahama. man garim lon hay. begin delav innun bene mehemanuta.

Uf hacha, shatu haam velaktu, shatu bishttuta degarmayyhu, uvaan leatrecha aleh, hada hu dichtiv, vetachanu varechayim. batar kol tircha da, la salik bidayyhu, ella dichtiv vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen. vela yattir. man garim lon hay, begin dela havo bene mehemanuta.

Amar ribbi yose, may leshad hashshamen. ikka deamre, delish bemishcha, ketargumo. veikka deamre, ma hashshed itchazar lechamma gavvnin, uf mana, itchazar lechamma gavvnin. ribbi yehuda amar, leshad hashshamen, yenika demishcha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, ish lefi achlo lakatu. vechi man deachil kima, lakit kima, uman deachil yattir, lakit yattir, veha ketiv lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir. ella lefum innun deachlin laktin. mashma achlo, man dehava achil leh, uvegine kach la ketiv achilato.

May ka mayyre. achid bar nash beavda, o beamata, veamar dehu dileh. ata chavreh, veamar, hay avda dili hu. kerivu lekameh demoshe ledina, amar lon kamma nafshaan bevetecha, vechamma nafshaan beveteh deden, amar kach vechach. vehahu shaata amar lon moshe, lakatu machar, vechol chad minnayychu yete legabbay. lemachar, nafku velaktu, veatyayn kame moshe, shavvyayn kameh mana, hava madid leh. i hahu avda deden, ashkach hahu omra deavda, behay mana. deha chad omra lechol nefesh venefesh mibbeteh. madid leden, veishtechach chasra, hahu mechla deavda, behahu mana dileh, vechad omra lechol nefesh venefesh mibbeteh. amar avda deden hu, hada hu dichtiv ish lefi achlo lakatu uchetiv omer laggulgolet mispar nafshotechem.

Amar Rabbi (nusach acher yesa) chiyyay, ketiv, (Shemot 16:6-7) erev vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai. erev vidatem, bemay yindeun. ella hachi tana, bechol yoma veyoma ishtechachu nimuse kudesha berich hu. betzafra, ittear chesed bealma. behahu zimna deikre erev, talya dina bealma, veha ukemuha, divgine kach, yitzchak tikken tefillat hammincha. (may ka mayyre) veal da, erev vidatem, kad ittear dina bealma, tindeun, divhahu dina appik Adonai yatchon mimmitzrayim. uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai deha behahu zimna ittear chesed bealma veyitten lechu lemechal.

Rabbi chiyyay amar ippecha, ma ketiv leella, beshivtenu al sir habbasar vegomer. beh shaata, ittear erev, dehahu zimna deittear dina, ittear name chesed bealma. hada hu dichtiv, vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim. tindeun hahu chesed deavad immechon, bezimna dedina veappik yatchon meara demitzrayim. uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai, kevod Adonai ha yedia. vekol kach lamma. bishmoa Adonai et telunnotechem vegomer.
Amar Rabbi yesa, la shane kudesha berich hu nimusoy, bar deinnun chayyayve alma shanyayn lon, umehappeche rachame ledina, kema deittemar.

Tane Rabbi elazar, mehay mana zeminin tzaddikayyay lemechal lealma deate, vei tema behay gavvna. la. ella yattir, dela hava ken lealmin. may ihu. kema deokimna dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

(Shemot 16:29) reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat. Rabbi chizkiyya patach (Tehillim 130:1) shir hammaalot mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. shir hammaalot satam, vela parish man amaru. ella shir hammaalot, dizminin kol bene alma lememar, dezammin hay shir lememreh ledare alma.

Umay hu mimmaamakkim keraticha. hachi tana, kol man dimtzale tzelota kame malka kaddisha, bae lemibbae bauteh, uletzallaa (Vayikra amud alef) meimka delibba, begin deyishtechach libbeh shelim bekudesha berich hu, vichavven libba ureuta. umi amar david hachi, veha ketiv, (Tehillim 119:10) bechol libbi derashticha. veda kera saggi, may bae mimmaamakkim.

Ella hachi tana, kol bar nash devae bauteh kame malka, bae lechavvevna data (nusach acher lavo) ureuta, meikkara dechol ikarin, leamshacha birkan meimka devera, (nusach acher decholla) begin deyangid birkan mimmabbua decholla. umay hu. hahu atar denafik minneh, veishtechach minneh, hahu nahar, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. uchetiv (Tehillim 46:5) nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim. veda ikre mimmaamakkim. (49 amud alef) imka decholla, imka devera, demabbuin nafkin venagdin levarcha kolla. veda hu sheruta leamshacha birkan meella letatta.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, (Bereshit 234 amud alef, Vayikra 285 1 2, 297 amud bet) kad attika setimaa dechol setimin, bae lezamna birkan lealmin, ashre kolla, veachlil kolla, behay amika illaa, umehacha shaiv veitnegid bera (nusach acher nahara) denachalin umabbuin itnegidu minneh, umitshakyayn minneh kullehu. uman dimtzale tzeloteh, bae lechavvevna libba ureuta, leamshacha birkan mehahu amika decholla, begin deyitkabbal tzeloteh, veyitavid reuteh.

Vayyomer moshe alehem ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker. amar ribbi yehuda, bechol yoma veyoma, mitbarech alma mehahu yoma illaa, deha kol shita yomin mitbarchan miyyoma sheviaa. vechol yoma yahiv mehahu beracha dekabbil behahu yoma dileh.

Veal da moshe amar, ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker. may tama. begin dela yahiv, vela yozif yoma da lechavreh, ella kol chad vechad shalit bilchodoy, behahu yoma dileh. deha la shalit yoma beyoma dechavreh.

Begine kach, kol innun (nusach acher amar rabbi yehuda kol yoma veyoma mitbarech mehahu yoma ilaa yoma sheviaa umitbarchan kol shita yomin kol chad vechad bilchodoy vechol yoma yahiv beyoma dileh mehahu beracha dekabbil mehahu yoma ilaa veal da moshe amar ish el yoter mimmennu ad bakar deha lo shallit yoma beyoma delav dileh vechol inun) chamishsha yomin shallitin beyomayyhu, veishtechach beh, ma dekabbilu, veyoma shetitaa ishtechach beh yattir. veazla ha, keha deamar ribbi elazar, may dichtiv yom hashshishshi, vela ittemar hachi bechol shear yomin. ella hachi ukemuha, hashshishshi. deizdavvevga (daazademanea) beh matronita. leatkena patora lemalka, ubbegin kach, ishtechachu beh teren chulakin, chad leyomeh, vechad letikkuna, bechedvavta demalka bematronita.

Vehahu lelya, chedvavta dematronita bemalka, veziuuga dilhon, umitbarchan kol shita yomin, kol chad vechad bilchodoy. begin kach, bae bar nash lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, begin deshari aleh birkan milleella, uvirkata la ishtechach al patora rekanya, (vehahu lelya chedvata dematronita bemalka veziuuga dilhon) begin kach, talmide chachamim deyadin raza da, ziuuga dilhon meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat, may shabbat. yoma deveh nayychin shear yomin, vehu kelala dechol innun shita acharanin, uminneh mitbarchin. ribbi yesa amar, vechen name keneset yisrael ikre shabbat, begin deihi bat zugo, veda hi kalla. dichtiv (Shemot 31:14) ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem. lachem vela lishar ammin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) beni uven bene yisrael. veda hi achasanat yerutat almin leyisrael. veal da, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha vegomer uveatrih okimna mille.

Ketiv al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii. mimmekomo. tanenan, mehahu makom deitchaze lemehach. veraza demilla dichtiv, (yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo, veda ihu makom. veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 3:Adonai) ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat kodesh hu. atar yedia karenan leh makom deishtemoda yekara illaa.

Uvegin kach, azharuta levar nash, deka mitattera beittura kaddisha dilella, dela yippuk minneh befumeh millula (amud alef amud bet) dechol, begin dei yippuk minneh, ka mechallel yoma deshabbeta, bidoy beovadta. beragloy, lemehach levar mitteren alfin ammin. kol illen chillula deshabbeta innun.

Al yetze ish mimmekomo, da ihu atar yakkira dikdushsha, deha levar minneh, elohim acherim ninhu. baruch kevod Adonai, da kavod dilella. mimmekomo, da kavod diltatta. da ihu raza daattara deshabbat, begin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo. zakkaa chulakeh man dezache likara deshabbeta zakkaa ihu bealma den uvealma deate.
Zohar, Beshalach 4: (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid. kamma chaviva orayyta kameh dekudesha berich hu, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, rachim hu leella, rachim hu letatta, kudesha berich hu atzit leh lemiluloy, la shavik leh behay alma vela shavik leh bealma deate.

Veorayyta bae lemile bah bimama uvelelya, dichtiv, (yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla vegomer. tinach bimama, belelya amay. begin diyhe shechiach legabbe shema kaddisha shelim. kema delet yomam bela lelya, velav ihu shelim, ella da im da, kach bae orayyta, leishtakkecha immeh debar nash yoma velelya, lemeheve shelemuta legabbe debar nash yomam valayla.

Veha ittemar, deikara delelya, mippalguta veilach. veaf al gav defalgu kadmita bichlala delelya hu, aval befalgut lelya, kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden, leishtashea im tzaddikayya, ucheden, bae leh levar nash lemekam, ulemile beorayyta.

Veha ittemar, dekudesha berich hu vechol tzaddikayya divginta deeden, kullehu tzayytin lekalleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini, veha ukemuha, hayyoshevet baggannim: da keneset yisrael, deihi meshabbachat leh lekudesha berich hu, bishvacha deorayyta, belelya. zakkaa chulakeh, man deishtattaf bahadah, leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, bishvacha deorayyta.

Vechad ate tzafra, keneset yisrael atya umishtashea beh bekudesha berich hu, veoshit lah legabbah sharvita dechesed, vela alla bilchodaha, ella alla, veal innun demishtattefin bahadah, veha ittemar dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla vegomer. veal da ayyelet hashshachar ikre.

Veamar rabbi shimon, beshaata devae leitnahara tzafra, itchashach veitkaddar nehora, vekadruta ishtechach. keden itchabberat itteta bevalah, detanenan, ishsha mesapperet im balah, lemishtae bahadeh, vealat lehechleh.

Levatar kad bae shimsha lemeal, itnehir veatat lelya, venatil leh. keden kol tarin setimin, vechamrin naarin, vechalbin navchin, kad itpelag lelya, shaari malka (lemikre) lemekam, umatronita lezammera, veate malka veakish letara dehechla, veamar (Shir hashshirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati vegomer. ucheden mishtaasha benishmathon detzaddikayya.

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu, deittear hahu zimna bemille deorayyta, begin da, kol innun divne hechla dematronita, kullehu bayayn lemekam behahu zimna, leshabbecha lemalka vechullehu meshabbechan kameh, ushevacha desalik mehay alma, da deihu rachik, (yattir) da nicha leh lekudesha berich hu mikkolla.
Kad istelik lelya, veate tzafra, (nusach acher vaaytechasheych) veitkaddar, keden malka umatronita beraza bechedva, veyahiv lah mattenan, ulechol bene hechlah. zakkaa chulakeh man deihu beminyayna.

VaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. kudesha berich hu, uvet dineh. amar ribbi yitzchak, hayeynu detanenan, shechinta baavahata natla. holech lifnehem yomam: da avraham. beammud anan: da yitzchak. lanchotam hadderech: da yaakov. dichtiv beh (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko. velayla beammud esh lehair lahem: da david malka.

Vechullehu reticha illaa kaddisha, lemehach yisrael bishlimuta decholla, begin deyechozun avahan purekana (sefer acher devenayyhu) dilhon, dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:4) veanochi aalcha gam alo, im hammerkava. uchetiv vaAdonai holech vegomer, lalechet yomam velayla. vechi amay havo azle yomam velayla, yahachun bimama, vela yahachun belelya, kivni enasha dearkin, kevan dekudesha berich hu natir lon, amay azlin bimama uvelelya. ella, leishtakkecha behu shelemuta decholla, delet shelimu ella yom velayla.

Amar ribbi abba, hachi okimna, vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan: da avraham. velayla beammud esh: da yitzchak. vei hachi yaakov an hu. ella bemilla kadmaa ittemar, vetamman shaari, kema dichtiv vaAdonai.

Velayla beammud esh, hava nahir, besitra da uveda. begin deyirdefun mitzrae batrehon, leityaykra shema dekudesha berich hu, birtichoy ufarashoy. begin lemezal yemama velelya, aspakalarya denahara, udela nahara. vetu, begin leataa lemitzrae deyemrun mikre hu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 19:13) noalu sare tzoan, uchetiv (yeshaya ma) meshiv chachamim achor, veal da azle bimama uvelelya.

Ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu appik lon mimmitzrayim, lemeheve chulakeh veachasanteh. veta chaze, besitra deyovla, ishtechach cheru leyisrael. vechen lezimna deate, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 27:13) vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol vegomer.

Uvegin hahu yovla illaa, itakkevu chamshin yomin, lekabbela orayyta, ulemikrav letura desinay. vechevan deazle biymama, azle belelya, lemehve kolla chad yoma, ben yemama velelya, vela ishtechach perishu.

Velo od, ella dechullehu benayycha azlin, liruta denafshayyhu, beyoma dekabbilu orayyta, havo chamshin yomin shelemin, yome velele kedka yeot, delet yom belo layla, velet layla belo yom, velayla veyom ikre yom echad. vechevan deazlu chamshin yomin shelemin, keden (lekabbel 50 deyovla vechamma) sharu alayyhu innun 50 yomin deyovla, umissitra deyovla ityeyhiv lehu orayyta, uvegin kach azlin yoma velelya.

Veamar ribbi abba, ketiv (Bereshit 27:1) vayhi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav, amay. ha okimna, man derachim lachayyayva, hachi hu. veta chaze, beyitzchak itkelil lelya, velelya lo bahir, veal da vattichhena enav, vecholla chad.

Rabbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Shemot 14:5) vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim ki barach haam, vayyuggad, man kaamar leh. ella, ha ukemuha. aval chachmoy vecharshoy itkenashu legabbeh, veoduhu ki barach haam. vaamay kamru da. ella chamu bechachmeta dilhon, dahavo azle yemama velelya, amru vadday arkin innun. velo od ella dechamu dela havo azle beorach meshar, kema dichtiv veyyashuvu veyyachanu lifne pi hachirot.
Zohar, Beshalach 7: (Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ribbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behon, leitdabbeka behu, mikkol shear ammin dealma, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kariv lon legabbeh, veyahav lon orayyta, veyahav lon shabbat, deihu kaddisha mikkol shear yomin, venayycha mikkolla, vechedva decholla, veshakil shabbat, lokovel orayyta kella, uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg, innuga decholla, innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain. vekarata lashshabbat, may vekarata. deyazmin leh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh, kelomar, zeminin, kema dimzammin ushepiza leveteh. veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg, deyazmin leh, kema dimzamnin ushepiza, befatora metakkena, beveta metakkena kedka yeot, bemechla uvemishteya kedka yeot, yattir al shear yomin. vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom. (emor 22 amud alef) likdosh Adonai mechubbad: da yom kippurim. tere deinnun chad. vechibbadto measot derachecha, kema deokimna.
Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, veha ittemar, begin dehahi milla salleka, veittear milla dechol leella. man dimzammin ushepiza, beh bae leishtaddela, vela baochora.

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash, salleka veittear itaruta leella, i letav, i levish. uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta, asir leh leitteara milla (43 2) dechol, deha pagim pegimu beyoma kaddisha. man deyativ behillula demalka, la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka, veyitassek beachara.
Uvechol yoma bae leachazaa ovada, uleitara ataruta mimma deitzterich. uveshabbat, bemille dishmayya, uvikdushsha deyoma bae leitteara, vela bemilla achara.

Ta chaze, hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael, behahi zimna, la bae kudesha berich hu, deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal, deha itaruta leella hu, deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leella, uzechuta dilhon kaim kameh, (veattearu itaruta da) vela baa kudesha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal. (deha beatrah leella hava) hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. tacharishun vadday, vela titarun milla, dela itzterich lechu, vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvavn reshiman, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, vadday tannina, Adonai, bechol atar rachame, veaf al gav deaggach kerava, veavid dina, hahu dina birchimuta hu. vehacha chamena, dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem, vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal, deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad.

Amar leh, milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar, deafillu hacha dina berachame hava, dechafa alehon yamma umitu, ulevatar appik lon yamma, vekudesha berich hu baa bikarehon, veitkevaru beara, vela baat ara lekabbela lon, ad deoshit lah kudesha berich hu yemineh, vekabbilat lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. uvegin da, (hava) hay dina berachame hava.

Veal da, la baa kudesha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma, dei yitarun yisrael milla, la yitarun shema derachame, vela yitavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun, dela titarun midi. deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayyhu, lemebad dina berachame. veal da bae, dela taavdun pegimu, vetitarun milla achara.

Amar leh, veha ketiv, (zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem. i hachi da dina berachame hava. amar leh, hachi hava vadday, dina hu berachame, demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma, ella chas alayyhu kudesha berich hu, dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma, dekatilu lon, ella benachat belo tzaara, ha dina berachame ihu.

Uvechol atar, shema da, dina berachame ihu, bar atar chad, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze vegomer. vechi kagibbor velo gibbor. ella yeshanne levushoy, veyilbash levushin acharanin. keish milchamot, yeshanne zineh.

Veim kol da, dina hu yattir, aval rachame beh, kema dichtiv, kagibbor, velo gibbor. keish milchamot, velo ish milchamot. devadday af al gav deavid dina, chas al ovadoy, veal da, Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.
