Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Kirvu. lammakom sheheanan yered:
ohc: Vayyomer moshe el aharon. pasuk ze efshar shehaya beyom rishon atzmo sheddibber alehem "erev vidatem". o efshar shehaya lemochorato, uma sheamar lahem "erev vidatem" eno chozer al erev shel oto yom, ella erev shel zeman sheyyitten Adonai lahem, keamro "betet Adonai" vegomer, uleappuke boker.

rashi: Hammarbe vehammamit. yesh shellaktu harebe veyesh shellaktu meat, ucheshebbau levetam maddu vaomer ish ish ma shellaktu, umatzu shehammarbe lilkot lo hedif al omer laggulgolet asher beoholo, vehammamit lilkot lo matza chaser meomer laggulgolet; vezehu nes gadol shennaasa bo:
Vayyassev. hesibbam min hadderech happeshuta ladderech haakuma:
Yam sof. kemo leyam suf, vesuf hu leshon agam sheggedelim bo kanim, kemo "vattasem bassuf" (Shemot 2), "kane vasuf kamelu" (Yeshayahu 19):

Vachamushim. en chamushim ella mezuyyanim; (lefi shehesibban bammidbar hu garam lahem shealu chamushim, sheillu hesibban derech yishshuv, lo hayu mechummashim lahem kol ma shetztzerichin, ella keadam sheover mimmakom lemakom uvedato liknot sham ma sheyyitztarech, aval keshehu poresh lammidbar tzarich lezammen lo kol hatztzorech; umikra ze lo nichtav ki im lesabber et haozen, shello titma bemilchemet amalek uvemilchemet sichon veog umidyan mehechan hayu lahem kele zayin shehikku otam bacherev) vechen hu omer "veattem taavru chamushim" (Yehoshua 1), vechen tirgemo unkelos "mezarzin", kemo "vayyarek et chanichav" (Bereshit 14) – vezarez. davar acher, chamushim echad mechamishsha yatzu vearbaa chalakim metu bishloshet yeme afela (mechilta):
ohc: Vachamushim alu vegomer. veulay ki zulat heyotam mezuyyanim bichle zayin lo yoil ma sheyyassev Adonai otam leval yachzeru birotam milchama, ki al kol panim yashuvu mitzrayma kevan sheen beyadam kele zayin laaroch im oyev milchama veyiru atzman avudim. laze amar vachamushim alu vegomer, perush millevad taam sheyyassev Adonai hayu lahem gam ken kele zayin, uvehitztarfut shene hatteamim lo yinnachem haam birotam milchama vegomer:

rashi: Nehalta. leshon menahel, veunkelos tirgem leshon nose vesovel, velo dikdek lefaresh achar leshon haivrit:
Vayyikra shemo. shel mizbeach:
Adonai nissi. hakkabba asa lanu kan nes. lo shehammizbeach karuy Adonai, ella hammazkir shemo shel mizbeach zocher et hannes sheasa hammakom – Adonai hu nes shellanu:

ohc: Vaydabber vegomer lemor shamati vegomer dabber vegomer. kashe lamma amar tevat lemor befasuk rishon, velo hispik bema sheamar achar kach "dabber el bene yisrael", veim nitkavven sheggam perat ze sheamar lo "shamati et telunot" vegomer yomrennu leyisrael, im ken lamma hutzerach lomar od achar kach "dabber"?

Venire lomar al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yoma 4,1) sheamru shekkol haomer davar lachavero hare hu beval tomar ad sheyyomar lo lemor, vehinne kesheddibber Adonai lemoshe veamar lo shamati vegomer hem divre Adonai lemoshe, veinyan ze hu beval tomar, laze amar lo Adonai lemor. vehinne en hechreach baze shechayyav lomar ella reshut hu shemmarshehu lomar lishlol bal tomar, vehaddavar beyado lehodia devar Adonai ze alehem, uchesheratza Adonai sheyyedabber elav devarim shennogim leyisrael, amar "dabber el bene yisrael" ki mikkan vaelach hem devarim sheani mechayyevcha ledabberam, velaze timtza sheshshinna Adonai et devaro, ki mikkodem dibber derech nistar al yisrael keillu medabber devarim beno leven moshe ella shehirshahu lesapper leyisrael. uchesheyyomar leyisrael tzarich ledabber lahem al ze hadderech ki Adonai amar lemoshe sheshshama telunot bene yisrael, lo shehushelach meAdonai lomar lahem mishshemo sheshshama vegomer, umaamar sheni amar elav dabber el bene yisrael mishshemi bishlichut, "ben haarbayim tochlu". vetaam shehutzrach lomar tevat "lemor", nitkavven sheyyomar lahem mishshemo yitbarach. veze shiur hakkatuv, dabber el bene yisrael sheani omer lahem baerev tochlu vegomer, vehu amro lemor, umeshammeshet tevat "lemor" bimkom ko amar Adonai. gam baze yutzdak gemar haddevarim sheamar ani Adonai elohechem, vezulat "lemor" yishshama haddavar shechas veshalom al moshe.

rashi: Amar oyev. leammo, kesheppittam bidvarim, erdof veassigem vaachallek shalal im saray vaavaday:

Timlaemo. titmmale mehem, nafshi ruchi uretzoni. veal titma al teva hamedabberet bishtayim, timlaemo – timmale mehem, yesh harebe ballashon hazze "ki eretz hannegev netattani" (Shoftim 1:15), kemo natatta li, "velo yachlu dabbero leshalom" (Bereshit 37:4), kemo dabber immo, "banay yetzauni" (Yirmeyahu 10:20), kemo yatzu mimmenni, "mispar tzeaday agidennu" (Iyov 31:37), kemo aggid lo, af kan "timlaemo" – timmale nafshi mehem:

Arik charbi. eshlof, veal shem shehu merik et hattaar bishlifato venishar rek, nofel bo leshon haraka, kemo "merikim sakkehem" (Bereshit 42:35), "vechelav yariku" (Yirmeyahu 48:12). veal tomar en leshon rekut nofel al hayyotze, ella al hattik veal hassak veal hakkeli sheyyatza mimmenna, aval lo al hacherev veal hayyayin, velidchok ulefaresh "arik charbi" kilshon "vayyarek et chanichav" (Bereshit 14:14), ezdayyen becharbi, matzinu hallashon musav af al hayyotze, "shemen turak" (Shir HaShirim 1:3), "velo hurak mikkeli el keli" (Yirmeyahu 48:11), lo hurak hakkeli en ketiv kan ella lo hurak hayyayin mikkeli el keli, matzinu hallashon musav al hayyayin, vechen "veheriku charvotam al yefi chachmatecha", dechiram (Yechezkel 28:7):
Torishemo. leshon reshut vedallut, kemo "morish umaashir" (Shmuel 1 2):
ohc: Amar oyev vegomer. taam lachazarat devarim ellu, vehem atzman sheamru bitchillat hashshira "markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam" vegomer, nitkavvenu leshorer al ofen seder hammaase shennitchakkem Adonai asot bimlechet hayyam leyisrael lenes, vetzivva Adonai sheyyaamod hannes keshurato ucheminhago laoyev, shebbaze taa vechashav lirdof ki yassig vichallek shalal, shezzulat ze lo haya rodef derech yam velo hayu muvetachim mimmennu.

Achallek shalal. hinne harasha chashav asot shelosha devarim: 1 shave bechullan vehu lishlol kol shelalam, vehu amro "achallek shalal". 2 sheyyikkach otam laavadim kevarishona, vehu amro timlaemo nafshi, perush titmalle nafshi mehem kesheechzor lichbosh otam laavadim. gam ramaz sheyyosif laasot bahem cheftzo beinnuy yoter mimma sheavar. 3 laharog moshe veaharon veziknehem ugedolehem, vehu amro arik charbi vegomer, veamro torishemo yadi yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1,lo) befasuk (Shemot 2:15) "vayvakkesh laharog et moshe" shebbikkesh lehargo besayif velo shalta bo vechulei, vehu sheamar moshe (Shemot 18:4) "vayyatztzileni mecherev paro", laze amar oyev "torishemo yadi" ki tassig yado ma shello hissig mikkodem.

rashi: Shachu raim lifne tovim. leatid:
targum: Nefalu vishe kodam tave verashie nitdun betaraya detzadike:

rashi: Im shamoa tishma. zo kabbala sheyyekabbelu alehem:
Taase. hi asiyya:
Vehaazanta. tatte aznayim ledakdek bahem:

Kol chukkav. devarim sheenan ella gezerat melech, belo shum taam, veyetzer hara mekanter alehem: ma issur beellu? lamma neesru? kegon levishat kilayim vaachilat chazir ufara adumma vechayyotze vahem (yoma 67):

Lo asim alecha. veim asim hare hu kelo husema, ki ani Adonai rofecha – zehu midrasho. ulefi feshuto ki ani Adonai rofecha umelammedcha tora umitzvot lemaan tinnatzel mehem, karofe hazze haomer laadam, al tochal davar ze pen yeviacha lide choli ze, vechen hu omer "rifut tehi lesharecha" (Mishlei 3):
ohc: Im shamoa vegomer. perush im shamoa lechok umishpat asher sam kaamur besamuch, tizku lishmoa bekol Adonai, perush mimmennu yitbarach, al derech amro (Devarim 4:33) "hashama am kol elohim" vegomer, umevasserem sheyyizku lema shezzachu achar kach, vaAdonai natan lahem shabbat vedinim kodem (sanhedrin 56:) lenassotam im yishmeu lemitzvot ellu yetzavve hattora kullah, vehu amro lemala vesham nissahu, perush, im yaamod bekabbalat hattora.

Vetimtza shekkan ramaz hakkatuv arba mitzvot: lilmod ulelammed, lishmor velaasot. keneged lilmod amar im shamoa vegomer bekol Adonai – zo talmud tora, vechafal hashshemia lattaam hannizkar, gam lirmoz lahem sheyyihye esek hattora becheshek gadol, shehagam sheodennu lomed yitavve lilmod od, veze yaggid sheeno savea vekatz belimmudo. ucheneged lelammed amar vehayyashar beenav taase, al derech amram zichronam livracha (nedarim 37,1) ma ani bechinnam af atta bechinnam, veshiur haddevarim hu al ze hadderech: vehayyashar beenav yitbarach laasot hu im beruav, shennatan lahem hattora bechinnam – taase gam ken atta. ucheneged mitzvot ase amar vehaazanta lemitzvotav, ucheneged mitzvot lo taase amar veshamarta kol chukkav – leshon shemira hatztzodeket al lo taase.

Asher samti vegomer. taam shepperat lomar "asher" vegomer, nitkavven leval yomru ki eno mavtiach ella shello lehavi alehem machala, aval im baa lezulat, bahade hutza lake kerava veen kan havetacha, laze amar "asher samti bemitzrayim", ulechu ureu maase mitzrayim, shehagam shehevi Adonai kamma machalot haya Adonai magbil lammakka leval tigga bahem, ha lamadta sheafillu bishat charon af yafli Adonai lahem chasdo veyatztzilem Adonai.

Ki ani Adonai rofecha. perush, letzad cholaim sheenam bide shamayim, keamram zichronam livracha (ketuvot 30,1) hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim ufachim. laze amar ki ani Adonai rofecha, perush, hagam sheyyikre lecha mikre mehem, ani erpaacha mehem.

rashi: Vehaya mishne. layyom velammochorat:

Mishne. al shehayu regilim lilkot yom yom shel shear yemot hashshavua; omer ani "asher yaviu vehaya mishne" – leachar sheyyaviu, yimtzeu mishne bammedida al asher yilketu veyamoddu yom yom, vezehu laktu lechem mishne – bilkitato haya nimtza lechem mishne. vezehu al ken hu noten lachem bayyom hashshishshi lechem yomayim – noten lachem beracha, paveyshen, babbayit lemallot haomer paamayim lelechem yomayim:
ohc: Vehechinu et asher yaviu. perush, ki hahavaa atzmah bichlal hahachana, utzerichin lahachinah miyyom shishshi, kede shello yaviu beshabbat, vehu maamar moshe leyisrael (Shemot 16:29) "al yetze ish mimmekomo" vegomer.

rashi: Elon betzaanannim. (targum:) meshar agnayya, mekom meshar shel betzaim, 650 belaaz vehu agnayya gevim, kemin gumot shehammayim nikbatzim sham, 'agne deara mikron (kiddushin 61 1):
targum: Vechever shalmaa itparash mishalmae mibbene chovav chamuhi demoshe ufarseh lemashkeneh ad meshar agnaya deim kedesh:

rashi: Merim ivvelet. mafrishah lechelko:
targum: Man dingida rucheh sagia veyuneh uman decharya rucheh masge shatyuta:

rashi: Bacharoshet haggoyim. shem ir, al shem shehayta chazaka vesholetet:
targum: Umesarnun Adonai beyad yavin malka dichnaan di melach bechatzor verav chele sisra vehu yatev bitkof kerakke ammaya:

rashi: Vayyillonu. lefi shekkala hallechem:
ohc: Vayyillonu vegomer bammidbar. perush, ki telunatam hayta al haviam derech midbar, ki yadua haya derech eretz kenaan ki yeshno levad derech ze, vezo telunatam shehevium derech midbar. vehaddavar haya meet Adonai lesibbot atzumot yeduot, veyisrael chashvu ki moshe hu shennitchakkem lahaviam derech ze lesibba yedua.

rashi: Mi yitten mutenu. shennamut; veeno shem davar kemo mitatenu, ella kemo asotenu chanotenu shuvenu, laasot anachnu, lachanot anachnu, lamut anachnu. targumo levay demitna, "lu matnu" (Bamidbar 14, 2) — halevay vehayinu metim:
ohc: Beyad Adonai beeretz mitzrayim. perush, ki im hayu bemitzrayim vehayu memaanim latzet, ma haya haddavar? hayu metim haruge Adonai, laze amru ki hem bocharim shehaya Adonai memitam beeretz mitzrayim al meunam, velo yodu latzet, veyamutu baraav, al derech amro (Eicha 4:9) "tovim hayu challe cherev mechalle raav".

Beshivtenu al sir vegomer. mikkan atta lamed ki medabbere lashon hara ze hem otam shello hayu alehem ol sivlot mitzrayim vehem hashshotrim, ki hammeunnim sovle ol haggalut lachma anya achlu bemitzrayim. veulay shehem harshumim beresha, hu datan vaaviram.
Beshivtenu al vegomer. perush, uveemtzaut habbasar hayu ochlim lechem lasova, ki haya lahem habbasar lelappet bo et happat.

O yirtze, ki millevad shekkevar achlu lechem, perush, seudatam, hayu mosifin leechol basar al hassova. veulay sheddikdeku beamram al sir vegomer, velo amru "beachlenu basar" vegomer, lirmoz ki lo hayu ochlim shennitbashshel veshaha, ki ze yippagem tamo, ella shehayu yoshvim al hassir leachlo beet gemar bishshulo. veramzu lo bedivrehem ki hagam sheyyomar lahem shachatu mimmiknechem veichlu basar, ze lo yaspik bitmidut kaasher hayu regilim leechol tamid lechem uvasar.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv lema shekkadam lomar "kol adat bene yisrael", min hassetam lo tihye kol haeda begeder shave bitlunatam neged Adonai veneged nevio, velaze rasham Adonai shete teanot keneged shete kittot shehayu beyisrael, achat tovaat basar veachat tovaat lechem, vehu amro beshivtenu al sir habbasar – zo kat happaritzim shebbahem, vehitchil hakkatuv bidvarim ellu ki bakkalkala matchilin min hatztzad, veachar kach amar "beachlenu lechem lasova" keneged hattovim lechem leechol, ki hayu roim atzman beeretz lo avar bah ish velo hayu moshlim berucham lehametin ad sheyyitten lahem rabbam menatam.

rashi: Beruach kadim azza. beruach kadim shehi azza shebbaruchot, hi haruach shehakkabba nifra bah min harshaim, shenneemar, "keruach kadim afitzem" (yirmeya 18), "yavo kadim ruach Adonai" (Hoshea 13), "ruach hakkadim shevarech belev yammim" (Yechezkel 27), "haga berucho hakkasha beyom kadim" (yeshaya 27):
Vayyibbaku hammayim. kol mayim shebbaolam:
ohc: Vayyet moshe et yado vegomer. hagam sheamar hakkatuv "vayyolech Adonai vegomer vayyasem et hayyam lecharava", lo sam lecharava ella mayim haamukim, kede shello yibbaku kol me hayyam veyitztarchu yisrael laredet lammaamakkim veyaarichu bahalicha uvigia, velaze hikdim ruach kadim lehakepot imke hammayim, vehu amro (Shemot 15:8) "kafu tehomot belev yam", vechelek shello nikpa nivka, veim lo haya taam ze lo haya tzarich leruach kadim.

Veyesh ladaat ematay hayta netiyyat yado shel moshe, im bitchillat hallayla im besofo. vehinne mishshetach hakkatuv muchach ki kodem habboker hayta, vekashe deim ken en hekker likriat yam suf shehayta al yede moshe. al ken muchrach lomar shepperush hakkatuv hu "vayyet moshe" vegomer, uchevar holich Adonai vegomer vayyasem et hayyam lecharava, velaze keshennata yado baku hammayim, uchefi ze techef lintiyyat yado nivka hayyam. veze mechuvvan lema shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 14:15) "ma titzak elay" shello nata yado ella achar nesiat yisrael, vetechef lichnisat yisrael layyam nata yado uvaku. vechen hu berabbot (Shemot Rabba 21) veze leshono: miyyad kevan sheherim moshe yado al hayyam nivka, ad kan. o yirtze amro vayyasem et hayyam lecharava, perush kol me hayyam nigledu, uvintiyyat yad moshe nivkeu hammayim haggeludim keshiur shello yitztarchu laredet leimke yam, uleolam ruach kadim sam kol me hayyam lecharava. verishon ikkar.
Kol hallayla. perush, ad sof hallayla, veaz nikra hayyam veyardu yisrael beashmoret habboker.

rashi: Ufaro hikriv. haya lo lichtov ufaro karav, mahu hikriv? hikriv atzmo venitammetz lekaddem lifnehem kemo shehitna immahem:
Nosea acharehem. belev echad keish echad. davar acher – vehinne mitzrayim nosea acharehem, rau sar shel mitzrayim nosea min hashshamayim laazor lammitzrim; – tanchuma:
Vayyitzaku. tafsu ummanut avotam – beavraham hu omer "el hammakom asher amad sham" (Bereshit 19), beyitzchak "lasuach bassade", (sham 24), beyaakov "vayyifga bammakom" (sham 28):
ohc: Ufaro hikriv vegomer vehinne mitzrayim vegomer. tzarich ledakdek lamma hutzrach lomar ze velo hispik ma shekkadam lomar "vayyassigu otam" vegomer? veamar od "vehinne mitzrayim nosea" vegomer, gam lamma hitchil hassibba befaro vegamar omer bemitzrayim, dichtiv "vehinne mitzrayim", shehaya lo lomar "vehinne paro" vegomer? od tzarich ledakdek amro nosea leshon yachid vegomer al mitzrayim shehem rabbim.

Ulehavin hakkatuv yesh lehair heara gedola bedivre bene yisrael el moshe "hamibbeli en kevarim vegomer ma zot asita lanu" vegomer, kenishma shehaddavar lahem chadash, veen ze emet, ki kevar hodiam Adonai ki yechazzek libbo lirdof lehikkaved bo, veheiram baze bammaase asher tzivva lahem asot sheyyashuvu veyachanu vegomer kede sheyyite lirdof acharehem, vayyaasu chen, hare hechinu atzmam lehateoto lirdof acharehem, im ken minnayin nichnas lahem happachad? lu yehi sherau shebba bechoach gadol shesh meot rechev vegomer, asher efshar ki lo chashvu mikkodem shehayu lahem kol kach chozek, af al pi chen kevar hivticham Adonai ki hu hamechazzek libbo lehikkaved bo vehem siyyeu baddavar.

Achen yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 21,5) sheamru veze leshonam: "umitzrayim nosea acharehem" – ze sar shel mitzrayim, mitzrayim shemo, ad kan leshonam. vehinne hammalach hallaz ba immahem, ki chen hu hannahug shehassar yaazor leummato veyippol binfilatah, vetze ulemad mimmaase alekkesanderus mukedon (yoma 69:) shehaya nidme lo saro bammilchamot. vehinne min hassetam ki hassar yihye omed limin hammelech, lo lifne haam, vehinne misseder haragil bammilchamot shehammelech benehem – shehaam yakdimu kodem lammelech vehammelech levassof mehaam. vechan hodia hakkatuv haddavar shemmimmennu baa hahargasha leyisrael liro ulefached, hagam shekkadam lahem ma shekkadam mehayedia, veamar ufaro hikriv, perush, lo asa seder haragil lehakedim haam ella hikriv atzmo kodem laam. vayyisu vene yisrael et enehem vehinne mitzrayim, perush, sar shel mitzrayim kannizkar. perush, letzad shepparo hikriv vehassar haya lefanav omed, ze haya sibba lirot yisrael hassar sheshshemo mitzrayim nosea vegomer, vehem lo yuchelu daat sibbat hassar sheeno ella laamod lifne melech kannahug, ki en minhag hammelech lehakedim lammachane, vehem rau hassar nosea acharehem, perush, kodem hammachane. laze raashu ki chashvu ki sare mala bau laaroch immam milchama, vahagam shekkadam lahem ma shekkadam lo hispik lahem kesherau malachim bau lehillachem immahem, ki hu ot ki Adonai chazar mimmachashavto hattova, ki zulat ze lo haya maskim al malacho lavo kenegdam, velaze tzaaku vegomer. veillu lo haya paro makdim, o im haya seder haragil sheyyakdim hammelech, hem hayu tolim haddavar ki lo lemilchama ba ella laamod lifne hammelech kechok sare mala im kol melachim asher hem memunnim alehem, velo hayu mefachadim. uvaze nityashshev hainyan veyishshuv hakketuvim.

Vetaam shello mana Adonai hammalach mibbo, lishne teamim: haechad, kede lehargo lifnehem, keamro "vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam", veamru zichronam livracha (zohar 10 52:) sheyyechavven al hassar sheshshemo mitzrayim. vetaam sheni, elohim chashavah letova kede sheyyifchadu veyachzeru bitshuva shelema vikarvu libbam lashshamayim, kede shebbeemtzaut ze yaase Adonai lahem hannes heatzum shel keriat yam suf, vedavar ze lo huvtechu bo kodem. vetimtza sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 21,5) betevat "hikriv" velo amar "karav", yirtze shehikriv libban shel yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim, vechen haya dichtiv vayyitzaku vene yisrael el Adonai:

rashi: Vattaal shichvat hattal vegomer. keshehachamma zorachat, ole hattal sheal hamman likrat hachamma, kederech tal ole likrat hachamma; af im temalle shefoferet shel betza tal vetistom et piha vetannichah vachamma hi ola meeleha baavir. verabbotenu darshu, shehattal ole min haaretz baavir, vechaalot shichvat hattal nitgalla hamman verau vehinne al pene hammidbar vegomer:
Dak – davar dak:

Mechuspas. megulle, veen dome lo bammikra. veyesh lomar mechuspas leshon chafisa udelusekma shebbilshon mishna, keshennitgalla mishshichvat hattal rau shehaya davar dak mechuspas betocho ben shete shichvot hattal. veunkelos tirgem "mekallaf", leshon machsof hallavan:

Kakkefor. kefor yylaydaa velaaz, daadak kegir, "keavne gir" (Yeshayahu 27), vehu min tzeva shachor, kidamrinan gabbe kissuy haddam "haggir vehazzarnich" (chullin 88). "dadak kegir kiglida al ara" – dak haya kegir veshochev muglad kekerach al haaretz, vechen perusho: dak kakkefor – shatuach, kalush umechubbar kiglid. dak 371 belaaz, shehaya maglid geled dak milmala; "uchegir" shettirgem unkelos tosefet hu al leshon haivrit veen lo teva bappasuk:

Et asher tofu efu. ma sheattem rotzim leefot battannur, efu hayyom hakkol lishne yamim, uma sheattem tzerichim levashshel mimmennu bammayim, bashshelu hayyom. leshon afiyya nofel belechem uleshon bishshul betavshil:
Lemishmeret. ligniza:
Veyashuvu. laachorehem, letzad mitzrayim hayu mekarvin kol yom hashshelishi, kede lehateot et paro sheyyomar toim hem badderech, kemo shenneemar "veamar paro livne yisrael vegomer":
Veyachanu lifne pi hachirot. hu pitom, veachshav nikra pi hachirot al shem shennaasu sham bene chorin; vehem shene selaim gevohim zekufim vehaggay shebbenehem karuy pi hasselaim:
Lifne baal tzefon. hu nishar mikkol elohe mitzrayim kede lehateotan, sheyyomru kasha yiratan, vealav peresh iyyov "masgi laggoyim vayabbedem" (Iyov 12):
ohc: Dabber vegomer veyashuvu vegomer. hinne kol roe yikhe baze lamma yitztarech Adonai lehaarim chas veshalom al haddavar, vehu aso yaase kol asher yachpotz belev paro lirdof?

Achen behasekil bema shekkadam lanu bidiat middat habbore ki chafetz lemaan tzaddek yisrael, halo ze haddavar asher dibber Adonai bemitzva zo shennitchakkem leval yikkashlu behacheasa labbore veyomru divre niutz sheamru achar kach (Shemot 14:11) "hamibbeli en kevarim vegomer halo vegomer tov lanu avod et mitzrayim" vegomer. venitchakkem Adonai veasa davar murgash umukkar lahem ki Adonai yaatz al paro raa umitchakkem elav lehotzio mimmitzrayim lirdof et yisrael lehikkaved bo. umeatta en makom leyisrael lachush lefaro, veadrabba yachilu derachav lirot nikmatam bo, velo hispik labbore lomar lahem haddevarim bappe levad ki hu yechazzek lev paro lirdof acharehem ki lo yaasu haddevarim bahem roshem, uvirot oto yirashu veyittenu rosh lashuv elav mimmorao alehem. laze tzivva Adonai sheyyashuvu veyachanu veyaasu maase hammuchan lirdof paro acharehem, vedavar ze yargishem veyaase bahem roshem ki hem hem haosim hachana beharegasha reusha shechazru laachorehem velachanot bemakom meyuchad shemmimmennu yite paro lirdof otam, uvaze lo yifchad libbam, uvevoo yagel yaakov yismach yisrael ki yecheze nakam beoyvo. vetimtza sheaf al pi chen lo hoil behechlet. vetze ulemad ma sheamru biroto, umizze takkish ma hayu osim zulat hachazara, vehaven.

rashi: Bachur. nivcharim, bachur leshon yachid, kol rechev varechev shebbeminyan ze haya bachur:

Vechol rechev mitzrayim. veimmahem kol shear harechev; umehechan hayu habbehemot hallalu? im tomar mishshel mitzrayim, hare neemar "vayyamat kol mikne mitzrayim" (Shemot 9), veim mishshel yisrael, vahalo neemar "vegam miknenu yelech immanu", mishshel mi hayu? min hayyare et devar Adonai. mikkan haya Rabbi shimon omer, kasher shebbammitzrim harog, tov shebbannechashim retzotz et mocho (mechilta):
Veshalishim al kullo. sare tzevaot, ketargumo:
Vide moshe kevedim. bishvil shennitatztzel bammitzva uminna acher tachtav, nityakkeru yadav:
Vayyikchu. aharon vechur:
Even vayyasimu tachtav. velo yashav lo al kar vacheset. amar: yisrael sheruyin betzaar, af ani ehye immahem betzaar (taanit 11):
Vayhi yadav emuna. vayhi moshe yadav beemuna, perusot hashshamayim bitfilla neemana unechona:
Ad bo hashshamesh. shehayu amalekim mechashshevin et hashshaot baitzterulogia, beezo shaa hem notzchim, veheemid lahem moshe chamma veirbev et hashshaot (tanchuma):

ohc: Vayhi kedabber vegomer. perush, shehaya Adonai keyoshev umetzappe sheyyifnu elav, vetechef lidvaro nira kevod Adonai beanan.

rashi: Tachat tomer. temarim hayu lah biricho:

Ben harama uven bet el behar efrayim. lefi targumo shel yonatan yesh lilmod sheen mikra ze kemashmao, veen ellu simane mekom yeshivatah, ella lamadnu sheishsha ashira hayta umin hammekomot haellu hayta parnasatah, vehi yoshevet beirah, atarot shemah:

Tachat tomer. temarim hayu lah biricho, ucheramim barama, vezetim bevikat bet el, shehu mekom shamen, veafar chivvar behar efrayim, (targum:) 'betur malka, omer ani shemmochrin otah leyotzre cheres. veyesh potrin: 'afar chivvar, sede zera, kemo (mishna sheviit 2:1): sede hallavan:
targum: Vehi yatva bekarta baatarot devora mitparnesa min dilah vela diklin biricho pardesin beramata zetin avdin meshach bevikata bet shakya bevet el afar chivar betur malka vesalkin levatah vene yisrael ledina:

rashi: Veamar paro. kesheyyishma shehem shavim laachorehem:
Livne yisrael. al bene yisrael. vechen (pasuk yad) "Adonai yillachem lachem" – alechem, (Bereshit 20 13) "imri li achi hu" – imri alay:
Nevuchim hem. keluim umeshukkaim, uvelaaz 720, kemo "nivche yam" (Iyov 38), "beemek habbacha" (Tehillim 84) "mibbechi neharot" (Iyov 28).
Nevuchim hem, keluim hem bammidbar, sheenan yodin latzet mimmennu ulehechan yelechu:
ohc: Veamar paro vegomer. perush, kesheyyashuv hammaggid hu yodio kol asher rau enav:

rashi: Laktu lechem mishne. keshemmaddu et lekitatam beoholehem matzu chiflayim, shene haomer laechad. umidrash aggada: lechem mishne – meshunne, oto hayyom nishtanna leshevach berecho vetamo (sham):

Vayyaggidu lemoshe. shealuhu ma hayyom miyyomayim; umikkan yesh lilmod sheadayin lo higgid lahem moshe parashat shabbat shennitztavva lomar lahem vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu vegomer, ad sheshshaalu ma zot, amar lahem hu asher dibber Adonai shennitztavveti lomar lachem, velchach anasho hakkatuv sheamar lo ad ana meantem, velo hotzio min hakkelal:
ohc: Vayyaggidu lemoshe vegomer. mikkan mashma shello hodiam kodem devar Adonai. vekashe, ech yichbosh chas veshalom nevuato, velimmedunu rabbotenu (sanhedrin 89,1) din navi hakkovesh nevuato vechulei chas veshalom, uma gam behaggadat mitzva lekayyem yisrael retzon hammelech sheyyesh baze shete bechinot: kovesh nevua vaakirat hammitzva. veen lomar ki chas veshalom shachach mitzvat Adonai, im ken nachush lo gam ken sheshshachach mimma shennitztavva vaadayin shachuach chas veshalom, uma gam shello haya lo leakkev zeman ma lishshachach vetechef umiyyad haya lo lehaggid nevuato, vegam kushya lelohenu lamma lo hizkiro kesheyyada bo sheshshachach, beotah shaa atzmah haya lo lehazekiro velo haya mannicho shachuach ad shiva yamim shehuzekar meatzmo.

Achen moshe rabbenu tamo venimmuko immo, uvemetek leshono heshiv teshuva kiri mutzak (Iyov 37:18) beamro hu asher dibber Adonai shabbaton shabbat vegomer. kan benoam devarav hishmit tevat "lemor", ramaz ki lo dibber lo Adonai lemor lahem, vaasher al ken haddavar beval tomar kemaamaram zichronam livracha (yoma 4,1) uchetavnuhu befasuk (Shemot 16:11) "vaydabber vegomer shamati" vegomer, veze hu tamo shello hodiam kodem. vehaed hanneeman ledivre moshe Adonai meido benosach hannevua kesheamar lo (Shemot 16:5) "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi" vegomer timtza shello amar lo Adonai sham "dabber el bene yisrael" velo tevat "lemor", hare satam haddavar befanav sheen lo shelichut bemitzva zo leyisrael, vehu sheamar hu achar maase shellaktu lechem mishne uvau lefanav, gilla lahem haddavar veamar lahem shello haya etzlo ella bederech sod nimseru lo haddevarim velo leamram.
Veyesh lanu latet lev kefi ze, mi hittir lo lemor lahem kol mitzvot haamurot bidvarav, shello neemar lo "dabber" velo "lemor"?

Venire ki nitchakkem moshe bachakirat chacham lamma lo ratza Adonai sheyyomar haddevarim leyisrael, vehiskil ki tamo hu shechafetz Adonai lintoa bahem neta emunat vehatzedakat mitzvat shabbat shettihye kabbalatah vidiatah mimmennu el elyon shello al yede shaliach techilla, ella kesheyyetzu lilkot keminhagam shiur haragil leyomo veyamoddu veyimtzeu pi shenayim meharagil yom yom, yiru reiyya chushiyyit vesichliyyit ki Adonai metzavve lahem leval yitrechu beyom shabbat umazmin lahem miyyom shishshi tzorech yom shevii, kede shebbaze tihye mitzva zo etzlam mekubbelet betosefet kabbalat haratzon umora gadol meavor aleha letzad shemmaalatah gedola, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 25,11) shakul shabbat keneged kol hattora kullah, velaze lo tzivva lahem techilla al hashshabbat moshe kede shello yechavvenu leharebot ballekita veyilketu kemishpat yom yom veyease lahem hannes limtzo bechiflayim, en ze ella maase elohim asher yesichem lishmor shabbat.

Veim tomar: sof kol sof yetzavve lahem moshe al hashshabbat, veyomar lahem ki lo yilketu ella keshiur ze haragil kede lehakkir haddavar, en ze mehammusar lahavinam ki tzerichin nes lehatzedik divre moshe, laze asa Adonai devar chachma.

Veod, im haya makdim hammitzvot al yede moshe, adayin yesh makom litot, al derech ma sheamru bimnachot perek rabbi yishmael (menachot 65,1), keshennitpal rabban yochanan ben zakkay labbaytusin haarurim veamar lahem: "atzeret achar hashshabbat minnayin lachem?" ufitpet kenegdo zaken echad mehem veamar lo: "moshe ohev yisrael haya veyodea atzeret yom echad hu, amad vetikkenah achar hashshabbat kede sheyyihyu mitannegin shene yamim", ad kan. vechatvu hattosafot sham veze leshonam: amad vetikkenah, vehakkadosh baruch hu hiskim al yado, ad kan. hare ki yesh toim shehagam shettihye hammitzva mippi moshe yaskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado, im ken yesh hefresh lehakedamat yediat hammitzva minnisyon el elyon. laze lo tzivva Adonai lemoshe lemor leyisrael davar ze, umeatta achar sheyyatzta hammachshava asher chashav elohim vehikkiru yisrael haddavar techilla, amar lahem moshe hu asher dibber Adonai elay shabbaton shabbat kodesh.

Veim tomar, lamma lo hoil hahekker lehassig bo yediat shabbat, vehutzrach moshe lomar lahem haddevarim? hinne zulat divre moshe yitu veyomru ulay nigmera yeridat hamman, velaze natan lahem Adonai shello kasseder haragil. laze amar lahem moshe hu asher dibber vegomer, velo lesibba acheret, veyukkar haddavar lahem behechlet kesheyyered hamman yom echad achar hashshabbat. vehuchrach moshe lomar lahem haddevarim shehem beval tomar shello yikkashlu beoto shabbat veyetzu, ella shello amar lahem haazhara beferush kaasher avaer befasuk "ad ana meantem" (Shemot 16:28).
Betoch hayyam bayyabbasha. perush amro "betoch hayyam" – bifnimiyyuto, veamro bayyabbasha – shello haya karkait hayyam tit varefesh.
Vehammayim lahem choma vegomer. perush, ki chelek mehammayim shennechlak lo nishpach latztzedadin. veamro "miminam" lomar ki lo choma mammash shehu behekkef mehatztzedadin:

rashi: Vayyomer. moshe:

Ki yad al kes yah. yado shel hakkabba hurema lishshava bechiso lihyot lo milchama veeva vaamalek olamit, umahu kes velo neemar kisse? veaf hashshem nechelak lechetzyo? nishba hakkabba sheen shemo shalem veen kiso shalem ad sheyyimmache shemo shel amalek kullo, uchesheyyimmache shemo yihye hashshem shalem vehakkisse shalem, shenneemar "haoyev tammu choravot lanetzach" (tehillim 9), zehu amalek shekkatuv bo "veevrato shemara netzach" (Amos 1), "vearim natashta avad zichram hemma" (tehillim sham), mahu omer acharav? "vaAdonai leolam yeshev" — hare hashshem shalem, "konen lammishpat kiso" — hare kisseo shalem:
Sifte chachamim yezaru daat. yachtiru daat, kemo "zer zahav" (Shemot 25:11):
Lo chen. eno emet:
targum: Sifvateh dechakkime modin mandea velibbehon desachle la chen:

ohc: Uvene yisrael halchu vegomer. taam hodaat davar ze paam sheniyya, ulay ki yechavven lomar sheyyadu hammitzriyyim et haddavar hazze, ki yisrael avru bayyabbasha vehammayim hayu lahem choma vegomer, vehem yardu tachtiyyot aretz, uvaze yadu Adonai, kemaamaro yitbarach (Shemot 14:18) "veyadu mitzrayim" vegomer, vezulat ze lo yargishu baddavar. vetze ulemad (even Ezra Shemot 14:27) mimma shettau mehameshuggaim veamru ki moshe haya yodea shaot shebbo yitmaet hayyam vechulei, veheevir yisrael beoto et vehammitzrim lo yadu venitbeu, umofet ze yasir shigon daat zo, ki halchu bayyabbasha vehammayim choma – shene simanim ellu yaakru hachechashat hannes, veheram Adonai lannitbaim.

rashi: Vayyavo amalek vegomer. samach parasha zo lemikra ze, lomar, tamid ani venechem umezumman lechol tzarkechem veattem omrim hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin, chayyechem shehakkelev ba venoshech etchem veattem tzoakim li vetedu hechan ani? mashal leadam shehirkiv beno al ketefo veyatza ladderech, haya oto habben roe chefetz veomer, abba tol chefetz ze veten li vehu noten lo, vechen sheniyya, vechen shelishit, pagu veadam echad amar lo oto habben, raita et abba? amar lo aviv, encha yodea hechan ani? hishlicho mealav uva hakkelev uneshacho (tanchuma yitro):
ohc: Vayyavo amalek vegomer. leheyot shennitatztzelu battora shennimshela lemayim uleesh, dichtiv (yirmeya 23:29) "ko devari kaesh", velo nitasseku bemilchamtah shel tora, laze heenisham betzimmaon keneged bechinat hammayim uveesh hammilchama shel amalek.

rashi: Ateret chachamim ashram. shehem ashirim battora:
Veivvelet kesilim ivvelet. kalkaltan shel kesilim hi haivvelet, shennitatztzel min hachachma:
targum: Kelila dechakkime uterehon veshavhorhon desachle shatyutehon:

rashi: Vayyaal beraglav. immo:
targum: Uchenash barak yat shivta dizvulun veyat shivta denaftali lekedesh useliku imeh asra alfin gavra uselikat imeh devora:

rashi: Natita yemincha. keshehakkabba note yado, harshaim kalim venoflim, lefi shehakkol natun beyado venoflim behattayatah; vechen hu omer "vaAdonai yatte yado vechashal ozer venafal azur" (Yeshayahu 31), mashal lichle zechuchit hannetunim beyad adam, matte yado meat vehen noflim umishtabberin (mechilta):
Tivlaemo aretz. mikkan shezzachu likvura bischar sheamru Adonai hatztzaddik (mechilta):
ohc: Natita yemincha vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru besifra (mechilta) melammed shehaya hayyam zorkan layyabbasha vehayyabbasha layyam. amra hayyabbasha layyam: uma bemakom shello kibbalti ella damo shel hevel yachid neemar li "arura" vegomer, atta ech uchal lekabbel kol haochlusim? ad shennishba lah hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno maamidah bedin, dichtiv "natita yemincha" vegomer, ad kan. vechen tirgem yonatan ben uziel. mikkan atta roe ki lo ratza hayyam lekabbelan vehaya poltan layyabbasha, velo chen matzinu sheamru bifsachim 118, veze leshonam: amar hakkadosh baruch hu lesaro shel yam "pelot otam layyabbasha". amar lefanav: "ribbono shel olam, yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotlah mimmennu?" amar lo: "etten lecha echad umechetza" vechulei. amar lo: "yesh eved shettovea rabbo?" amar lo: "nachal kishon yihye arev". miyyad pelatan layyabbasha uvau yisrael verau otam, shenneemar "vayyar yisrael" vegomer, ad kan. hare sheamru zichronam livracha beferush shello haya hayyam chafetz lefaltan, im ken achar kach keshehecheziratam lo haadama lamma lo samach lekabbelam? gam lamma hutzrach Adonai lifroa lo mimmachane sisra, vahare shellecha lefanecha – yachazirem lo beatzman velo haya tzarich arev?

Od kashe, halo enenu root ki en hayyam sovel betocho adam uvehema ella poltan layyabbasha, shezzechurani peamim shettavu bene adam bayyam vehishlichan layyabbasha, mehem bayyom hahu mehem achar yom o yomayim, velidverehem zichronam livracha hayyam chafetz sheyyihyu omdim etzlo. veraiti lerashi verashbam sheppershu shettaanat hayyam hu letzad parnasat dege hayyam sheyyimtzeu mazon. vetzarich ladaat im ken lamma lo kibbelam keshezzerakatan hayyabbasha vehayu limzon haddagim. vehaya nire leyashshev ki az hayu seruchim veenam reuyim lemaachal dagim, veze divre dichuy ki min hassetam lo yitakkev Adonai lomar layyabbasha lekavram middin "lo talin" (Devarim 21:23), vegam en tzorech baddavar leakkev kelonam al pene haadama ella ad sheyyamutu, veachar mita ma tzorech lehitakkev belo kevura.

Vahagam sheen darkenu bechibbur ze lefaresh maamare rabbotenu zichronam livracha, im kol ze hainyan hu tzorech mashmaut hakkatuv, uchede shello nomar midrashim chalukim, nire lehateimam al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (mechilta al 14:30) vechatavnu oto befasuk "vayyar yisrael vegomer met al sefat hayyam" ki rau otam bigmar mita beodam ketzat chayyim kede sheyyakkiru veaz vechulei, ulefi divrehem ellu zarach or shene hammaamarim, ki ma sheshshaal hayyam shello yiflot otam hu letzad ki Adonai amar elav liflot otam chayyim lesibbat hannizkar lesammeach yedidav sheyyakkiru hammitzriyyim yisrael veyiru utechassem busha, kaamur bedivrehem hafelagat nes ze, vahagam shello ramuz bemaamaram ze inyan happelita shettihye beodam chayyim, af al pi chen rabbotenu zichronam livracha somchim lema sheyyadua benehem, velaze taan hayyam "yesh eved shennoten" vechulei, hakkavvana ki chafetz hu ligmor hammitzva bemachise el. vetimtza ki chol sare mala vechol berue mala umatta chafetzim vachashekim laasot mitzvot Adonai, ki hem evyonim baddavar letzad sheen lahem mitzvot, vechen timtza sham bifsachim beotah sugeya ki gavriel bikkesh meAdonai lehatztzil avraham mikkivshan haesh, veamru sham ki Adonai lo kippeach secharo veamar lo tizke vetatztzil shelosha mibbene vanav vegomer ad kan, hare ki zechut hu lammalachim laasot chesed latztzaddikim uleohave elyon, uchemo chen haya chafetz hayyam shettigmor yetziat nafsham bayyam velo bayyabbasha velaze tzaak libbo, veheshivo el elyon kederech sheasa legavriel, ki leatid yamtzi lo zechut acher leabbed am rasha chelek umechetza, vehu machane sisra shehu yaase bahem mitzvat ibbud reshaim.

Od yesh taam betaanat hayyam shehaya chafetz shettiggamer mitatam bayyam lakachat kol kochot hachiyyuniyyot shehem kol hannefashot shel haam, ki mitteva nafshot haammim laamod bimkom mitatan, keamro (Kohelet 3:19) "veruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz", vehaovde kochavim umazzalot nimshelu labbehemot, vechi tetze nafsham bayyam yizke hassar bahem livchinot hammussagot etzlo mehainyan. velaze kesheamar elav lefaltan chayyim, sheaz tihye haaretz zocha baddavar, ki konim mekoman bimkom hannachatam yordim shamma, tzaak libbo "yesh eved" vechulei ad sheanahu rabbo ki yitten lo baadam vechulei, perush bene adam chayyim kemot ellu, uferat lo bedomin leellu veshaav chiyyutam mehem shehu ikkar cheshko lo bagguf. velaze achar sheppelatam veyatzta nafsham al sefat hayyam uzerakatam haadama layyam, lo ratza lekabbelam ki eno mittivo, vehaaretz hi hamechasset al baneha asher lukkechu mimmenna, vehichrichah Adonai lekabbelam ki lah nogea haddavar.

Velo takshe ledarkenu ze mimma sheamru sham bifsachim (fesachim 118,2) ki kesheppara Adonai layyam patchu dagim shebbayyam veamru "veemet Adonai leolam" ad kan, im ken lahem nogea haddavar. veulay ki beet asher yachpotz hayyam bekabbalatam betocho, shehu bizman shehem chayyim, hayu haddagim nehenim mehem bene uvene kodem sheyyamutu, veaz yashlichem hayyam veen lahem od mehem mazon, veal zeman parnasatam amru shira.

Veraiti mi shennitatztzem betaanat hayyam "yesh eved" vechulei – halo yad eved keyad rabbo, veen baze kihuy, ki hayyam taanato nechona al derech amram (taanit ko,1): mishshamayim mehav yahave, mishkal la shakle, veal adnut adono hu omer, vechi kara mikre ze leeze eved meavde Adonai shennatan lo rabbo vechazar vechulei, velaze lo amar "yesh adon shennoten vechulei vechozer" vechulei, ki zo enah taana – yesh vayesh, veadrabba yad eved keyad rabbo, ucheillu lo natan, ella devarav hem lerabbo ki eno mitnaheg ken im avadav.

rashi: Ma tenassun. lomar hayuchal latet mayim beeretz tziyya?:
ohc: Vayyarev haam vegomer. perush, vehammeriva hu sheamru lahem bederech ze "tenu lanu mayim", vechi moshe yesh lo mayim latet lahem? en ze ella meriva, sheim hayta kavvanatam lishol ki yitzak el Adonai, haya lahem lomar kederech sheddibberu elav (Bamidbar 21:7) kesheshshalach Adonai bahem nechashim serafim. o efshar shehayu tovim hammayim kemi shettovea chov mechavero veomer lo ten li ma sheatta chayyav li, veamru leshon rabbim vedivrehem im moshe levad, kan kallu laAdonai. velaze amar lahem moshe ma terivun immadi ma tenassun et Adonai. veamar beseder ze ki beerech Adonai kevar yadu ki chol yachol, ella menassim im yesh bekirbam.

rashi: Lifnot boker. leet shehabboker pone lavo:
Leetano. letakpo harishon (mechilta):
Nasim likrato. shehayu mehummamim umetorafim veratzin likrat hammayim:
Vaynaer Adonai. keadam shemmenaer et hakkedera vehofech haelyon lematta vehattachton lemala, kach hayu olin veyordin umishtabberin bayyam, venatan hakkabba bahem chayyut lekabbel hayyissurin (sham):
Vaynaer. "veshannek", vehu leshon teruf bilshon arammi, veharebe yesh bemia:
ohc: Leetano. razal amru (Shemot Rabba 21,6) "litnao harishon". vekashe li ledivrehem, en ze mekom hattenay ella bishat hachaluka sham yizkor tenay ze. veulay ki yodia hakkatuv ki achar sheshshav, az yada shehu tenay shehitna immo Adonai, velo gezerat kilyono o haggaat tzivyono lehibbatel mehaolam. vahagam ki hattenay haya yadua lo, ulay shellirot hafelaat haddavar shennityabbesh venaasu hammayim yabbasha, vegam hammayim haomdim naasu chomot avanim, yomru ki va ad kitztzo gam ken, ucheshechazar yada ki en ze ella tenay rishon levad. vetzarich ladaat ofen hattenay, im haya leyotze mitzrayim, im ken lamma nirash bappaam hazzot kemaamaram zichrono livracha (sham) shehitris keneged moshe veamar lo: en ani nikra mippanecha sheani nivreti beyom shelishi veatta nivreta beyom shishshi" vechulei, ad shennata Adonai yemino limin moshe, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 63,12) "molich limin moshe". veod roani ki lichide segulla haya nikra beal karcho, kemaase huva bechulin (chullin 7,1) berabbi pinchas ben yair vechulei, veim lo hitna immo ella leyotze mitzrayim levad, ma kocho shel rabbi pinchas ben yair alav hashshalom lehitgabber al maase vereshit?

Achen tenay ze hu bichlal hattenaim shehitna Adonai al kol maase vereshit, lihyot kefufim lattora vaameleha, velaasot kol asher yigzeru alehem, umemshaltam alehem kememshelet habbore baruch hu. velaze timtza kemo chen bashshamayim uvaaretz uvakkochavim uvashshemesh veyareach shaltu alehem hatztzaddikim yechidim, veen tzarich lomar merubbim, kaasher chakak Adonai lahem beet habberia. vehu sod amro (Yeshayahu 43:1) "boraacha yaakov" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 36:4) sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leolamo: mi beraacha, mi yetzarcha – yisrael, vehakkol bechoach hattora. vetze ulemad ma shekkatavti befasuk bereshit.

Vehinne bitziat yisrael mimmitzrayim adayin lo kibbelu hattora, veen gezerato al hannivraim gezera, velaze lo hiskim hayyam lechalek lahem, vetaan lemoshe: atta nivreta beshishshi vaani bishlishi". ze remez ki eno ben tora, sheim haya ben tora hinne hu kodem lo, ki hattora kadma laolam kullo. velaze nitchakkem Adonai veholich yemino limin moshe, perush, herahu ki hu ben tora hammityaches lah yamin, dichtiv (Devarim 33:2) "mimino" vegomer, uchesheraahu techef umiyyad nikra kitnay harishon. velaze kol tzaddik vetzaddik sheyyaamod achar kabbalat hattora yavi beyado shetar chov echad lechofo lechalek lefanav. vetimtza shekkeshello ratza lechalek lerabbi pinchas ben yair ulehammitlavve immo, ratza lekanso, ufachad hayyam mimmennu.

Umitzrayim nasim vegomer. perush, shehagam shehayu nasim mimmennu kesherauhu sheshshav leetano, af al pi chen "likrato" perush haya hayyam ba lahem lemul makom shennasim shamma, ulechol makom shehayu nasim hayu motzim atzman sheholchim likrato, al derech omram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 110,1; Bamidbar Rabba 98) bivliat korach vaadato shehaya pe haaretz ratz acharehem lemakom sheyyaamdu shamma, ki kol hannivraim osim retzon konam bizrizut uzehirut gedola, veshiur hakkatuv ki nitgabber hayyam leetano perush letakpo venaasa kannizkar.

Vaynaer Adonai. perush, letzad sheyyesh bene adam bekiin lashut bayyam, hagam sheyyihye hayyam bechol takpo ugevurato yitchakkemu lasum bo derech, laze amar hakkatuv keneged ellu "vaynaer" vegomer, bittel mehem hakkoach hahu. uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 21) sheamru ki "mitzrayim" met hu sar shel mitzrayim, amar ki higshimo vehishlit alav geshem hammayim veniaro betoch vegomer.

rashi: Sham sham lo. bemara natan lahem miktzat parashiyyot shel tora sheyyitasseku vahem, shabbat ufara adumma vedinin (sanhedrin 56):
Vesham nissahu. laam, veraa keshi arpo, shello nimlechu vemoshe belashon yafa "bakkesh alenu rachamim sheyyihye lanu mayim lishtot" ella nitlonnu:

Vayyavou marata. kemo lemara, hei besof teva bimkom 74 bitchillatah, vehattav hi bimkom hei hannishreshet betevat mara, uvismichatah, keshehi nidbeket lahe shehu mosif bimkom hallamed, tehafech hahe shel shoresh letav; vechen kol hei shehi shoresh batteva tithappech letav bismichatah, kemo "chema en li" (Yeshayahu 27), "vachamato baara vo" (Ester 1), hare hei shel shoresh nehpechet letav mippene shennismechet el havvav hannosefet, vechen "eved veama" (Vayikra 25), "hinne amati vilha" (Bereshit 30), "lenefesh chayya" (Bereshit 2:7), "vezihamattu chayyato lachem" (Iyov 33), "ben harama" (Shoftim 4), "uteshuvato haramata" (Shmuel 1 7):
ohc: Vayyavou marata vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lifamim yikra lah marata velifamim mara. venire ki shem hammakom haya marata, vehammayan shel mayim shebbo lo haya lo shem meyuchad.

Veamar velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara, perush, mehammayan shehaya bemarata, mittaam ki marim hem. veachar kach chazar hakkatuv legallot lecha ki shem mara sheamar hu shem shennikba lammayan hahu achar shemmatzu memav marim, kerao hakkatuv al shem heatid. ulederech ze yavo al nachon amro ki marim hem, letzad shekkeriat shem mara hu al heatid veaz adayin lo nikra shemah mara, ucheillu amar "lishtot mayim mimmarata", laze hutzrach lomar ki marim hem, vehaven.

rashi: Yemincha yemincha. shene feamim, kesheyyisrael osin et retzono shel makom hassemol naaset yamin (sham):

Yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. lehatztzil et yisrael vimincha hashshenit tiratz oyev. veli nire otah yamin atzmah tiratz oyev, ma shei efshar leadam – laasot shete melachot beyad achat; ufeshuto shel mikra yemincha hanneederet bakkoach ma melachtah? yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev; vechamma mikraot dugmato, "ki hinne oyvecha Adonai ki hinne oyvecha yovedu" (tehillim 92), vedomehem:
Nedari. hayyod yetera, kemo "rabbati am, sarati bammedinot" (Eicha 1), "genuvti yom" (Bereshit 31):
Tiratz oyev. tamid hi roetzet umeshabberet haoyev; vedome lo "vayyiratzu vayrotztzu et bene yisrael", beshoftim (10, 8). (davar acher – yemincha hanneederet bakkoach hi meshabberet umalka oyev):
ohc: Yemincha Adonai vegomer. perush, keshettihye middat harachamim mitchazzeket laasot devar mishpat, vehu amro nedari bakkoach, az yemincha Adonai shehi middat harachamim atzmah tiratz oyev. o yidrosh missofo lerosho, ematay yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach? kesheyyemincha Adonai tiratz oyev, az tippol emata vafachad al kol hannivraim mippene shimcha haaddir.

rashi: Veikkavda befaro. keshehakkabba mitnakkem barshaim shemo mitgaddel umitkabbed, vechen hu omer "venishpatti itto vegomer" veachar kach "vehitgaddilti vehitkaddishti venodati vegomer" (Yechezkel 38), veomer "shamma shibbar rishfe kashet", veachar kach "noda bihuda elohim" (tehillim 76), veomer "noda Adonai mishpat asa" (sham 9):
Befaro uvechol chelo. hu hitchil baavera umimmennu hitchila happuranut:
Vayyaasu chen. lehaggid shivchan, sheshshamu lekol moshe, velo amru haech nitkarev el rodfenu? anu tzerichim livroach ella amru en lanu lekayem ella divre ven amram (mechilta):
Nashafta. leshon hafacha, vechen "vegam nashaf bahem" (yeshaya 40):
Tzallu. shaku, amku, leshon metzula:
Kaoferet. avar, 156 velaaz:
ohc: Nashafta veruchacha vegomer. shalosh pureaniyyot keneged shalosh machshavot, keneged ma sheamar "achallek shalal" – kissamo yam, baze hagam sheyyemalletennu sus veyashut bayyam hinne shelalo avad, ucheneged hainnuy shechashav al hayyehudim karamuz beamro "timlaemo nafshi", gam ma shechashav leharik charbo, amar tzallu vegomer, perush metu, velo metu techef umiyyad ella "tzallu kaoferet bemayim addirim". veamru zichronam livracha (mechilta) shehayu hammayim maalim otam ad lashshamayim umoridim otam ad hattehom vehayu metim baarichut zeman, vehu amro kaoferet bemayim addirim yechavven lishne devarim: haechad hu hashshekiut, vehu amro "tzallu kaoferet", vehashsheni hu meniatam millamut techef umiyyad, vehu amro "bemayim addirim" vehem yaalum mimmaal veyimneum mimmavet techef umiyyad, shir veshevach lelohim al nissav umoftav.

rashi: Shetem esre enot mayim. keneged 12 shevatim nizdammenu lahem:
Veshivim temarim. keneged shivim zekenim (mechilta):
Gam lereehu yissane rash. afillu leshoshvinav veohavav. gam leshon afillu:
Yissane rash. am haaretz sheeno yodea linhog kashshura:
targum: Af lechavreh sene miskena verachame deattira sagiin:

rashi: Vayyillonu. leshon nifal hu, vechen hattargum leshon nifal hu veitraamu, vechen derech leshon teluna lehasev haddibbur el haadam – mitlonen, mitroem velo amar lonen, roem, vechen yomar halloez dakevamepaleyshenat 310 velaaz, mesev haddibbur elav beamro 310:
ohc: Vayyillonu vegomer lemor. yesapper hakkatuv bignutam ki bau beriv, veen hakkatuv makpid ella al telunotam, aval al perat amram "ma nishte" lo yakpid Adonai im hayu omrim kederech shoel chesrono.

rashi: Vattaan lahem miryam. moshe amar shira laanashim – hu omer vehem onin acharav – umiryam amra shira lannashim (sota 30):
Leolam vaed. leshon olamut hu vehavvav bo yesod, lefichach hi petucha, aval "anochi hayyodea vaed" (Yirmeyahu 29), shehavvav bo shimmush, kemutza hi:
ohc: Adonai yimloch vegomer. taam shello amru "Adonai malach", amru hem atzmam hattaam "ki va" vegomer, perush, letzad shello naasa hammishpat ella beumma achat, vehu amro ki va sus paro vegomer, ki lo yukkach mizze hachechashat kol haelohot asher ummot otam yaavdu, velaze en malchuto nikkeret leolam. ma sheen ken leatid lavo, ki yaase Adonai mishpat bechol haggoyim, az yihye Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz, vehu amro "Adonai yimloch".

O yirtze taam amro yimloch velo malach, ki "va sus paro" vegomer, perush, kullam hayu battevia kesus echad, vehakkavvana baze ki lo nimlat mehem ad echad, keshem sheyyitba adam echad yitbeu chullam. vehen emet, im haya maggid laolam hafelagat veotzem hannes lehakkir haolam gedullat tigboret peer nitztzachon vehod yesod emunatenu, asher kol shomav yitlahavu veyomru: havu yekar ki hu ze adonenu malkenu, umeatta yihye Adonai lemelech, ella shello halchu bayyabbasha venimletu zulat bene yisrael, vehu amro "uvene yisrael halchu" vegomer, velahem lo yishmeu haummot ki hem nogim baddavar lihyoto elohehem.

rashi: Lemishmeret. ligniza:

Ledorotechem. bime yirmeyahu; keshehaya yirmeyahu mochicham lamma en attem oskim battora? vehem omrim nanniach melachtenu venaasok battora, mehechan nitparnes? hotzi lahem tzintzenet hamman amar lahem attem reu devar Adonai, shimu lo neemar ella reu, baze nitparnesu avotechem, harebe sheluchin yesh lo lammakom lehachin mazon lireav:
ohc: Vayyomer moshe ze vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro haddavar. od tzarich ladaat mitzva zo lemi metzavve otah moshe, im leaharon hare hu omer achar kach "vayyomer moshe" vegomer. veod kefel haddevarim roani kan.

Venire ki kavvanat moshe hu al ze hadderech: ze haddavar asher tzivva vegomer melo haomer vegomer, velo amar Adonai mi yikkachennu, vegam lo amar seder lekichato, gam lo amar mekom hannachato, ella ze hu haddibbur sheyyatza mippi Adonai elay velo yoter. vayyomer el aharon – shafat betzedek daat chacham, ki perush "lemishmeret" sovelet shete derachim, umiddarche hattora kol shehatteva tisbol shene devarim shekulim bemashmautah techavven el hashshenayim, ki eze mehem totzi. ushete hadderachim hem: haachat – lemishmeret min hattuma, vehashsheniyya – min shelichut yad. keneged shelichut yad amar makom hammishtammer beohel moed, gam sham makom shetztzarche yisrael netunim sham, hattora uchele sharet, veze gam ken keli shemmeshammesh horaat davar asher chafetz Adonai lehareot ledorot. uchemo chen asa Adonai bematte aharon uvemachtot adat korach (bammidbar 17:25, 17:3-4), velaze amar lehannicho lifne Adonai. ucheneged shemirat tuma amar tzintzenet achat, veamru zichronam livracha (mechilta) tzintzenet davar shehu metzitz mechavero shehu keli cheres shekkol shetztzamid patil alav tahor. ushene peratim ellu shemaam middevar Adonai beamro "lemishmeret", umeatta dan ki aharon hu hallokeach ki hu hakkohen hamesharet bammikdash, velaze "vayyomer el aharon". uleval yachshevu haam ki Adonai amar elav ledabber el aharon "velakachta tzintzenet" vegomer, laze amar hanneeman haggadol "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai" velo yoter, vehechacham hevin hakkavvana.

O yirtze, ki mittechilla keshekkibbel hannevua sidderah lifne yisrael keseder shemiatah meel elyon, vehaya chaser hayedia mi haose umekom hanachat hamman umekom hanachat hakkeli, velo yada ma laasot ad shebbaa hannevua paam sheniyya, veamar lo sefekotav, vehu amro besof hammaase kaasher tzivva Adonai el moshe (Shemot 16:34), perush, lo tachshov bedatecha ki peratim sheenam meforashim bidvar Adonai shehem shelosha hannizkarim, moshe meatzmo asaan, lo chen hu, ella kaasher tzivva Adonai el moshe mippi elyon hayu haddevarim.

Veladderech harishon yitbaer amro kaasher tzivva Adonai vegomer, yechavven hakkatuv lomar ki hitzdiku iyyuno shel moshe keillu ken tzivva Adonai elav kaasher shafat baddevarim hassetumim kemo shepperashnu.

Lemishmeret ledorotechem. amar leshon rabbim, achat hayta bedoro shel yirmeya, veachat tihye leatid lavo kemaamaram zichronam livracha (mechilta ka, tanchuma 3) shelosha devarim atid eliyyahu lehaamid leyisrael, veechad mehem hi tzelochit shel man.

rashi: Berakkato. (targum:) betzideh, 95 154 belaaz, utechavah berakkato uvaaretz:
targum: Veha varak redaf yat sisra venafkat yael likdamuteh vaamarat leh ita veachazinach yat gavra deat bae veal levatah veha sisra tarif umit vesikketa neitza betzideh:

rashi: Vayyesor et richbo. hu veatzmo (mechilta):

Veet immo lakach immo. meshacham bidvarim, lakinu venatlu mamonenu veshillachnum, bou immi vaani lo etnaheg immachem kishar melachim, derech shear melachim avadav kodmin lo bammilchama, vaani akdim lifnechem, shenneemar ufaro hikriv – hikriv atzmo umiher lifne chelotav –, derech shear melachim littol bizza barosh kemo sheyyivchar, ani eshve immachem bachelek shenneemar "achallek shalal" (Shemot 15):
ohc: Veet ammo lakach vegomer. ki lo haya bammassa umattan shekkatavnu ella hu vaavadav, aval ammo hutzrach lekachtam bidvarim, ki hem hayu yereim lenafsham.

rashi: Kaasher yarim moshe yado. vechi yadav shel moshe notzchot hayu hammilchama vechulei kidita beroah:
Yara vayyam. "shedi veyamma", shedi leshon yeriyya, vechen hu omer "o yaro yiyyare" (Shemot 19) – o ishtedaa yishtedi, vehattav meshammesh beellu bimkom yitpael:
Umivchar. shem davar. kemo merkav, mishkav, mikra kodesh:

Tubbeu. en tevia ella bimkom tit, kemo "tavati biven metzula" (Tehillim 69), "vayyitba yirmeyahu battit" (Yirmeyahu 38), melammed, shennaasa hayyam tit, ligmol lahem kemiddatam sheshibedu et yisrael bechomer uvilvenim (mechilta):
Uverov geoncha. zot hayyad bilvad roetzet haoyev – keshehu merimah berov geono az yaharos kamav – veim berov geono levad oyvav neherasim kal vachomer kesheshshillach bam charon af yochlemo):

Taharos. tamid atta hores kamecha hakkamim negdecha, umi hem hakkamim kenegdo? ellu hakkamim al yisrael; vechen hu omer "ki hinne oyvecha yehemayun" (tehillim 83), uma hi hahemya? "al ammecha yaarimu sod" (sham), veal ze kore otam oyvav shel makom:
ohc: Uverov geoncha. perush, letzad shehizkir ki yaarotz kamav, hosif lomar ki od lahem sheyyaharsem berov geono, vehakkavvana shello yaharsem harisa kalla belo hareasha ella bemoftim uveotot yaase bahem mishpat katuv. veamro teshallach charoncha yochlemo kakkash, perush, lo sheatta tzarich lerov geoncha laharos otam, ella hagam sheyyachol atta lishloach charon echad shellecha veyihye neevad kakkash.

rashi: Vaychassu et harechev, lechol chel paro. kach derech hammikraot lichtov lamed yetera, kemo "lechol kelav taase nechoshet" (Shemot 27), vechen "lechol kele hammishkan bechol avodato" (Bamidbar 4), "vitedotam umetrehem lechol kelehem" (sham), veenah ella tikkun lashon:
ohc: Lechol chel paro vegomer. perush, harechev vehapparashim shello haya bahem koach lemaher lavo letoch hayyam, vehayu baim acharehem, shavu hammayim alehem lemakom shehayu sham, "lo nishar bahem" vegomer:

rashi: Nod hechalav. shehechalav machbid et hagguf lihyot nirdam:
targum: Vaamar lah ashkini chean zeer maya are tzache ana lemishte ufetachat yat noda dechelba veashkiteh vechasiteh:

rashi: Et hayyad haggedola. et haggevura haggedola sheasta yado shel hakkabba. veharebe leshonot noflin al leshon yad vechullan leshon yad mammash hen, vehamefarsho yetakken hallashon achar inyan haddibbur:
ohc: Vayyiru haam et Adonai – perush, yirat harommut, aval yirat haonesh min hassetam hayta lahem kodem bemitzrayim. ulefi ma shehochachnu befarashat (Shemot 12:43) "zot chukkat happasach" ki lo kibbelu alehem mitzvot hammelech, im ken afilu yirat haonesh lo hayta lahem ad sherau hayyad haggedola vayyiru vegomer, veal kol panim beyirat harommut hakkatuv medabber, meamro "vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vayyiru" vegomer. veamro vayyaaminu ki ze tashlum haemuna bahem.

rashi: Ma titzak elay. limmedanu shehaya moshe omed umitpallel, amar lo hakkabba, lo et atta lehaarich bitfilla, sheyyisrael netunin betzara (mechilta). davar acher – ma titzak elay, alay haddavar taluy velo alecha, kemo shenneemar lehallan "al banay veal poal yaday tetzavvuni" (Yeshayahu 45):
Dabber el bene yisrael veyissau. en lahem ella lissa, sheen hayyam omed bifnehem, keday hu zechut avotehem vehaemuna sheheeminu vi veyatzu, likroa lahem hayyam (mechilta):
ohc: Ma titzak elay. kashe, ulemul mi yitzak im lo laAdonai elohav, uvifrat beet tzara dichtiv (Yona 2:3) "karati mitztzara li", (Tehillim 118:5) "min hammetzar karati yah", veim letzad shehirba lehitpallel, halo kol od shello naana mehaone batztzar lo lo yiref mittefilla. od roani ki nitkabbela tefillato veamar lo Adonai harem et mattecha vegomer, im ken kavlanut ze sheamar ma titzak elay lamma. od kashe amro dabber el bene yisrael veyissau lehechan yisu im rodef meachor vehayyam lifnehem, veim hakkavvana achar sheyyibbaka hayyam im ken haya lo lomar "harem et mattecha" vegomer veachar kach yomar "dabber el bene yisrael" vegomer:

Achen yitbaer hainyan al pi maamaram zichrono livracha (Shemot Rabba 21,7) sheyyisrael hayu netunin baddin "ma ellu af ellu". vedavar yadua hu ki koach harachamim hu maasim tovim asher yaase haadam lematta yosifu koach bemiddat harachamim, ulehefech baavonotenu harabbim yemaatu hakkoach, vehu amro (Devarim 32:18) "tzur yeladcha teshi". vehinne letzad sheraa el elyon ki yisrael kitrega alehem middat haddin, vehen emet ki chafetz Adonai letzaddek yisrael aval en koach barachamim letzad maasehem kannizkar, asher al ken amar lemoshe teshuva nitztzachat ma titzak elay, perush ki en haddavar taluy beyadi hagam sheani chafetz asot nes kevan shehem enam reuyim, middat haddin monaat veen koach barachamim keneged middat haddin hammonaat. veamar elav dabber el bene yisrael, perush zot haetza hayyeutza lehagebir tzad hachesed veharachamim, dabber el bene yisrael veyitatztzemu beemuna bechol libbam veyisseu el hayyam kodem sheyyechalek al semach habbittachon ki ani eese lahem nes, uveemtzaut ze titgabber harachamim. veatta harem et mattecha, perush beemtzaut maase hattov naase lahem hannes uvaka hayyam, ki gadol habbittachon vehaemuna hallaz lehacheriam letova. vetimtza shekken haya, vetzaddik harishon hu nachshon ben amminadav venichnas ad gerono velo nivka hayyam ad sheamar "ki vau mayim ad nafesh" kemaamaram zichrono livracha (sota 37,1). uvaze nityashshevu hakketuvim al nachon. venire li lomar ki rasham Adonai lomar lahem taam tigboret haddin alehem letzad shehem himitu belibbam haemuna veamru "halo tov lanu et avod mitzrayim", laze tzivva Adonai laasot keneged avon ze hatzedakat haemuna bechol tokef. gam baze remazam ladaat hassovev tigboret haddin mechadash.

rashi: Vayyachalosh yehoshua. chatach rashe gibborav velo hishir ella challashim shebbahem, velo haragam kullam, mikkan anu lemedim sheasu appi haddibbur shel shechina (sham):
Man hu. hachanat mazon hu, kemo "vayman lahem hammelech" (Daniel 1):
Ki lo yadu ma hu. sheyyikrauhu vishmo:
ohc: Vayyomru ish vegomer man vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma kavvanat hakkatuv baze. veulay ki birotam oto hizmin Adonai lefihem bimkom sheyyomru "ma hu" amru "man hu", veze shemo asher kava lo Adonai vesam shemo befi yisrael, al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 7,2) "asher sam shammot baaretz" sheyyechavvenu lashshemot asher kara lahem habbore. veamro ki lo yadu natan hakkatuv taam hametzaat hashshem lefihem, hu letzad shello yadu ma hu, umeemtzaut ze nafal eleha befihem. veulay ki mizze nitchakkemu bene yisrael vekaru shemo man, dichtiv (Shemot 16:31) "vayyikreu vet yisrael shemo man", shehiskilu betevat man sheenah min haragil bannidbar, veen ze ella ruach Adonai dibber umillato al leshonam ki ze shemo.

rashi: Vayyasar et ofan markevotav. mikkoach haesh nisrefu haggalgallim, vehammerkavot nigrarot, vehayyoshvim bahem naim veevarehen mitparkin (mechilta):
Vaynahagehu bichvedut. behanehaga shehi cheveda vekasha lahem; bamidda shemmaddu: "vayyachbed" libbo hu vaavadav (Shemot 9), af kan vaynahagehu "bichvedut":
Nilcham lahem bemitzrayim. bammitzriyyim. davar acher bemitzrayim – beeretz mitzrayim, shekkeshem sheellu lokim al hayyam kach lokim otam shennisharu bemitzrayim (mechilta):

Vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim. mashal limhallech badderech uveno mehallech lefanav, bau listim lishboto, netalo millefanav unetano leacharav, ba zeev meacharav, netano lefanav, bau listim lefanav uzeevim meacharav, netano al zeroo venilcham bahem, kach "veanochi tirgalti leefrayim kacham al zerootav" (Hoshea 11) (mechilta):
Vayhi heanan vehachoshech. lemitzrayim:
Vayyaer ammud haesh et hallayla leyisrael, veholech lifnehem kedarko lalechet kol hallayla vehachoshech shel arafel letzad mitzrayim:
Velo karav ze el ze. machane el machane (sham):
ohc: Vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim vegomer. ulay ki kol mekom hechalal shebben shene hammachanot mille otam heanan vehachoshech, vehu amro vayyavo ben vegomer, sheim lo chen lamma hutzrach lomar "vayyavo ben" vegomer achar shekkevar amar "vayyelech meacharehem vayyaamod meacharehem"?

rashi: Eshet lappidot. shehayta osa petilot lammikdash:
targum: Udevora itteta neviata ittat lappidot hi dayna yat yisrael beidana hahi:

rashi: Az yashir moshe. az kesheraa hannes ala velibbo sheyyashir shira. vechen "az yedabber yehoshua" (Yehoshua 10), vechen "uvayit yaase levat paro" (Melachim 1 7) – chashav belibbo sheyyaase lah, af kan yashir amar lo libbo sheyyashir vechen asa – vayyomru lemor ashira laAdonai, vechen bihoshua kesheraa hannes amar lo libbo sheyyedabber vechen asa – "vayyomer leene yisrael" (Yehoshua 10), vechen shirat habbeer, sheppatach bah az yashir yisrael, peresh acharav "ali veer enu lah" (Bamidbar 11), "az yivne shelomo bama" (Melachim 1 11), pershu vo chachme yisrael shebbikkesh livnot velo vana, limmedanu shehayyod al shem hammachashava neemra, zehu leyashshev peshuto. aval midrasho amru rabbotenu zichrono livracha "mikkan remez litchiyyat hammetim min hattora" vechen bechullan, chutz mishshel shelomo, sheppershuhu bikkesh livnot velo vana. veen lomar uleyashshev lashon hazze kishar devarim hannichtavim bilshon atid vehen miyyad, kegon "kacha yaase iyyov" (Iyov 1), "appi Adonai yachanu" (Bamidbar 9), "veyesh asher yihye heanan" (sham), lefi shehen davar hahove tamid venofel bo ben leshon atid uven leshon avar, aval ze shello haya ella leshaa, eni yachol leyashshevo ballashon hazze:

Ki gaa gaa. ketargumo. (davar acher – ba hakkefel lomar sheasa davar shei efshar levasar vadam laasot; keshehu nilcham bachavero umitgabber alav, mappilo min hassus, vechan hasus verochvo rama vayyam, vechol shei efshar laasot al yede zulato nofel bo leshon geut, kemo "ki geut asa" 0, vechen kol hashshira timtza chefula, azzi vezimrat yah vayhi li lishua, Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo, vechen kullam). davar acher – ki gaa gaa, al kol hashshirot vechol ma sheakalles bo, od yesh bo tosefet, velo chemiddat melech basar vadam shemmekallesin oto veen bo:
Sus verochvo. shenehem keshurim ze baze vehammayim maalin otan veyordin laomek veenan nifradin (mechilta):

Rama. hishlich, vechen "uremiv lego attun nura" (Daniel 3). umidrash aggada: katuv echad omer rama, vechatuv echad omer yara, melammed shehayu olin larum veyordin lattehom, kemo "mi yara even pinnatah" (Iyov 38), milmala lematta:
ohc: Az yashir. lo haya tzarich lomar "az", ella "vayyashar moshe" vegomer, vehaddavar muvan ki az shorru. achen yechavven hakkatuv lehodienu hachanat hammussag, ki keshennichnesa belibbam yirat harommut vehaemuna hashshelema, az zachu lomar shira beruach hakkodesh.

Veamro yashir leshon atid, letzad sheamar "az" chash hakkatuv sheyyite adam veyomar ki "az" miet sheen shira zo yechola leamer zulat az, talmud lomar "yashir", sheyyeshnah leshira zo gam leatid, vechol habba lashir shira zo lifne Adonai yesh leel yado. o yirmoz lammitzva shemmitzva leamrah tamid, ukevauha bitfillat shacharit bechol yom.

Vayyomru lemor ashira. perush, amru ze laze lemor, perush, sheyyomru shira yachad belo bechinat hishtannut vehaferada, ad sheyyihyu keish echad, hagam heyotam rabbim, venitkavvenu yachad veasu chen, veamru ashira leshon yachid keillu hem ish echad, shezzulat ze hayu omrim nashira.

Ki gao gaa vegomer. en leshabbeach techilla ella al mappaltan shel reshaim, al derech amro (Mishlei 11:10) "uvaavod reshaim rinna". uferush amro gao gaa yechavven al paro shennitgaa geut sheshshemah geut, ki derech haggeim yitgau al kayyotze bahem, adam al adam kayyotze bo, vegaavato shel ze enah chashuva geut ki hu mitgae al hashshafel. aval paro gao gaa, perush geut shennikret kefi haemet geut gaa, ki lo hechshiv maamar elyon veamar "mi Adonai". o yirtze gao gaa shehayta gaavato kefula, sus verochvo shel haggee rama vegomer:

Od yirtze gao gaa al "Adonai malach geut lavesh" (tehillim 93:1), venitkavvenu lomar ki kodem sheasa mishpat ze hayta lo bechinat gaava achat, uveemtzaut yad haggedola gao gaa. gam lirmoz ben baelyonim ben battachtonim beemtzaut davar ze. ulederech ze chaser hannismach lerochvo. veulay shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "ashira laAdonai ki gao gaa", perush Adonai, venimshechet od tevat "ki gao gaa" lematta al ze hadderech, uleoto sheggao gaa sus vegomer rama vayyam.

rashi: Vecham hashshemesh venamas. hannishar bassade naase nechalim veshotin mimmennu ayyalim utzevaim, veummot haolam tzadin mehem vetoamim bahem taam man, veyodim ma shivchan shel yisrael:
Venamas. pashar, leshon poshrim, al yede hashshemesh mitchammem umafshir, dayshatenaperayr belaaz, vedugmato besanhedrin besof 4 mitot:
Hasselav. min of veshamen meod (yoma 75):

Hayta shichvat hattal. hattal shochev al hamman, uvemakom acher hu omer (Bamidbar 11) "uveredet hattal vegomer", hattal yored al haaretz, vehamman yored alav, vechozer veyored tal alav, hare hu kemunnach bekufsa (yoma sham):
Devar yom beyomo. tzorech achilat yom yilketu beyomo velo hayyom letzorech machar (mechilta):
Lemaan anassennu hayelech betorati. im yishmeru mitzvot hatteluyot bo, shello yotiru mimmennu velo yetzu bashshabbat lilkot:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinni vegomer. lo amar hakkatuv "lemor". gam hitchil ledabber nocheach vesiyyem nistar "veyatza haam" vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 75,1) ki hamman haya yored latztzaddikim petach oholo shel kol echad velo haya tzarich latzet acharav, velishar haam haya yored bemakom acher vehayu yotzim lilkot, vehu amro hinni mamtir lachem lechem vegomer, perush been tzorech latzet lilkot, aval haam yetzu veyilketu. keneged ma shello batchu vekadmu lishol yassiguhu betorach.

Vetaam shello amar bitchillat nevua zo "lemor", letzad ki adayin yetzavvehu paam sheniyya kol haddevarim bapparasha sheachar zo, ella shehikdim haddevarim lemoshe limtzo befiv maane, vetechef umiyyad heshivam shehannevua neemra lo keheref ayin, vetechef umiyyad "vehinne chevod Adonai":
Lemaan anassennu vegomer. ki lechem min hashshamayim lo yitztarech shum tikkun, uvaze yihyu penuyim mikkol, veere hayelech vegomer.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech taam devar yom beyomo lemaan anassennu, kesheyyihye tzarich lo bechol yom limzonotav:

rashi: Adonai ish milchama. baal milchamot, kemo "ish noomi" (Rut 1), vechol ish veishech meturgamin baal, vechen "vechazakta vehayita leish" (Melachim 1 2) – legibbor:
