Adonai shemo. milchamotav lo bichle zayin ella bishmo hu nilcham; kemo sheamar david "veanochi va elecha beshem Adonai tzevaot" (Shmuel 1 17). davar acher, Adonai shemo – af beshaa shehu nilcham venokem meoyvav, ochez hu bemiddato lerachem al beruav velazun et kol bae olam; velo chemiddat malche adama keshehu osek bemilchama pone atzmo mikkol asakim veen bo koach laasot zo vezo (mechilta):
ohc: Adonai ish milchama. perush, gam bemiddat harachamim asa milchama, velo sheyyishtanne mippene ze chas veshalom, ella "Adonai shemo", al derech (Malachi 3:6) "ani Adonai lo shaniti". o yirtze, ki bazzeman atzmo sheasa milchama im hammitzriyyim, bazzeman atzmo haya mitnaheg bemiddat harachamim im yisrael, uchemo shepperashti bemaamaro yitbarach (Shemot 6:2) "vaydabber elohim el moshe vegomer ani Adonai":

rashi: Veselef bah shever beruach. kesheyyesallef ballashon, sofah lehavi alav shever habba beruach kadim, hammuchana lehippara min harshaim, kemo sheamar "beruach kadim azza" (Shemot 14:21), "beruach kadim afitzem" (yirmeya 18:17), "beruach kadim teshabber oniyyot tarshish" (tehillim 48:8):
targum: Asyuta delishana ilana dechaye hu udeachal min perohi nisba:

rashi: Vehu kezera gad lavan. esev sheshshemo kavelayynedar, vezera shello agol veeno lavan, vehamman haya lavan, veeno nimshal lezera gad ella leinyan haiggul, kezera gad haya – vehu lavan:
Ketzappichit. batzek shemmetaggenin oto bidvash, vekorin lo iskeritin bilshon mishna (fesachim 37), vehu targum shel unkelos:
Mecharoshet haggoyim el nachal kishon. hizikam sheyyelchu el nachal kishon mecharoshet haggoyim shehu yoshev sham:
targum: Uchenash sisra yat kol reticheh tesha mea retichin devarzela veyat kol ama deimeh mitkof kerakke ammaya lenachala dekishon:

rashi: Vayhi beshallach paro, velo nacham. nehagam, kemo "lech neche et haam" (Shemot 32), "behithallechcha tanche otach" (Mishlei 6):
Ki karov hu. venoach lashuv beoto hadderech lemitzrayim; umidreshe aggada yesh harebe:

Birotam milchama. kegon milchemet "vayyered haamaleki vehakkenaani vegomer" (Bamidbar 14), im halchu derech yashar hayu chozrim, uma im keshehikkifam derech meukkam amru "nittena rosh venashuva mitzrayma" (sham), im holicham bifshuta al achat kamma vechamma:
Pen yinnachem. yachshevu machashava al sheyyatzu veyittenu lev lashuv:
ohc: Vayhi beshallach vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar leshon tzaar bimkom gila verenen. od lamma kinna hainyan befaro velo baadon hammaasim, ki hu hammotzi otanu meeretz mitzrayim.

Achen hakkatuv yaggid hassibba sheggarma kol hatztzaar shennitztaaru yisrael birdifat paro, veamar: teda sibbat haddavar, letzad shello hotzi Adonai et yisrael ella lirtzono shel paro, kafa oto ad shennitratztza veshillecham veamar lahem kumu tzeu mizze, chashav machashavot lirdof acharehem kaasher avaer beezrat hashshem, uvaze garam tzaar leyisrael, vegam leatzmo garam ibbud lo uleummato. vetze ulemad ki hakkadosh baruch hu yakpid al kilyon hannivraim, kammuva bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Megila 10,2): maase yaday tovim bayyam veattem omrim shira. ucheneged kol ze amar hakkatuv "vayhi" leshon tzaar, umi garam kol tzaar ze – "beshallach paro", sheim haya Adonai motziam shello lirtzono, hagam shello haya chafetz leshallecham, lo haya lo makom lirdof, ella eno hitattu shehaya haddavar taluy bo velaze chashav lashuv lekachtam. veamro velo nacham beVav bitchillat hodaat inyan, yechavven tosefet al haggadat tzaar hakkodem haramuz betevat "vayhi" kannizkar.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichrono livracha (zohar 10 45:) ki chol makom sheyyechanne yisrael beshem "am" yirmoz al erev rav, velaze timtza beinyan ze lifamim mazkir shemam "haam" velifamim mazkiram "bene yisrael", dichtiv "vachamushim alu vene yisrael" vegomer, hare ze mare beetzba ki haam lo mibbene yisrael hemma. veamru zichrono livracha (Shemot Rabba 42,6) ki hashechatat yisrael bammidbar ze hu sibbato, hem amru "nittena rosh" vegomer, hem amru "ase lanu" vegomer, veze hu amro vayhi – tzaar gadol lesonehem shel yisrael, beshallach paro et haam – perush, erev rav sheshshelacham paro, lo Adonai baruch hu hotziam, ki lo ba elohim lakachat lo ella goy gadol nachalato yitbarach, ella paro shelacham, vetamo haya lachof et yisrael lashuv mitzrayim, vehem matzu makom lehiddavek beyisrael vesovev betachlitam tzaar leyisrael kannizkar.

Ulederech ze yeduyyak al nachon amro velo nacham elohim ki karov hu, perush, karov hu lirmoz haam mikkarov ba veen lo chozek bikdushsha. o karov hu lehareshia visovev raa gam leyisrael, veharaa hi "ki amar vegomer pen yinnachem birotam", viduyyak al nachon amro velo nacham betosefet vav bitchillat inyan, lomar ki ze nosaf al kamma tzaar sheggarmu lahem haramuz betevat "vayhi" vegomer, veod lahem "velo nacham".

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 20,3) ki paro asa leyisrael levaya, ulefi ze yaggid hakkatuv tzaar hannimshach lahem mizze, veamar vayhi leshon tzaar lesibbat shallach paro, ki yitztarech haddavar lihyot sheyyittol sechar pesiotav. vetze ulemad missechar pesiot shel oto rasha nevuchadnetztzar (sanhedrin tzav,1), vechol sachar sheyyiktzov lo Adonai yihye gorem raa lesonehem shel yisrael, asher al ken nitchakkem Adonai uvittel mitzvato mimmennu venitchakkem shello holicham derech karov shemmin hassetam lesham yaarim paro lelauotam, uvaze batla machshavto keillu lo livva otam. nimtza mi garam shello halchu yisrael derech karov, levayato shel paro.

Vetaam amro velo nacham betosefet vav lederech ze, lirmoz ki tzaar acher garam haddavar zulat ze, sheal kol panim higgio ketzat zechut ballevaya, veze sibba shennichnesu yisrael besakkana birdifato, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 21) befasuk "velo karav ze" vegomer uvefasuk "ma titzak elay" vegomer, vechamma harepatteke daado alayyhu.
Veamro ki amar vegomer, hu taam acher, ucheillu amar "vechi amar", vetoldot mechusho hu letzad shelichat haam shehem erev rav kemo sherashamnu bederech sheni.

rashi: Amod petach haohel. zarzi atzmech kezachar. veyesh potrim: 'amod, kemo laamod:
targum: Vaamar la kumi bitra mashkena vihe im enash yete veyishalinaych veyemar hait ka gavra vetemrin la:

rashi: Umoshe aharon vechur. mikkan letaanit shetztzerichim shelosha laavor lifne hatteva, shebbetaanit hayu sheruyim (mechilta):
Chur. benah shel miryam haya vechalev balah (sota 11):

Uvoker ureitem. lo al hakkavod shenneemar "vehinne kevod Adonai nira beanan" neemar, ella kach amar lahem, erev vidatem ki hayecholet beyado litten taavatchem, uvasar yitten, ach lo befanim meirot yittenenna lachem, ki shello kahogen shealtem oto umikkares melea, vehallechem sheshshealtem letzorech, biridato labboker tiru et kevod or panav – sheyyoridehu lachem derech chibba, babboker, sheyyesh shaot lahachino vetal milmala vetal millematta, kemunnach bekufsa (yoma 75):
Et telunnotechem al Adonai. kemo asher al Adonai:
Venachnu ma. ma anachnu chashuvin?

Ki tallinu alenu. shettarimu alenu et hakkol, veet benechem uneshechem uvenotechem veerev rav. veal karchi ani zakuk lefaresh tallinu bilshon tafilu mippene dagshuto ukeriyyato, sheillu haya rafe, hayiti mefarsho bilshon tifalu, kemo "vayyalen haam al moshe" (Shemot 17), o im haya dagush veen bo yod venikra tillonu, hayiti mefarsho leshon titlonnu, achshav hu mashma tallinu et acherim, kemo bammeraggelim "vayyallinu alav et kol haeda" (Bamidbar 14):
ohc: Uvoker ureitem vegomer. perush boker hu ma sheamar besamuch "vayyomer moshe vegomer vehinne chevod Adonai" (Shemot 16:9-10), veinyan ze haya beyom sheni. ulefi ze taam amro ureitem betosefet 6, perush, millevad devaro asher yedabber lachem al yadi, od yaase Adonai lachem davar sheyyare lachem et kevodo. o yirtze beamro uvoker ki gam boker yedu ki Adonai vegomer, vehi nimshechet lemala im amro "erev vidatem vegomer uvoker", veamro "ureitem" hu techillat inyan, uchefi ze efshar ki bo bayyom rau kevod Adonai.

rashi: Vayyotiru anashim. datan vaaviram:
Vayyarum tolaim. leshon rimma:
Vayyivash. hare ze mikra hafuch, shebbattechilla hivish ulevassof hitlia, kainyan shenneemar "velo hivish verimma lo hayta bo", vechen derech kol hammatliim (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyarum tolaim vegomer. taam shehikdim "vayyarum" vegomer levayyivash", letzad sheharamat hattolaim timmatze bammin hammatok velo yivash, ki en hasserachon ragil baddevarim hammetukim kirgilut havayat hattolaim, umin ze taamo ketzappichit bidvash, velaze amar vayyarum tolaim, velo day ze ella vayyivash.

Vehaed hanneeman leferushenu ze, amro (Shemot 16:24) "velo hivish verimma lo hayta bo", perush, lo millevad shello hivish, ella afillu rimma hargila lihyot belo sirchon lo hayta bo. veim lo yarum tolaim ad shekkevar hivish, achar sheamar hakkatuv "velo hivish" en tzorech lomar od "verimma" vegomer.

Vehinne raiti lerabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) shello pershu kidvarenu, veulay ki yisberu sheal kol panim hagedalat hattola yakdim lah ketzat mehahavasha shemmimmennu tithavve, hagam shello yivash hammatok.

Uvederech remez yirtze ki en tola gadel ella mehannivash. vehinne matzinu shettirgem uneklos ra – bish, uvechinat hara visodo hu avur pi hattora vehammitzva, veadam ki yecheta yarum tolaim, vehu sod gedilat tolaim mehapperot vaavir haadama achar chet haadam, vehu amro vayyarum tolaim hattaam hu letzad "vayyivash", shennaasa bo bechinat hara shehinnichuhu hefech mitzvat hattora, velaze kesheamar lahem moshe hannichu oto vegomer ad habboker, amar hakkatuv "vayyannichu oto ad habboker kaasher tzivva moshe velo hivish verimma lo" vegomer, perush, lo naga bo bechinat hara, uvaze "verimma lo hayta", uchemo chen hatztzaddikim asher lo yatimu nafsham mibbechinat hara lo yatliu. vetze ulemad maase rabbi eliezer bar rabbi shimon ben yochay alav hashshalom (bava metzia 84:) ki tola echad levad gadal beazno letzad bechinat hara asher naga sham:

rashi: Kol sus paro. vechi sus echad haya? maggid sheen kullam chashuvin lifne hammakom ella kesus echad (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyirdefu mitzrayim. hagam sheamar hakkatuv "vayhi heanan" vegomer (Shemot 14:20), ze haya ballayla, uveor boker lo avot chazru hammaarachot larishonot, verau hammitzriyyim halichat yisrael veradfu acharehem:

rashi: Vehikkita vatztzur. al hatztzur lo neemar ella vatztzur, mikkan shehammatte haya shel min davar chazak ushemo sanpirinon, vehatztzur nivka mippanav (sham):
ohc: Hinni omed vegomer. perush "lefanecha" bemakom ze, vesham" al hatztzur, ki melo chol haaretz kevodo bitmidut been hishtannut makom shello yihye bo shochen hashshochen, ella yesh makom shettigdal bo hasheraat shechinato yitbarach, o kefi maalat hachanat hammakom kemakom hamekuddash, o kefi hashsheruyim betocho.

rashi: Bachamishsha asar yom. nitparesh hayyom shel chanaya zo, lefi shebbo vayyom kalta hacharara shehotziu mimmitzrayim vehutzrechu lamman, lelammedenu, sheachlu mishsheyare habbatzek shishshim veachat seudot veyarad lahem man beshishsha asar beiyyar, veyom 1 beshabbat haya kidita bemassechet shabbat (87):

Bechar lanu. li ulecha – hishvahu lo; mikkan amru chachamim yehi chevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellach; uchevod chavercha kemora rabbach minnayin? shenneemar "vayyomer aharon el moshe bi adoni", vahalo aharon gadol meachiv haya veose et chavero kerabbo. umora rabbach kemora shamayim minnayin? shenneemar "adoni moshe kelaem" – kallem min haolam, chayyavin hem kelaya, hammordim becha keillu mardu behakkabba:
Vetze hillachem. tze min heanan vehillachem bo:
Machar. beet hammilchama, anochi nitztzav:
Bechar lanu anashim. gibborim veyire chet shettehe zechutan mesayyatan. davar acher – bechar lanu anashim sheyyodin levattel keshafim, lefi shebbene amalek mechashshefin hayu:
ohc: Vayyomer moshe el yehoshua. nitchakkem moshe keshehikkir heavon shehu letzad bittul milchemet hattora, amar: en rauy latzet lammilchama ella yehoshua, shenneemar alav (Shemot 33:11) "lo yamish mittoch haohel" beesek hattora, veamar lo sheyyivchar kayyotze vo, uvaze yitgabber alav, vechen haya.

rashi: Vattikkach miryam hannevia. hechan nitnabbea? keshehayta achot aharon, kodem shennolad moshe, amra atida immi shetteled ben vechulei kidita besota. (daf 12). davar acher — achot aharon, lefi shemmasar nafsho aleha keshennitztara nikret al shemo:
Et hattof. keli shel mine zemer:
Betuppim uvimcholot. muvtachot hayu tzadkaniyyot shebbaddor shehakkabba ose lahem nissim vehotziu tuppim mimmitzrayim (mechilta):
Zevach reshaim. toeva balak uvilam (Bamidbar 22-24):
Utefillat yesharim. ze moshe :
targum: Divchahon derashie merachakteh deelaha uvitzlothon ditritze mitree:

rashi: Ozzi vezimrat yah. unkelos tirgem "takpi vetushbachti", azzi kemo uzzi, vezimrat kemo vezimrati, vaani tameah al leshon hammikra, sheen lecha chamohu binkuddato bammikra ella bishlosha mekomot shehu samuch etzel vezimrat, vechol shear mekomot nakud shuruk, "Adonai uzzi umauzzi" (Yirmeyahu 16), "uzzo elecha eshmora" (Tehillim 59). vechen kol teva bat shete otiyyot hannekuda melafum keshehi maarechet beot shelishit veen hashsheniyya bachataf, harishona nekuda beshuruk, kegon oz uzzi, rok rukki, chok chukki, ol ullo – "vesar mealehem ullo" (Yeshayahu 14), kol kullo – "veshalishim al kullo" (Shemot 14), veellu 3 azzi vezimrat shel kan, veshel yeshaya, veshel tehillim, nekudim bachataf kamatz, veod en beechad mehem katuv vezimrati ella vezimrat, vechullam samuch lahem "vayhi li lishua". lechach ani omer, leyashshev leshon hammikra, sheen azzi kemo uzzi velo vezimrat kemo vezimrati, ella azzi shem davar hu kemo "hayyoshvi bashshamayim" (Tehillim 123), "shochni vechagve sela" (Ovadya 1), "shochni sene" (Devarim 33), vezehu hashshevach azzi vezimrat yah hu haya li lishua. vezimrat davuk hu letevat hashshem, kemo "leezrat Adonai" (Shoftim Adonai), "beevrat Adonai" (Yeshayahu 9), "al divrat bene haadam" (Kohelet 3). uleshon vezimrat leshon "lo tizmor" (Vayikra 25), "zemir aritzim" (Yeshayahu 25), leshon kissuach ucherita – uzzo venikmato shel elohenu haya lanu lishua. veal titma al leshon vayhi, shello neemar haya, sheyyesh lanu mikraot medabberim belashon ze, veze dugmato: "et kirot habbayit saviv lahechol veladdevir vayyaas tzelaot saviv" (Melachim 1 6), haya lo lomar asa tzelaot saviv. vechen bedivre hayyamim: "uvene yisrael hayyoshvim beare yehuda vayyimloch alehem rechavam" (divrei hayamim 2 10), haya lo lomar malach alehem rechavam. "mibbilti yecholet Adonai vegomer vayyishchatem" (Bamidbar 14), haya lo lomar shechatam. "vehaanashim asher shalach moshe vegomer vayyamutu" (sham) metu haya lo lomar, "vaasher lo sam libbo el devar Adonai vayyaazov" (Shemot 9), haya lo lomar azav:
Ze eli. bichvodo nigla alehem vehayu marin oto beetzba, raata shifcha al hayyam ma shello rau neviim (mechilta):

Veanvehu. unkelos tirgem leshon nave – "nave shaanan" (Yeshayahu 33), "linve tzon" (sham 65). davar acher – veanvehu leshon noy, asapper noyo veshivcho levae olam, kegon "ma dodech middod vegomer dodi tzach veadom" (Shir HaShirim Adonai), vechol hainyan:
Elohe avi. hu ze vaarommenhu: elohe avi. lo ani techillat hakkedushsha ella muchzeket veomedet li hakkedushsha velohuto alay mime avotay:
ohc: Azzi vezimrat vegomer. hinne seder haomdim lifne Adonai leshorer uleshabbeach ulehitpallel hu lehatechil baddevarim hammuskalim meAdonai elav veachar kach bammuskol meAdonai laavotav, uchemo shemmatzinu shettikkenu anshe keneset haggedola beavot – "elohenu" veachar kach "elohe avotenu". velaze sidderu behatechalat hashshir ma shehiggiam mittuvo, veamru "azzi vezimrat yah vayhi li lishua", vehu ma shennitchassed Adonai immahem lehoshiam mehatztzara shehayu bah kodem sheyyaggia hakketz, veze haya letzad rachamav alehem, uchemo shekkatavti inyan ze beorech befarashat shemot (3:7), uvefarashat vaera (6:3). velaze gamru omer ze eli veachar kach amru elohe avi, vehu kasseder atzmo shel keneset haggedola shekkavu lomar "elohenu velohe avotenu", vechan amru leshon yachid ki naasu kullam keish echad, kemo shepperashti befasuk "vayyomru lemor".

rashi: Belev navon tanuach chachma. tishkon vetishkot benachat, leshon menucha umargoa:
Uvekerev kesilim tivvadea. meat chachma shebbelibbo machriza; istera belagina kish kish karya (bava metzia pe:):
targum: Belibba demitbayen tishre chachmeta uvegavehon desachle shatyuta tityeda:

rashi: Bassemicha. tirgem yonatan: begoncha, uferash rav hay (shabbat na 1): goncha - gelufekrin, 116 belaaz:
targum: Venafkat yael likdamut sisra vaamarat leh zur ribboni zur levati la tidchal vezar levatah lemashkena vechasiteh begunecha:

rashi: Tippol alehem emata. al harchokim:
Vafachad. al hakkerovim, kainyan shenneemar "ki shamanu et asher hovish vegomer" (Yehoshua 2):
Ad yaavor, ad yaavor. ketargumo:
Kanita. chibbavta mishshear ummot, kechefetz hakkanuy bedamim yekarim shechaviv al haadam:
ohc: Tippol vegomer ad vegomer. pasuk ze veshelleacharav yedabber kol echad al shete hachenasot laaretz, achat bime moshe veachat bime hammashiach, velaze amar hainyanim kefulim.

rashi: Vayyassa moshe. hissian beal karcham, sheitteru mitzrayim et susehem betachshite zahav vachesef vaavanim tovot, vehayu yisrael motzin otan bayyam – ugedola hayta vizzat hayyam mibbizzat mitzrayim shenneemar "tore zahav naase lach im nekuddot hakkasef" (Shir HaShirim 1) – lefichach hutzrach lehassian beal karcham:
ohc: Vayyassa moshe vegomer. perush, nesia zo al pi moshe nesauha, umikkan vaelach al pi Adonai.

rashi: Lachatz et bene yisrael bechazka. darash rabbi tanchuma (96 2): begiddufin, vechen hu omer (Malachi 3:13): chazku alay divrechem:
targum: Utzeaku vene yisrael kodam Adonai are tesha mea retichin devarzela leh vehu dechak yat bene yisrael betukefa asrin shenin:

rashi: Vaychazzek Adonai et lev paro. shehaya tole im lirdof im lav, vechizzek et libbo lirdof (sham):
Beyad rama. bigvura gevoha umefursemet:
ohc: Vaychazzek vegomer uvene yisrael yotzim vegomer. perush, hutzrach Adonai lechazzek libbo, ki haya lo latet lev leofen veseder yetziat bene yisrael shehayta beyad rama, veze yaggid ki paska yad moshel mealehem, umizze haya lo lihyot nirta, ella she chizzek libbo vechashav machashavot hannizkar lemala, "vayyirdof" vegomer:

rashi: Bet tzaddik chosen rav. bet hammikdash shebbana david hatztzaddik chosen rav umigdal oz leyisrael:
Uvitvuat rasha nekaret. uvahavaat hatztzelem shehevi menashshe (divrei hayamim 2 33:7) bah nekera (Devarim Rabba 2:20):
targum: Beveta detzadike sagi chela vaalaltehon derashie titacher:

rashi: Chayye vesarim lev marpe. lev basar, shehu rofe et haraa veover al middotav, hu chayye beriyyotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shehen basar vadam:
Urekav atzamot kina. adam baal chema, rikkavon atzamot hu lakkol:
targum: Demafleg chemta delibbeh asya hu devisreh vehech milteta vekisa hachen kinata begarmeh:

rashi: Vayyisu missukkot. bayyom hashsheni, shehare varishon bau merameses lesukkot:

ohc: Velo matzau. perush, sheim matzu hayu loktin:

rashi: Arbaim shana. vahalo chaser sheloshim yom hem? shehare betv beiyyar yarad lahem hamman techilla uvetv benisan pasak, shenneemar "vayyishbot hamman mimmochorat" (Yehoshua Adonai)? ella maggid, shehauggot shehotziu yisrael mimmitzrayim taamu vahem taam man (kiddushin 38):

El eretz noshavet. leachar sheavru et hayyarden (sheotah shebbeever hayyarden meyushshevet vetova shenneemar "ebera na veere et haaretz hattova asher beever hayyarden", vetargum shel noshavet "yatvata", ratza lomar — meyushshevet):

El ketze eretz kenaan. bitchillat haggevul kodem sheavru et hayyarden, vehu arvot moav. nimtzeu machchishin ze et ze? ella bearvot moav keshemmet moshe bez baadar pasak hamman millered, venistappeku mimman shellaktu vo vayyom ad shehikrivu haomer beshishsha asar benisan, shenneemar "vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach" (Yehoshua Adonai):
ohc: Et hamman achlu vegomer. hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya "et hamman" velo samach al hazekarato besamuch, leheyot sheyyesh shinnuy ben achilat hamman sheachlu ad boam el eretz noshavet lamman sheachlu ad boam liktze eretz kenaan shehu kodem haavarat hayyarden, ki oto shead eretz noshavet haya mehamman shebbakkelim lo shehaya yored yom yom, laze kesheratza lehazekir hamman sheachlu ad boam el eretz kenaan zachar oto bifne atzmo, lomar ki yishtanne ze mizze, vehassechel yakkir ze ki chol sheyyosif lehitrachek zeman shehaya karov lammakor shennithavva mimmennu yugesham yoter. od amru zichronam livracha (kiddushin lach,1) vechi arbaim shana achlu, vahalo chaserim sheloshim yom mitv benisan ad 16 beiyyar, ella shehayu toamim baugot taam kamman.

Veraiti ledakdek hakkatuv lamma shinna leshono: bitchilla ketiv achlu et hamman, hikdim zichron haachila lezichron hamman, ucheshehizkir hamman paam sheniyya amar et hamman achlu, hikdim zichron hamman lezichron haachila. hinne hakkatuv yedakdek leshono lomar ki yishtanne cheshbon arbaim shana shemmana baachilat hamman lema shemmodiacha sheachlu hamman ad boam vegomer, millevad hahefresh shekkatavnu shel yeridato yom yom o mehashshamur, ki hamman shennichnas becheshbon arbaim shana eno ella beerech ma shehayu toamim baachilatan, vehu shehikdim zichron achila kodem zichron hamman lomar ki letzad haachila hukkar heyoto man shehayu toamim beugotehem man, aval en kol haarbaim shana man mammash, shehare sheloshim yom achlu ma shehotziu mimmitzrayim ugot, uchesheratza lehagebil shiur zeman achilat hamman hikdim zichrono lomar en ze nechshav man letzad shettaamu chen ella lefi ma shehu kefi haemet, vedok:

rashi: Vayyomer moshe ichluhu hayyom vegomer. shacharit shehayu regilin latzet velilkot bau lishol: "im netze im lav", amar lahem et shebbeyedchem ichlu, laerev chazru lefanav ushealuhu mahu latzet? amar lahem shabbat hayyom, raa otam doagim shemma fasak hamman velo yered od, amar lahem hayyom lo timtzauhu, ma talo hayyom? hayyom lo timtzauhu aval machar timtzauhu:
ohc: Ichluhu hayyom vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letzauotam al achilato. veulay ki leheyot shello amar lahem ella hannichu oto lemishmeret velo peresh lahem sheyyihyu muttarim baachilato, vahagam shello matzinu sheasar beferush achilat hannotar, mikkan atta lamed sheasaro lahem. o ulay deasur middin "lo tochal kol toeva" veamru zichronam livracha (chullin 114:) kol shettiavti lecha hu beval tochal, laze amar lahem ichluhu hayyom. vedikdek lomar hayyom lishlol yom acher issur hannotar labboker, uchede shello tite vetomar hayyom davka velo yom acher kol ikkar vaafillu shabbat, laze gamar omer ki shabbat vegomer, ha lamadta ki miut hayyom lo ba lemaet ella sheenam shabbat.

Od nitkavven beamro ki shabbat taam lema shelleachareha al ze hadderech, uletaam shehayyom shabbat lo timtzauhu bassade. dikdek lomar bassade lirmoz maamar rabbi shimon ben yochay sheamar bazzohar (chelek 2 88.) ki beyom shabbat yarad hammazon shel kol sheshet yamim lemala, umeoto mazon yored devar yom beyomo, vehu amro lo timtzauhu bassade aval lemala bo yimmatze adrabba mazon lechol shishsha yamim:

rashi: Od meat. im amtin od meat usekaluni:
Ki va sus paro. kaasher ba:
Yillachem lachem. bishvilchem; vechen "ki Adonai nilcham lahem", vechen "im lael terivun" (Iyov 13), vechen "vaasher dibber li" (Bereshit 24), vechen "haattem terivun labbaal" (Shoftim 6):
ohc: Adonai yillachem lachem. perush, letzad shehappachad shennafal alehem hu mehassar, uchemo shepperashnu befasuk "ufaro hikriv", laze amar lahem: bishlama im hayu hem hallochamim, yeshaaru ki atzum hu mehem, ma sheen ken letzad she hu hallochem, en lachush leelef kayyotze bo.

Od yirtze lomar sheafillu middat harachamim tehafech ledin al hammitzriyyim lehillachem immahem, vedikdek lomar lachem kevan shebbeerech yisrael yechashev haddavar rachamim. od yirtze yillachem lachem ki lo leezra levad yihye lahem bammilchama ella hu yaaroch kol hammilchama.

Veamro veattem tacharishun yitbaer al derech amram zichrono livracha (Petichta daaykeh rabbati 30) arbaa tzaddikim ma sheshshaal ze lo shaal ze, vachalukka hammeulla shebbechulan hu ma sheshshaal chizkiyya sheamar: ani en bi koach lo laharog velo lirdof velo lehitpallel, ella ani yashen al mittati veatta ose. vechen asa Adonai, dichtiv (Melachim 2 19:35): "ballayla hahu vayyetze malach Adonai" vegomer, vehi hammadrega sheamar moshe "veattem tacharishun", perush afillu bitfilla im en bachem koach kemaamar chizkiyya tacharishun vehu yillachem lachem. ulefi ma shepperashnu befasuk "hityatztzevu" sheamar lahem yaamdu bitfilla, yirtze al ze hadderech veattem tacharishun lemiddat haddin, perush tarbu bitfilla lehashemia bammarom kolchem lehacharish lemiddat haddin alechem.

rashi: Vayyelech meacharehem. lehavedil ben machane mitzrayim uven machane yisrael ulekabbel chitztzim uvalisteraot shel mitzrayim. bechol makom hu omer malach Adonai vechan malach haelohim, en elohim bechol makom ella dayyan, melammed shehayu yisrael netunin baddin beotah shaa im lehinnatzel im leheaved im mitzrayim (sham):

Vayyissa ammud heanan. keshechashcha vehishlim ammud heanan et hammachane leammud haesh, lo nistallek heanan kemo shehaya ragil lehistallek arvit legamri, ella nasa vehalach lo meacharehem lehachashich lemitzrayim:
ohc: Vayyissa malach haelohim vegomer. yair nativ katuv ze bema shepperashnu befasuk (Shemot 13 21) "vaAdonai holech lifnehem" vegomer ki shelosha ananim hayu meshammeshim leyisrael: echad lifnehem latur lahem makom vegomer, vehashsheni lehagen alehem mechom hashshemesh, vehashshelishi lehair lahem ballayla. vehodianu hakkatuv asher asa Adonai ballayla hahu, vayyissa malach haelohim shehu haholech lifnehem, vehu heanan harishon shemmuzekar befarashat devarim (Devarim 1 33) sheamar "haholech lifnechem" nasa vehalach leacharehem. veamar od ki heanan hameshammesh bifnehem shezzemanno kol hayyom, shehiggia zemanno linsoa ballayla, vehu hammuzekar befarashat devarim dichtiv (sham) "uveanan yomam", gam hu nasa veamad leacharehem. nimtzeta omer ki shene ananim shehayu lifnehem nasu leacharehem, vetaam hashsheni kede sheyyachshich lifnehem bilti daat mekom tachanotam shel yisrael. vehu amro vayhi heanan vehachoshech vayyaer et hallayla, perush ki hutzrach lishnehem lehacheshich bifnehem leval yedu machane yisrael shehaya bo ora hallayla, vehaor yaggid lahem makom. laze kissa choshech penehem, velo hispik lo choshech levad ki yavhik or bene yisrael bemoshvotam, laze asa Adonai shenayim – heanan vehachoshech.

Vaani hinni mechazzek vegomer. bechemlat Adonai alehem nitkavven lehodiam kodem, leval yifchadu birotam ki hayyam nishar chaluk lifne hammitzriyyim keseder shehaya chaluk lifnehem, yashuvu lachshov machashavot ulehamit haemuna belibbam, veyomru hinne hemma olim acharenu veyiru meod. laze hodiam veamar lahem: deu lachem ki mimmenni hayu haddevarim lehikkaved bo, vaani pores reshet leraglehem.

rashi: Veyashuvu hammayim. shezzekufin veomdim kechoma, yashuvu limkomam vichassu al mitzrayim:
ohc: Nete et yadcha vegomer veyashuvu vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hutzrach lintot yado al hashavat hammayim, halo hem meatzmam lo yatmidu laasot ken, uvigmar aliyyat yisrael shehu gam ken gemar yeridat acharon shel hammitzriyyim (Shemot Rabba 22) meatzmo yashuv hayyam.

Veulay ki mehattaam atzmo shennishar chaluk gam bimkomot sheavru bo kevar yisrael, vehayu hammitzriyyim baim shamma, chashav hayyam ki "ma ellu af ellu", vaAdonai gazar ken kede sheyyikkansu kullan yachad letoch hayyam, vetaam ze lo noda layyam velo hirher achar rabbo, laze tzivva Adonai lemoshe lirmoz layyam ki kalta shelichuto veyelech keminhago.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet yom tov (betza 5,1): kol davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro, vehochichu chen mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 5:27): "shuvu lachem leoholechem", hagam sheen taam leesor od, af al pi chen hutzrach lehattir.

Od taam hannetiyya, lefi shezzulat ze, hagam sheyyashuv hayyam, yashuv leat leat letzad heyoto tash koach mehahishtannut sheavra alav, uvaze yuchelu lehimmalet. laze tzivva Adonai lemoshe lehair layyam bintiyyat yado lashuv letakpo harishon techef umiyyad, vechen hu omer vayyashav vegomer leetano. o efshar ki letzad shehukka hayyam al yede moshe, chafatz Adonai sheal yede moshe shav verafa lo al yede netiyyat yado vaAdonai somchah, keamro (Yeshayahu 63:12) "molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto" yitbarach.

Od yirtze bintiyyat yado lirmoz layyam sheyyaase melachto bahem shelema, leval yimmalet sus verochvo, velo yimmana mehem beshum ofen leval yimmalet mitzri lashuv alot mehayyam, uchegon otam shebbiktzot hayyam shebbeshita achat yifnu mehayyam, hirshahu layyam al kullam levilti yimmalet mehem ad echad, vechen hu omer vayyashuvu hammayim vaychassu vegomer:

rashi: Vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met. sheppelatan hayyam al sefato, kede shello yomru yisrael, keshem sheanu olim mitztzad ze kach hem olin mitztzad acher, rachok mimmennu, veyirdefu acharenu (fesachim 118):
ohc: Bayyom hahu. perush bayyom hahu hayta hatteshua velo kodem, hagam sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim lo hayu botchim beatzman mehem.

Vayyar vegomer met al sefat hayyam. kashe lamma hutzrach lehodienu sheraahu met, peshita shello yihyu chayyim achar hattevia. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta beshallach) amru ki rau bemitatan, vehodianu baze ki sham gamru mitatam, vehattaam kede sheyyakkiru bahem yisrael beodam chayyim vehem yiru beyisrael utechassem busha. ulefi ze tihye kavvanat hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim shehayta yotza nishmato al sefat hayyam, vetevat "met" niksheret im amro "al sefat hayyam" velo im tevat "vayyar".

Vayyitzma sham vegomer. hinne hainyan yolid hattema, lamma yeviem Adonai el hannissayon haggadol hazze lamut batztzama, uchefi hassechel yeshaer adam sheddavar ze vechaddome tolid hakkefira. veod tigdal hakkushya al moshe shebbimkom sheyyeezor chalatzav bitfilla uvetachanunim ba betaana lifne Adonai "od meat" vegomer, sheyerae ki lo chashash al tzimonam veal mot bene yisrael batztzama, ki hakkatuv meid ki tzamu lammayim.

Venire ki Adonai nissa otam lehadericham laset enehem ulehitpallel lifne Adonai, ki ze ikkar gadol baemuna uvehashlamat hannefesh. vetimtza shennitchakkem Adonai al haddavar velo natan lahem man yom lechodesh ella devar yom beyomo, vaasher al ken mana mehem hannes ad sheyyitchannenu lemul konam veyishma tzaakatam. umodia hakkatuv ki bimkom sheyyitzaku laAdonai hayu merivin im moshe, ucheshettakaf alehem hatztzimmaon, vayyalen haam al moshe. laze sidder hakkatuv seder hammaase "vayyitzma vegomer vayyalen" vegomer, lomar shello asu davar zulat ze – ha lamadta ki lo tzaaku laAdonai. vechen heid hakkatuv al nassotam vegomer "hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin" – ha lamadta ki lo hayu matzdikim bahashegacha. vehen haadon baruch hu haya machricham litzok elav ulehasir hammachshava haraa beemtzaut tokef hatztzimmaon, vechol ze hiskil vehevin moshe, velaze lo hitpallel el Adonai vehaya metzappe letikvat haadon mehem. uchesheraa ki gadol hakkeev amar lifne Adonai ma eese laam hazze, perush, ma eese lahem leharechik telunatam mealay. umizze teda ki hirgish moshe ki en davar ze taluy bitfilla, sheim lo chen haya mitpallel kemo sheasa al hayyam, velu yehi shello naana haya mosif bitfilla ad sheyyaanehu Adonai. vetaan od lifne Adonai od meat vegomer, perush, im tosif letzaaram od meat toldot haddavar shettetze mehem hi usekaluni, velu yehi sheachar tosif letzaaram ad sheyyitzaku lefanecha bivchiyya rabba vetetze kavvanat Adonai lappoal, aval bene bene vayyelech moshe biskila, vezo taana hannishmaat.

Veraiti latet lev ech am Adonai haroim devarim hammuflaim vehannoraim bemitzrayim veal hayyam uvammidbar, yitu baddavar velo yitzaku el Adonai, vahalo hem hammakkirim toelet hatztzeaka ki shama et naakatam bemitzrayim (Shemot 2:23). veulay ki datam haya sheen tzorech litfilla al haddavar kol she yeshno betocham, ki achar sheheviam lammidbar peshita shello heviam ella lesappek tzarkam, sheim lo chen halo hemma avudim velo yitztarchu litfilla, veen ze ella sheen Adonai bekirbam, vehu hannissayon sheamru "hayesh Adonai bekirbenu" vegomer.

rashi: Lo yamish. hakkabba et ammud heanan yomam veammud haesh layla; maggid sheammud heanan mashlim leammud haesh veammud haesh mashlim leammud heanan, shead shello yishka ze ole ze:

Beashmoret habboker. sheloshet chelke hallayla keruyin ashmura, veotah shellifne habboker kore ashmoret habboker. veomer ani, lefi shehallayla chaluk lemishmerot shir shel malache hashsharet, kat achar kat, lishlosha chalakim, lechach karuy ashmoret, vezehu shettirgem unkelos "matterat":
Vayyashkef. vayyabbet, kelomar pana alehem lehashechitam. vetargumo "veistechi" af hu leshon habbata, kemo "sede tzofim", (Bamidbar 23) – chakal sachuta:
Beammud esh veanan. ammud anan yored veose oto ketit veammud esh marticho, vetalfe susehem mishtammetot (mechilta):

Vayyahom. leshon mehuma, ashedaveradeyshevan belaaz, irbevam, natal signiyyot shellahem. veshaninu befirke rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili: kol makom shenneemar bo mehuma hareamat kol hu, veze av lechullan "vayyarem Adonai bekol gadol vegomer al pelishtim vayhummem" (Shmuel 1 7):
ohc: Vayhi beashmoret habboker. tzarich ladaat lamma asa Adonai hammishpat haggadol hazze babboker velo ballayla shehu zeman tigboret haddinim. veraiti sheamru zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 235) ki gavriel taan taana zo lifne Adonai veheshivo el elyon: hameten ad otah shaa sheppaal avihem immi, shenneemar "vayyashkem avraham babboker" (Bereshit 22:3) ad kan. perush teshuvat Adonai, ki hagam sheeno zeman hannekama, ani mehappech hasseder livne avraham keshem shehafach avraham tivo harachaman, uma gam al beno yedido, veeese ken gam ani, shehafach hazzeman laasher yachpotz. veyesh baze hanaa leyisrael sheyyaamod zechut haet, gam yaase Adonai devaro hattov bichvodo uveatzmo kemo sheasa avraham vechavash chamoro beatzmo, vehu amro vayyashkef Adonai.

rashi: Omer. shem midda:
Mispar nafshotechem. kefi minyan nefashot sheyyesh leish beoholo tikkechu omer lechol gulgolet:
ohc: Ish lefi achlo. perush, lefi shiur bene veto, im rabbim im meattim. veamar achlo, ki achilat kullan techashev achilat haish hattaluy bo, vehaed al ze ma sheamar achar kach "vayyamoddu vaomer vegomer ish lefi achlo" vegomer, vechazar lomar kamma yikchu lechol echad "omer laggulgolet", vechazar lomar mispar vegomer, lomar shello yaasu hefresh ben katan legadol ella mispar hannefashot, ki chullam yishvu baachilat hamman. veamro laasher beoholo, nitkavven lomar ki mi sheyyesh lo beoholo ish o ishsha sheen mezonotehem alav vehem bishchunato, sheggam lahem yikkach haish. uderashat rabbotenu zichronam livracha (yoma 75,1) tair enayim benifleot Adonai.

rashi: Uveruach appecha. hayyotze mishshene nechirayim shel af. dibber hakkatuv kivyachol bashshechina dugmat melech basar vadam, kede lehashemia ozen habberiyyot kefi hahove, sheyyuchelu lehavin davar; kesheadam koes yotze ruach minnechirav; vechen "ala ashan beappo" (tehillim 18), vechen "umeruach appo yichlu" (Iyov 4), vezehu sheamar "lemaan shemi aarich appi", (Yeshayahu 48) – keshezzapo nach, neshimato arukka, ucheshehu koes neshimato ketzara, "utehillati echetam lach" (sham) – ulemaan tehillati asim chotem beappi listom nechiray bifne haaf veharuach shello yetzu, lach – bishvilcha, echetam, kemo "neaka bechotem" bemassechet shabbat, kach nire beenay. vechol charon af shebbammikra ani omer ken; chara af kemo "veatzmi chara minni chorev" (Iyov 30), leshon serefa umoked, shehannechirayim mitchammemim venecherim beet hakketzef, vecharon miggizrat chara kemo ratzon miggizrat ratza, vechen chema leshon chamimut, al ken hu omer "vachamato baara vo" (Ester 1), uvenoach hachema omer "nitkarra" dato:

Neermu mayim. unkelos tirgem leshon armimut, uleshon tzachut hammikra kemo "aremat chittim" (Shir HaShirim 7), venitztzevu chemo ned yochiach: neermu. mimmoked ruach sheyyatza meappecha yavshu hammayim, vehem naasu kemin gallim ucheriyyot shel arema, shehem gevohim:
Chemo ned. ketargumo "keshur" – kechoma:

Ned. leshon tzibbur vechinnus, kemo "ned katzir beyom nachala" (Yeshayahu 17:11), "kones kanned" (Tehillim 33:7), lo chatuv kones kannod ella kanned, veillu haya kanned kemo kannod vechones leshon hachenasa, haya lo lichtov machnis kivnod me hayyam, ella chones leshon osef vetzover hu, vechen "kamu ned echad" (Yehoshua 3:13), "vayyaamdu ned echad" (sham), veen leshon kima vaamida benodot ella bechomot vetzibburim, velo matzinu nod nakud ella bimlafum kemo "sima dimati venodecha" (Tehillim 56:9), "et nod hechalav" (Shoftim 4:19):
Kafu. kemo "vechaggevinna takpieni" (Iyov 10:10), shehukshu venaasu kaavanim vehammayim zorkim et hammitzriyyim al haeven bechoach venilchamim bam bechol mine koshi:
Belev yam. bechozek hayyam; vederech hammikraot ledabber ken, "ad lev hashshamayim" (Devarim 4), "belev haela" (Shmuel 2 18), leshon ikkaro vetakpo shel davar:
ohc: Neermu vegomer nitztzevu vegomer kafu vegomer. perush, keneged shalosh melachot sheasa Adonai bayyam: ha, shennivkeu venitkabbetzu kullam yachad velo nisharu mefuzzarim bammakom happanuy, ella naasu kullan arema achat laasot midderach ragle yisrael. 2, hammemot shehayu mitkabbetzim uvaim veshofchim bayyam mehatztzedadin hayu nitztzavim bammakom shenneermu harishonim, vehu amro nitztzevu chemo ned nozlim. perush, otam shennozlim uvaim nitztzevu kemo ned. 3, lefi ma sheheelenu (Shemot 14:21) ki lo nechlak kol hayyam kede shello yitztarchu laredet leimke hayyam, chelek shello nechlak nikpa venaasa kayyabbasha, ucheneged ze amar "kafu" vegomer. uchevar katavti ki hahakpaa kadma labbikkua, vehu amro kafu tehomot belev yam, kodem shennikra kafa libbo venishar millibbo vamala mayim shello kafu venivkeu. vetaam amro tehomot leshon rabbim, ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 24,1) sheamru shehayyam nikra lishnem asar keraim, vechol makom umakom shennikra kafa sham hattehom, ucheneged kullam amar tehomot.

Vayyomer moshe vegomer. ulay ki mitzva zo moshe meatzmo dan otah, leheyot sheraa ki Adonai noten lahem devar yom beyomo, ze yaggid ki en yom echad mechin lachavero, vehevin davar mittoch davar veasar lahem. velaze amar hakkatuv "velo shamu el moshe", vekashe, lo haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyotiru" vegomer vaani yodea shello shamu.

Od lamma lo hispik lomar "velo shamu vayyotiru", vaani yodea ki lo shamu lammashmia? velidvarenu yavo al nachon perush velo shamu – lema shennitchakkem veasar lahem middato. ulederech ze yeduyyak gam ken amro bammaamar hakkodem laze "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai", ma shello amar ken bema shellefanenu. vetaam shehivish vayyarum tolaim, shehiskim Adonai al yado shehitzdik bisvarato sevarat chacham adif minnavi.

Veefshar lomar ki leolam mippi haggevura neemra lo mitzva zo, ella letzad shekkevar amar "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai", samach shekkol inyan perate dine hamman nimshach lema shehikdim lomar "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai", vehem lo hiskilu kavvanato vechashvu ki horaato horaat chacham lo hodaat navi.

rashi: Vechose vemoto tzaddik. kesheyyamut, hu batuach sheyyavo legan eden:
targum: Bevishuteh mistechef rashia udetachel demaet tzadika hu:

rashi: Tzintzenet. tzelochit shel cheres, ketargumo:
Vehannach oto lifne Adonai. lifne haaron; velo neemar mikra ze ad shennivna ohel moed, ella shennichtav kan befarashat hamman:
Asirit haefa. haefa shalosh sein vehassea 6 kabbin vehakkav 4 luggin vehallog 6 betzim, nimtza asirit haefa 43 betzim vechomesh betza, vehu shiur lachalla velammenachot:

Yechasyumu. kemo yechassum, vehayyod haemtzait yetera vo; vederech mikraot bechach, kemo "vetzoncha yirbeyun" (Devarim 8), "yirveyun middeshen betecha" (tehillim 36), vehayyod rishona shemmashmaah leshon atid, kach parshehu: tubbeu veyam suf kede sheyyachzeru hammayim vichassu otan. yechasyumu en dome lo vammikra binkuddato, vedarko lihyot nakud yechasyumo melafum:
Kemo aven. uvemakom acher "tzallu kaoferet", uvemakom acher "yochlemo kakkash", harshaim kakkash, holchim umittarfin olin veyordin, benonim kaeven, vehakkesherim kaoferet shennachu miyyad (mechilta):
ohc: Tehomot vegomer. lefi ma shepperashti (Shemot 14:21) ki chatzi hayyam nirka vachatzi nivka, vechol chelek yikkare tehom letzad hafelagat ribbuyo ushenehem yechasyumu, veayyen befasuk "kafu tehomot" (Shemot 15:8) beofen acher:
Yardu vimtzolot. yirmoz el otam shehayu mishtaddelim laalot mehayyam bechoach melechet hashshita, shehoridam leimke mayim, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 14:27) "vaynaer" vegomer:

rashi: Yirgazun. mitraggezin:
Yoshve pelashet. mippene shehargu et bene efrayim – shemmiharu et hakketz veyatzu vechazka kamforash bedivre hayyamim – vaharagum anshe gat (mechilta):
Yetad haohel. 182 belaaz, shettokin baaretz im shippule haohel lefoshto:
Hammakkevet. (targum:) arzafta, 289 belaaz:
Ballat. (targum:) beraz, cheresh:
Vattitznach baaretz. (targum:) uneatzat beara:
targum: Unesivat yael ittat chever yat sikkat mashkena veshaviat yat arzafta bidah vaalat levateh beraz unekishat yat sikketa betzideh uneatzat beara vehu demuch veishtalhi umit:

rashi: Ki asher reitem et mitzrayim vegomer. ma sheritem otam eno ella hayyom, hayyom hu sheritem otam velo tosifu od:
ohc: Hityatztzevu ureu. ulay shennitkavven lomar lahem sheyyityatztzevu bitfilla kemot shehayu omdim vetzoakim el Adonai kaamur besamuch "vayyitzaku vegomer el Adonai", vechen hu omer (Shmuel 1 1:26) "ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha" vegomer:

Asher yaase lachem hayyom. nitkavven beamro hayyom lehasir millibbam chashash ma sheavar bitziat mitzrayim, shearach ketz haggeulla miyyom shehitchila habbesora ad gemar haddavar shenem asar chodesh, laze amar lahem ki lo yaarich zeman milchama zo, ella hen hayyom yaase Adonai hatteshua.

Asher reitem et mitzrayim vegomer – kavvanat maamar ze efshar shennitkavven lehasir mehem happachad al ze hadderech, beamro: halo ma sheritem et mitzrayim hayyom hu letzad shello tosifu lirotam od ad olam. letaam ze hu sheheviam Adonai vehera Adonai otam lachem, kede shello yishshaer lachem shum mechush mehem leolam, vehu maamar hakkodem sheamar lahem (Shemot 14:4) "vechizzakti et lev paro" vegomer. vahagam sherau hassar, gam oto yitmadded lifnehem kemo shekken haya.

rashi: Hamibbeli en kevarim. vechi mechamat chesron kevarim – sheen kevarim bemitzrayim likkaver sham – lekachtanu mishsham. 310 286 paleynetzaa 14 106 paveshaysh velaaz:
Erev. kemo laerev:
Vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim. lefi sheamartem lanu ki hotzetem otanu, tedu ki lo anachnu hammotziim ella Adonai hotzi etchem sheyyagiz lachem et hasselav:
ohc: Erev vidatem vegomer. perush, letzad sheyyisrael dibberu bederech hachelatat hammenia sheyyimtzeu basar bammidbar, beamram "mi yitten mutenu" vegomer, velo shaalu haddavar kodem ze – yaggid ki haya lahem haddavar bilti efshar. laze amar lahem "erev vidatem ki Adonai" vegomer, ki ad atta enchem yodim hammotzi etchem ma nora maasav, velo lekachtem yedia mehammassot haggedolot ki kol yachol, achshav mechadash takkiruhu. vechavvanat devarav hu leshevet musar, ki tach merot enehem vegomer (Yeshayahu 44:18). vetaam shello tala hayedia ella bemaase erev velo bemaase boker, letzad shehu hammuflag etzlam bammenia. veamar vidatem betosefet vav, lomar millevad shettusar yirat mavet baraav, ella sheyyihye bederech mufla kemaase Adonai hannora hammotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim.

rashi: Halo tzivva. beyad moshe (Devarim 20:17): ki hacharem tacharimem, kach shenuya bimchilta (ba 12):
targum: Ushelachat ukerat levarak bar avinoam mikedesh devet naftali vaamarat leh hala pakad Adonai elaha deyisrael ezel vetitnegid betura detavor vetidbar imach asra alfin gavra mibbene naftali umibbene zevulun:

rashi: Vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim. iktorin shalach immahem, vechevan shehiggiu lishloshet yamim shekavu lelech velashuv verau sheenan chozrin lemitzrayim, bau vehiggidu lefaro bayyom harvii, bachamishi uvashshishshi radfu acharehem, lel shevii yardu layyam, bashshacharit amru shira vehu yom shevii shel pesach; lechach anu korin hashshira bayyom hashshevii:

Vayyehafech. nehpach mimma shehaya, shehare amar lahem "kumu tzeu mittoch ammi" (Shemot 12), venehpach lev avadav, shehare lesheavar hayu omrim lo "ad matay yihye ze lanu lemokesh" (Shemot 10), veachshav nehefchu lirdof acharehem bishvil mamonam shehishilum:
Meovdenu. meavod otanu:
ohc: Vayyuggad lemelech vegomer ki varach vegomer vayyehafech levav vegomer el haam. tzarich ladaat amro "ki varach" velo amar "ki halach", sheyyerae sherau bahem siman bericha. od kashe amro vayyehafech vegomer, mashma shennitchartu al haddavar asher asuhu, vehaddevarim temuhim – vechi lirtzonam asu? vahalo hukku makkot gedolot ad kimat safu vetammu, uveal karcho shillechum, veech yehafech libbam bedavar shello lirtzonam asuhu? vekashe od amram ma zot asinu vegomer, kemitraamim al atzmam al asot davar shello kahogen, vahalo lo asu ella beal karcham, uma yitonen adam al davar sheasao beal karcho?

Veefshar lomar al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (zohar 10 ma:) ki "haam" hu erev rav, uchemo shekkatavnu bitchillat happarasha. uferush hakkatuv kach hu: "vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim ki varach haam" – perush, haam asher shalach hu im yisrael letaam nachon etzlo lehashiv bene yisrael, hen atta barchu vehalchu lahem, uleellu yityaches habbericha, ki zulat habbericha en matztzilam miyyad paro ki hem ammo vaavadav.

Vayyehafech levav paro vegomer, perush shennichamu al asher shillechum, perush, laam, lo al yisrael. vayyomru ma zot asinu, perush, temuhim hem al maasehem sheshshillechu haam. vetaam hattemiha hu ki shillachnu et yisrael meavdenu, perusho al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 208) ki paro katav get shichrur leyisrael veamar lahem: hare attem leatzmechem, hare attem bene chorin. vehu amro shillachnu beget shilluchim, meavdenu sheen lahem mishpat eved. vahagam sheefshar sheala al datam sheyyachzeru, lo yaavod bahem od avodat eved, vechevan shekken tachzor haavoda hatztzericha lammelech al haam, umeatta kevan shebbarach haam mi yaavod. gam baze ramaz lamma lo chashshu al berichat haam hannizkar kesheyyargishu shettichbad haavoda alehem, velaze techef umiyyad hechinu atzmam lirdof. vehinne lefi ma shepperashti en hardifa ella al haam, veamar hakkatuv ki Adonai chizzek libbo shel paro vayyirdof gam achare bene yisrael velo laam bilvad.

Od nire al pi ma shepperashti befarashat bo (Shemot 10:7) ki taam shehikshu arpam paro vaavadav hu lechashvam ki divre Adonai bederech ze hem derech arma, veze yaggid ki lo yuchal asot kol cheftzo chas veshalom. vehinne beyom hakkot Adonai otam makkat bechorot vaymaddedem pegarim metim, raashu veraadu vehitzdiku haddevarim ki elohe yisrael kol yachol lehachariv olam, umikkol shekken mitzrayim. ulefi sevara zo yitchayyevu lomar ki ma sheamar Adonai "derech sheloshet yamim" en arma chas veshalom ella emet yehge, vehochachat paro mimma sheholchim kullam yachad enah hochacha, kattaam haamur bedivre moshe (sham) "ki chag Adonai" vegomer. veze haya lahem lemishan shehishilu mamonam leyisrael vehonam, ki nitchazzek belibbam ki shov yashuvu yisrael mitzrayim. gam lo chashshu ki asa Adonai haddavar bederech ze kede sheyyashilum, letzad shehikkiru shehaya Adonai yachol lehachericham gam al ze latet kol mamonam. uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 94) sheggillu matzpunehem bime choshech mitzrayim veyadu mitzrayim baze, veim ken mittaam ze haya lahem littol hakkol been roe.

Vechaasher higgid hammaggid lefaro, amar elav "ki varach haam", perush, lefi ma sheala bemaskanatam kefi hahochachot ki meAdonai lo haya haddavar behechlet halichot olam, im ken ma shello ratzu yisrael lachzor ki ratzu livroach mimmitzrayim velalechet halicha muchletet, velo min Adonai hu haddavar. laze vayyehafech levav paro vaavadav el haam, perush lo letzad hammotzi ki hammotzi adayin bechezkat ki lo hotzi ella leshaa, ella lema shennogea laam lamma lo chashshu lahem sheyyivrechu. vehu amram ma zot asinu ki shillachnu et yisrael meavdenu, perush, hagam shehaya lanu leshallecham ligzerat elohehem, af al pi chen lo hayinu sholchim otam bederech ze sheyyuchelu livroach meavdenu, ki hayu yecholin lishloach immahem chel mitzrayim verichbo ufarashav ad avod elohehem bammidbar veyashuvu lemitzrayim.

O yomar, ki beemtzaut hammaggid shehiggid shebbarchu, nithappech levav paro al ma shehichriu ki elohe yisrael kol yachol, vahare ze lecha haot beverur ki lo yachol al hakkol, mimma sheddibber derech arma. emor meatta bemofet chotech ki lo haya bo chas veshalom koach lehotziam behechlet vehutzrach lignevat daat, vedikdek hakkatuv lomar.

Levav – lomar ki shene levavot huchreu baddavar, ki hagam shebbattechilla kodem shillach yisrael haya choshev machashava zo ki en koach beyado lehotziam behechlet mimma sheshoel bederech ze, af al pi chen haya lo lev acher doche sevara zo veomer ulay ki eno chafetz bahem ella leshaa, umeatta parcha lah taana zo vehiskimu shene hallevavot yachad el haam levilti shallecham shehuvrar etzlam tzad haacher, veamru, ma peulla raa zot asinu ki shillachnu vegomer, shellemafrea anu roim shello haya yachol lehotziam behechlet mittaam shekkatavnu, laze "vayyesor et richbo".

rashi: Ketov zot zikkaron. shebba amalek lehizdavveg leyisrael kodem lechol haummot:
Vesim beozne yehoshua. hammachnis et yisrael laaretz, sheyyetzavve et yisrael leshallem lo et gemulo; kan nirmaz lo lemoshe sheyyehoshua machnis et yisrael laaretz (sham):
Ki macho emche. lechach ani mazhircha ken, ki chafetz ani limchoto:
ohc: Vesim beazne vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma nityached maamar ze lihoshua levad. veulay ki letzad sheraa yehoshua otzem hacheasat amalek vetakpo, velo haya bo koach laasot bo killayon ella shehechlisham levad, veyesh belibbo shel tzaddik ech lo asa Adonai ma sherauy laasot berasha ze, laze ba Adonai lehafig tzinnato vetzivva lemoshe lemor lo beazno, perush ki haddavar hu lehashiv lema shebbelibbo shel yehoshua, veamar lo ki lo yidag al haddavar, "macho emche" vegomer, udevar Adonai keillu kevar haya, vetihye zot nechamato.

Vetaam kefel "macho" vegomer, ulay sheramaz lanu zemannim sheyyimche bahem: 1 bime shaul, uchenegdo amar "macho", 2 bime mardechay, uchenegdo amar "emche", veachat leatid, uchenegdo amar "mittachat hashshamayim".
Chassalat parashat beshallach

rashi: Reu. beenechem ki Adonai bichvodo mazhir etchem al hashshabbat, shehare nes naase bechol erev shabbat latet lachem lechem yomayim:
Shevu ish tachtav. mikkan samchu chachamim 4 ammot layyotze chutz lattechum (eruvin nusach acher):
Al yetze ish mimmekomo. ellu alpayim amma shel techum shabbat (mechilta), velo vimforash – sheen techumin ella middivre sofrim – veikkaro shel mikra al lokte hamman neemar:
ohc: Reu ki Adonai vegomer. perashti lemala shennitkavven moshe lomar lahem ki mitzva zo eno tzarich leamrah hu lahem, ella hinne hem roim otah ki Adonai noten hammitzva mimmennu lahem belo shum emtzai, kemo shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 16:22) "vayyaggidu" vegomer, veze lemaalat hashshabbat ki yiru yisrael haddavar bechush harut. veamro al yetze ish, perush ki Adonai lo horid hamman letzad shello yitztarchu latzet ish mimmekomo vegomer, veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Shemot 16:28) "ad ana meantem":

rashi: Lanchotam hadderech. nakud pattach shehu kemo lehanechotam, "larotchem badderech asher telchu vah" (Devarim 1) shehu chemo lehareotchem, af kan lehanechotam ay shaliach, umi hu hashshaliach? ammud heanan; vehakkadosh baruch hu bichvodo molicho lifnehem, umikkol makom et ammud heanan hechin lehanechotam al yado, shehare ay ammud heanan hem holchim; ammud heanan eno leora ella lehorotam hadderech:
ohc: VaAdonai holech vegomer. amro lanchotam perush – lihyot lahem noach hadderech, ki letzad shehayu yeme hachom chofef Adonai alehem beammud anan leval yakkem hashshemesh. velaze lo haya meshammesh ammud heanan ella bayyom velo ballayla, veanan ze hu levad meanan hakkodem lahem leyashsher hammaakashshim lehashepil haggavoah ulehagbiah hannamuch uleharotam hadderech. veyesh reaya laze mimma sheamar hakkatuv befarashat devarim (Devarim 1:33) "haholech lifnechem badderech latur lachem makom lachanotchem baesh layla larotchem badderech asher telchu vah uveanan yomam", vehinne hizkir hakkatuv shelosha: haechad – latur lachem makom, ze haya meshammesh tamid lifnehem, perush makdim lalechet kodem lahem. hashsheni – ammud haesh larotchem vegomer, hashshelishi – uveanan yomam, vehem devarenu atzmam, sheanan ze lo haya ella chofef mehakkotam shemesh. velo kemo shepperesh Rashi "lanchotam" vechaser hei vehevi chaver "larotchem", ki lefi devarenu gam kan gam sham enah chasera hei, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Velayla vegomer lehair vegomer. kashe lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat 22:) sheamru shekkol arbaim shana shehayu vammidbar lo halchu ella leoro, shehayu roim afillu ma shebbetoch hattafiach. veen lomar ki al zeman hallayla hu omer, sheen ze peshat amram "lo halchu ella leoro", ki ma ba lemaet im lo shennomar or hashshemesh bayyom? veim ken hallayla lamma lo yair kayyom shello hayu tzerichin lashshemesh, shehutzrach leammud esh lehair lahem? ulehavin hainyan yesh ledakdek od amro lalechet yomam valayla, lamma lo hispik taam "lehair lahem" shehutzrach lomar "lalechet" vegomer?

Achen kavvanat haddevarim hi leolam shello zaz oro yitbarach mimmachane yisrael tamid, kemaamar chachamenu zichronam livracha shekkatavnu besamuch, ella sheyyesh ladaat ki haor hakkadosh hallaze lo haya mitpashshet chutz mimmachane yisrael ella davka bemoshvotam. veyesh taam baddavar, uma gam bammidbar hara shehu mador shel machane tuma, ki sham hirgia hakkelippa kayyadua bedivre hakkedoshim (zohar chelek 1 126.), vechevan shekken lo hayu yisrael yecholim lehanot mehaor haelyon ella bemachanehem, aval chutz lemachanehem layla yachshich keseder haolam. vehinne im lo hayu yisrael holchim ballayla kesheyyachpotz Adonai lalechet, lo hayu tzerichin leor ammud haesh ki lechol bene yisrael haya or Adonai bemoshvotam, ella lesibbat halichatam ballayla hutzrechu laammud lehair lemerachok chutz lemachane yisrael lehakkir makom sheyyelchu bo chutz lemachanehem, vehu amro lehair lahem, vetaam or ze hu lalechet yomam valayla, perush beshave, keshem shebbayyom millevad or Adonai hannotzetz alehem hayu roim or lemerachok beor hashshemesh hammeir laolam kullo, kemo chen hayu roim ballayla beemtzaut ammud haesh. uvaze yitam beur ma sheamar hakkatuv befarashat devarim (Devarim 1:33) "baesh layla larotchem badderech asher telchu vah", perush larotchem – kede larotchem, kede shettiru otam, lo kemo shepperesh Rashi lehareotchem vechaser hei vehevi mehanneviim umehakketuvim chaver lah, ki en anu tzerichim laze, uveer hakkatuv devarav ki devarenu yaggid beamro "larotchem badderech", velidvarav haya tzarich lomar "hadderech", ella hakkavvana hi lihyot shehaya lahem leyisrael or olam bemoshvotam velo badderech asher adayin lo bau shamma, laze amar ki ammud (anan) [esh] tamo hu kede sheyyiru badderech asher yelchu vah leshon atid, vehaven vehem devarenu atzmam. umeatta en hevdel ben hayyom lallayla livne yisrael, velo hayu makkirim zeman yom uzeman layla ella al yede hishtannut haananim.

Vayyachanu birfidim veen mayim. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (bechorot 5:) en refidim ella rifyon yadayim min hattora, yechavven hakkatuv lomar kesherafu yedehem min hattora shennimshela lemayim, laze gam Adonai mana mehem hammayim midda keneged midda.

rashi: Uvayyom hashshevii shabbat. shabbat hu, hamman lo yihye bo; velo va hakkatuv ella lerabbot yom hakkippurim veyamim tovim:
ohc: Sheshet yamim vegomer. hakkavvana baze lehazehiram leval yetzu lilkot, uferush lo yihye bo – lo yihye bo maase ze shel hallekita, sheim al havayat hamman kevar amar "lo timtzauhu bassade", velaze kesheyyatzu min haam lilkot amar Adonai lahem "ad ana meantem lishmor mitzvotay" vegomer, hare sheavru al hallav, vehechan matzinu azhara zo sheamar lahem ken? veim kavvanato al diyyuk hannishma meamro "sheshet yamim" levad, lav ze lo yikkare lav ella ase kedin lav habba mikkelal ase (fesachim ma,1), velo yutzdak lomar lahem alav "meantem lishmor" ki leshon shemira yeamer al hallav.

rashi: Allufe edom ele moav. vahalo lo haya lahem liro chelum, shehare lo alehem holchim? ella mippene aninut shehayu mitonnim umitztaarim al kevodam shel yisrael (yalkut shemauni):
Namogu. namassu, kemo "birvivim temoggenna" (tehillim 65), amru, alenu hem baim, lechallotenu velirash et artzenu (mechilta):
ohc: Az nivhalu vegomer. amro "az" lomar ki eno bazzeman sheddibber bo ad atta, shehu zeman shel hannichnasim laaretz, ella al zeman biat goalenu. velaze amar "az nivhalu allufe edom", vechen hu omer (Bamidbar 24:18) "vehaya edom yeresha", vegam az yachul zeman lizkot bemoav veammon. velaze amar ele moav yochazemo raad, vetaam shello hizkir ammon, ki gam hu meav, perush, im bitto ba, veaz gam ken nizke bechol hannishar mehakkenaani, vehu amro "namogu kol yoshve chenaan". veamar yoshve, lomar sheyyittaharu bahem afillu shear haammim. vetaam amro leshon avar ki devar Adonai keillu nitkayyem vehaya.

rashi: Teviemo. nitnabbe moshe shello yikkanes laaretz lechach lo neemar "tevienu" (bava batra 119):
Machon leshivtecha. mikdash shel matta mechuvvan keneged kisse shel mala asher paalta (mechilta):

Mikkedash Adonai. hattaam alav zakef gadol, lehaferido mittevat hashshem shelleacharav, hammikdash asher konnu yadecha Adonai. chaviv bet hammikdash, shehaolam nivra beyad achat, shenneemar "af yadi yasda eretz" (Yeshayahu 48), umikdash bishte yadayim, veematay yibbane bishte yadayim? bizman she yimloch leolam vaed" – leatid lavo shekkol hammelucha shello:
Asher dibbarnu elecha beeretz mitzrayim. vehechan dibberu? "yere Adonai alechem veyishpot" (Shemot Adonai) (mechilta):

Mimmutenu. measher namut, veim haya nakud melafum haya nivar mimmitatenu, achshav shennakud beshuruk nivar measher namut vechen "mi yitten mutenu" (Shemot 16) – shennamut, vechen "mi yitten muti" deavshalom (Shmuel 2 19) – sheamut. kemo "leyom kumi lead" (Tzefanya 3), "ad yom shuvi veshalom" (divrei hayamim 2 18) – sheakum, sheashuv:

Hashebea hishbia. hishbiam sheyyashbiu livnehem. velamma lo hishbia banav sheyyissauhu leeretz kenaan miyyad kemo shehishbia yaakov? amar yosef, ani shallit hayiti vemitzrayim vehaya sefek beyadi laasot, aval vanay lo yannichum mitzrayim laasot, lechach hishbiam lichsheyyiggaalu veyetzu mishsham sheyyissauhu:
Vehaalitem et atzmotay mizze etchem. leechav hishbia ken, limmedanu sheaf atzmot kol hashshevatim heelu immahem shenneemar ittechem (mechilta):
ohc: Pakod yifkod vegomer. taam hakkefel lehatzedik emunat haddavar. veze shiuro "pakod" perush, happekida shehivtiach Adonai vadday "yifkod". od yirtze lirmoz al shene devarim: al harechakat hannezek, hi hatztzalatam meoni mitzrayim umeol subbolam, vehakeravat hattoelet, sheyyetzu berov tuv levet yisrael, dichtiv (Bereshit 15:14) "veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol". vetaam sheramaz lahem davar ze lefi shehu nogea lashshevua, shello yihye lahem davar ze sibba limnia leval yaalu atzmotav letzad sheyyihyu terudim baasifat hon uteinat kesef vezahav ki yirbe, keamram zichronam livracha (bechorot 5:) sheen lecha adam miyyisrael shello taan asara chamorim mikkesef vezahav shel mitzrayim, veze yihye sibba limniat haddavar. laze amar hashebea vegomer lemor pakod yifkod gam pekidat haosher, veaf al pi chen tidchaku atzmechem vetisbelu atzmotay, hagam sheyyihye lahem meemtzaut ken hefsed keshiur massao mikkesef vezahav. vetimtza shekken asa moshe, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 100) shebbimkom sheyyiton kesef vezahav taan arono shel yosef bimkomo venatal secharo al haddavar.

Mizze ittechem. taam amro mizze, en lomar ki davka mishsham yaaluhu, ella nitkavven lechazzek hashshevua shettihye chazaka kedin hannishba al daat chavero bishvil tova sheasa lo, velaze hitna veamar mizze, perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84) befasuk "nasu mizze" – nasu mehaachva shehu minyan ze, vehu sheramaz lahem kan bishat hashshevua beamro mizze ittechem, perush ki beemtzaut chesed ze shehem nishbaim lo ma shehem hifriduhu mizze venasu meachvato veasu ma sheasu lo, achshav yetukkan haddavar veyihyu laachadim, vehu amro "ittechem" – yihyu chonim mehannesia lihyot ittam immam veneekar heavon hahu vahare hem yachad beachva, vehakkavvana baze ki machal lahem ma sheppashu bo bead chesed ze shennishbain lo, uchefi ze hinne hem nishbaim al dato bishvil tova sheasa lahem.

rashi: Berav am. shehatztzibbur zakkaim – haderat hakkadosh baruch hu hu:
Uveefes leom. kesheenam devekim bo:
Mechittat razon. chesron raznuto hu, kivyachol noten mikkevodo lelohe nechar umashlit et haummot al banav:
targum: Besugea deama hadereh demalka vehech divtzir ama mittevar parnaseh:

rashi: Basar leechol. velo lisboa; limmeda tora derech eretz sheen ochlin basar lasova. uma raa lehorid lechem babboker uvasar baerev? lefi shehallechem shaalu kahogen, shei efshar lo laadam belo lechem, aval basar shaalu shello kahogen, sheharebe vehemot hayu lahem, veod shehaya efshar lahem belo vasar, lefichach natan lahem bishat torach shello kahogen (yoma 75):
Asher attem mallinim alav. et haacherim hashshomim etchem mitlonnim:
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer betet vegomer. leheyot shebbattechilla amar haddevarim setumim erev vavoker, velo amar ma yihye erev vavoker, laze chazar uferesh ma sheamar "erev vidatem" hayedia hi betet Adonai.

rashi: Beyirat Adonai mivtach oz. neemar beavraham "ki atta yadati ki yere elohim atta" (Bereshit 22:12), vehivticho "ki varech avarechcha vegomer" (Bereshit 22:17):
Ulevanav yihye hu:
Machse. sheyyechasu veyitchabbe betzel zechuto:
targum: Dechalteh deelaha sivra deushna velivnoy neheve tuchelan:

rashi: Avor lifne haam. uree im yiskelucha, lamma hotzeta laaz al banay? (Shemot Rabba):
Vekach ittecha mizzikne yisrael. leedut, sheyyiru sheal yadcha mayim yotzim min hatztzur, velo yomru mayanot hayu sham mime kedem:

Umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor. ma talo "asher hikkita bo et hayeor"? ella shehayu yisrael omrim al hammatte sheeno muchan ella lefuranut – bo laka faro umitzrayim kamma makkot bemitzrayim veal hayyam – lechach neemar asher hikkita bo et hayeor, yiru atta sheaf letova hu muchan (mechilta):
ohc: Avor lifne haam vegomer. ulay sheyyada Adonai ki gadal hatztzimmaon baam veyihyu mistakkenim afillu bizman muat, laze amar ki midde avro yaavor lifne haam, perush bederech sheyyedu sheatta holech limtzo lahem mayim kede sheyyishkot esh hatztzimmaon mehem bene uvene, velo taavor derech shello yihye lifnehem, vegam kach immecha hazzekenim kede shettihye hahargasha.

Asher hikkita bo vegomer. veze yihye lenes atzum, ki ze asher hivish hammayim hannimtzaim vaasaam dam, yifol bechoach elyon peulla negdiyyit sheyyamtzi mayim lishtot haam. veyesh baze hachechashot muflaot menaggedot lammitchakkemim lehachechish ki hem pilot elohe yisrael, bematte ze tibbaka karkafto hachoshevet zarot.

rashi: Baelim. bachazakim, kemo "veet ele haaretz lakach" (Yechezkel 17). "eyaluti leezrati chusha" (tehillim 22):
Nora tehillot. yaruy millehaggid tehillotecha fen yimatu, kemo shekkatuv "lecha dumiyya tehilla" (Tehillim 65:2):
ohc: Mi chamocha baelim vegomer. perush, kevan sheanu roim mitzrayim shehu hassar mitzrayim shemo met, mi yidme laAdonai bivne elim?

Od nire al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 16,1) melech basar vadam keshennechba betoch haam eno nikkar ki hu ze, ma sheen ken elohenu ot hu bitzvao, vehu amro mi chamocha afilu kesheatta baelim belo shum hekker hammelucha rashum hu.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta) melech basar vadam morao al harchokim yoter mehakkerovim, aval hakkadosh baruch hu morao al hakkerovim yoter vechulei, vehu amro mi chamocha baelim ki sham makkirim yoter, aval battachtonim ematay mi chamocha – kesheatta nedar bakkodesh, kesheatta noten chozek veeder livchinat hakkedushsha, kemaase eretz mitzrayim asher hishpil geon resha veheedir hakkedushsha:

Od yirtze al derech amro "nehar dinur naged venafik min kodamohi" (Daniel 7:10), veamru zichronam livracha (chagiga 13:) ki mizzeat hachayyot shemmeziim beet sheomrim kadosh yotze nehar dinur, vehu amro nedar bakkodesh, perush keshemadderim oto bakkodesh, az letzad hammora shennichnas bachayyot keshemhallelim oto ose hannoraot hahu shemmeziim nehar dinur.

Nora tehillot ose vegomer. perush, yesh lakkol liro mehaggid tehillotav, letzad shemmaasav kullam pele, umi hu sheyyitztaddek bithillotav, ki en adam yassig daat hammufla leshabbeach bo, veech yehallo bemadrega ketanna kevan sheyyesh lo bechina muflet umechusset gedola vaatzuma.

rashi: Bechol-etzev. bechol yegia melacha yihye revach, aval divre hevel ach lemachsor:
targum: Bechol man deatzpa lach yeheve lach yuterana vesifvata yattirata lechuserana:

rashi: Ad ana meantem. meshal hedyot hu "bahade hutza lake cherabba" – al yede harshaim mitgannin hakkesherin:
ohc: Ad ana meantem. lefi ma sheheeleti befasuk "vayyaggidu lemoshe" ki moshe lo paal aven bema shello amar lahem kodem inyan ze, im ken ma makom lechollo im hammemaanim lishmor mitzvot Adonai? verabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava kamma tzav,1) amru: bahade hutza lake karva, vedivrehem zichronam livracha yatzdiku ki lo paal michshol. veli nire ki al kol panim lo yichlelennu hakkatuv im hashshear im lo haya laAdonai alav chut hassaara mehahakpada. vehitztzatzti bemaamar moshe besamuch lefasuk ze sheamar leyisrael "reu" vegomer, vetzarich ladaat nevua zo ematay neemra lemoshe, im neemra achar sheamar lo "ad ana meantem" – kushya lelohenu lamma lo tzivva lo kodem letzauot yisrael "al yetze ish" vegomer, veim neemra lo kodem – ech lo amarah moshe leyisrael?

Achen zo hi shigyono shel ish haelohim, ki hahitchakkemut shennitchakkem behasekalato bedivre Adonai betaam shello amar lo "dabber" vegomer, o "lemor" haya tzarich leamrah leyisrael, vehu lo amar lahem ella "hu asher dibber Adonai" vegomer, velo amar lahem hayyotze mimmaase ze asher asa Adonai lechem mishne shehu latet lahem hashshabbat bederech ze mimmennu lahem, al derech shepperashnu befasuk (Shemot 16:22) "vayyavou kol nesie haeda" vegomer. vehinne mizze yatza lahem sheyyatzu beyom shabbat kodesh min haam lilkot, ki chashvu kevan shello amar lahem azhara beferush ella dimfaresh lahem hainyan "hu asher dibber" vegomer, lo asu haregasha veyatzu lilkot velo chashshu laze ad achar kach kesheamar lahem "al yetze" vegomer, az amar hakkatuv "vayyishbetu haam" vegomer, ha lamadta ki lo chen mikkodem. asher al ken kelalo Adonai veamar "ad ana meantem". velaze kesheraa moshe shehikpid Adonai alav hevin haddevarim vetechef amar "reu ki Adonai" vegomer, vehem haddevarim shenneemru lo bitchillat devar Adonai beinyan ze (Shemot 16:5) "vehechinu et asher yaviu" uchemo shepperashti sham. vehinne mikkan atta lamed sheal ikkuv maamar ze leyisrael kelalo Adonai im hammemaanim, shehaya lo lomar leyisrael kavvanat Adonai kemo shehissig ladaat hu uchemo shepperashnu befasuk "vayyaggidu lemoshe". vesover ani ki en bedavar ze kede lehityasser beshevet musar gadol alav leamer lo "ad ana meantem", ki hu lo nitztavva vechiched velo avar afillu al chut hassaara, ella shehaya lo lehodia leyisrael ma shehissig bedaat elyon kede shello yishgu latzet kemo sheshshaggu veen baze onesh, laze amru zichronam livracha (bava kamma tzav,1) bahade hutza lake karva likkuy sheeno rauy lo.

Mitzvotay vetorotay. ki matzinu lahem sheavru al shete mitzvot: achat sheamar lahem "al yoter mimmennu" vehotiru, usheniyya sheamar lahem "tilketuhu uvayyom hashshevii lo yihye bo" hallekita, veavru veyatzu lilkot, laze amar "ad ana meantem lishmor mitzvotay". veamro vetorotay gam ken hem shete torot: achat ki Adonai amar lahem sheyyilketu omer laggulgolet vehem laktu yoter, uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (mechilta) beamro "velo hedif hammarbe", uvemaase shabbat gam ken lo hispik lahem ma shennatan lahem mishne yom shishshi veyatzu lilkot yoter meomer laggulgolet, usheniyya shello heeminu bemaamar Adonai ki beyom shabbat lo yihye bo veyatzu vegomer, veen lecha over al tora kaze sheeno maamin betorat moshe avdo.

targum: Dechalta deelaha mabbua dechaye lidmaste min pacha demota:
Uvarak redaf batar reticha uvatar mashrita ad tekof kerakke ammaya veitketala kol mashiryat sisra lefitgam decharev la ishtaar ad chad:
Vechaviu lesisra are selik barak bar avinoam letur tavor:
Shatya masle marduta daavuy udemizdahar bemachsenuta arima hu:
Veazlat yad bene yisrael azla vetakfa al yavin malka dichnaan ad di shetziu yat yavin malka dichnaan:
Hala tooyan dechashlin bishta vechisda ukeshot chashlin tave:
Deashek lemiskena chisuda avid levarye vedimrachem aliva yekareh:
Chatya shaet lechavreh uman deyahev lemiskena tuvohi:
Bechol atar aynoy dayya chamyin bevishe uvetave:
Vaamar lah barak im tezlin imi veezil veim la tezlin imi la ezil:
Merachek elaha orcheh derashia uderadef tzidketa nitrachem:
Veosifu bene yisrael lemebad devish kodam Adonai veehud mit:
Vaamarat devora levarak kum are den yoma dimsar Adonai yat sisra bidach hala malacha dayya nefak leatzlacha kodamach unechat barak mitura detavor veasra alfin gavra batrohi:
Vaamarat mezal ezil imach lechod are la tehe tushebachtach al orcha deat azel are beyad itteta yimsor Adonai yat sisra vekamat devora vaazalat im barak lekedesh:
Utevar Adonai beyoma hahu yat yavin malka dichnaan kodam bene yisrael:
Vesisra appech beraglohi lemashkena deyael ittat chever shalmaa are shelama ben yavin malka dechatzor uven bet chever shalmaa:
Lishana dechakkime mashpar yediata ufumehon desachle nabbia shatyuta:
Vetabber Adonai yat sisra veyat kol retichaya veyat kol mashrita lefitgam decherev kodam barak unechat sisra meal reticha veappach beraglohi:
Milta rechichta mehappecha chemta umilta deaziza maska rugeza:
Maftze nafsha sahada dekusheta udemalel kadavuta ramaya hu:
Veetattev al yedach lenachla dekishon yat sisra rav chela deyavin veyat retichohi veyat mashiryateh veemserine vidach:

bart: Eser tumot porshot min haadam. eser maalot zo lemala mizzo yesh betumot happorshot min haadam:
Mechussar kippurim. kegon metzora muchlat, vezav baal shalosh reiyyot, vezava, veyoledet, shettavlu veheeriv shimshan, asurin leechol kadashim ad sheyyaviu chapparatan. umuttarin batteruma:
Chazar lihyot tevul yom. tame shettaval velo heeriv shimsho:
Asur bakkodesh uvatteruma. ufosel otam im naga bahen:
Chazar lihyot baal keri. sheyyatza mimmennu shichvat zera velo taval:

Chazar lihyot boel nidda. veha delo tane chazar lihyot teme met shehu chamur mibbaal keri, ditme met av hattuma uvaal keri eno ella rishon, vahadar litne chazar lihyot boel nidda dechamur mitteme met, shemmetamme mishkav hattachton kaelyon, mishshum dehanach eser tumot porshot min haadam, vezo tumat magga hi:

Mishkav tachton kaelyon. mishkav hattachton shel boel nidda cheelyono shel zav, ma elyono shel zav tame letamme ochalim umashkin aval lo adam vechelim, af tachtono shel boel nidda tame letamme ochalim umashkin lo adam vechelim:
Sheraa shete reiyyot metamme mishkav umoshav. vetzarich lispor shiva nekiyyim. dehachi tenan perek kamma dimgilla (mishna 3) en ben zav haroe shete reiyyot lezav sheraa shalosh reiyyot ella karban:
Vetzarich biat mayim chayyim. dichtiv bezav (Vayikra 15) verachatz besaro bemayim chayyim. aval shear kol hattemeim saggi lehu veme mikve:
Chayyav bakkarban. heamur befarashat metzora gabbe zav. vechol zeman shello hevi karban have mechussar kippurim:
Metzora musgar. shemmasgiro hakkohen shivat yamim lirot im yivvaldu bo simane tuma:
Metamme bevia. im ba el habbayit nitma chol asher babbayit:
Ufatur min happeria umin happerima. delo amra tora begadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye parua, ella vimtzora muchlat:
Umin hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim. demuchlat shennitrappe mevi tzipporim umegalleach et kol searo, umusgar lo:
Sheen alav basar karauy. kedimfaresh bassefa chede lehaalot arucha:

Metamme vemagga uvemassa veeno metamme veohel. divmagga ketiv (Bamidbar 19) [veal] hannogea baetzem, mashma ben yesh bo vasar karauy ben en bo vasar karauy. uvetumat ohel ketiv, o veetzem adam o vekaver, veetzem adam mashma ad sheyyihye vo vasar vegidim vaatzamot:

Bemakom echad kede lehakkifo vechut erev. sheim yachtoch habbasar sheal haevar lechutim sheyyesh beavyan kechut erev, shehu yoter av michut hashsheti kiflayim, veyihye vahen kede lehakkif et haevar, beyadua divhachi hu maale arucha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haya ochel beeshkol. talash eshkol miggefen shebbagginna vehaya ochel veholech ad shennichnas lechatzer, vechatzer kovaat lemaaser, vaafillu achilat aray asura ad sheyyitrom viasser:
Rabbi eliezer omer yigmor. lo sheyyochal bechatzer. ella yetze chutz lechatzer veyigmor leechol haeshkol bagginna:
Lo yigmor. vaafillu bagginna, ad sheyyeasser:
Chashecha lele shabbat. vehaya ochel achilat aray, veshabbat kovaat lemaaser vaafillu achilat aray asura:
Yigmor. lemotzae shabbat, aval bashshabbat atzmo mode deasur:
Lo yigmor. afillu lemotzae shabbat, ad sheyyeasser. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Haochel teruma mezid. belo hateraa, deillu itru veh loke veeno meshallem. veaf al gav divlo hateraa chayyav mita bide shamayim, enah poteret min hattashlumin:
Veeno meshallem et hachomesh. delo chiyyeva tora chomesh ella laochel teruma bishgaga:

Hattashlumin chullin. detashlumin deshogeg bilvad karinhu rachamana kodesh, kedichtiv venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, aval tashlumin demezid chullin hen, vehoil vehen chullin im ratza hakkohen limchol mochel, ma sheen ken betashlumin shel shogeg sheim ratza limchol eno mochel, mippene shehen kodesh:

Min halleket min hashshichcha umin happea. mishshum deen bahem zikat teruma umaasrot, hilkach lo have bichlal davar harauy lihyot kodesh. velo dami lechullin metukkanim, dehanhu hayu reuyin lihyot kodesh kodem shennitkenu, aval leket shichcha ufea meolam lo niru lihyot kodesh:
Umin hahefker. leachar shezzacha vo:
Velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato. veaf al gav dehashta have kechullin hametukkanim, kevan dekodem shennittela terumato lo chaze, hasheta nammi lo chaze:

Sheen hekdesh pode hekdesh. veellu chashuvim kehekdesh kodem shennifdu, veen adam yachol liftor atzmo bemamon gavoah. vesavar rabbi meir maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu, vechevan dekodem shennifdu lo chazu tu lo chazu leachar shennifdu:
Vachachamim mattirin baellu. bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. vahalacha kachachamim:

Vechullam. eved veishsha sheachlu mittechilla behetter, beha kaamar rabbi eliezer deyivleu, aval ben gerusha o ven chalutza demeolam lo achlu behetter mode rabbi eliezer deyiflot, mide dahava attame hayita o temea hayta hatteruma kodem shennetanah letoch piv, demode rabbi eliezer deyiflot:
O shettaam taam pishpesh. sheretz, keshemmollin oto recho maus beyoter, vehu matzuy bakketalim uvammittot, vekorin lo baaravi 112 uvelaaz 241. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Zara achat mehen patur. shehazzorea et hatteruma beshogeg tzarich lehappech et hakkarka, veim lo hippech, haggiddulim teruma, vehacha patur, dichchullin hem:
Bedavar shezzaro chale. kegon chittim useorim, muttar lezarim, deen zo teruma vadday, vechashvinan la kegiddule [medumma] ditnan lekamman beferek 9‏ shehen chullin:
Bedavar sheen zaro chale. kegon shum uvetzalim, asur, veaf al gav dechashvinan leh kimdumma velo chitruma, bedavar sheen zaro chale yesh lehachemir tefe:
Hammaachil et banav ketannim. delav bene chiyyuva ninhu, vaavadav afillu gedolim:
Uterumat chutz laaretz. af al pi shehi medammaat, en mosifin chomesh aleha:

Ayarot hammukkafot choma. mimot yehoshua bin nun. devimtzora ketiv (sham 13) michutz lammachane moshavo, chutz lemachane yisrael. ucheshekkavash yehoshua et haaretz kiddesh haayarot shehayu mukkafot choma beyamav sheyyihyu kemachane yisrael lehishtalleach mishsham metzoraim:
Umesabbevim letochan met. muttar lenaso bair mimmakom lemakom ad makom sheyyirtzu tove hair lekavro sham:
Yatza. hammet min hair:
En machazirim oto. bair lekavro sham, vaafillu ratzu tove hair, dechevan deyatza tuma min hair en machnisin otah betochah:
En kotvin bimchubbar. mippene shemmechussar ketzitza:
Ketavo al hammechubbar vechulei. hachi kaamar, katav bimchubbar hattofes, shehu kol hagget kullo chutz mimmekom haish umekom haishsha vehazzeman:
Utelasho vachatamo. kelomar shekkatav hattoref shehu mekom haish vehaishsha vehazzeman achar shettelasho:
Kasher. dechevan shennichtav hattoref betalush, af al pi shehattofes nichtav bimchubbar, kasher:
Al hanneyar hammachuk. sheyyachol lachazor ulemochako ad haedim velichtov alav ma sheyyirtze, velo minnakkera milleta, shehare edim nammi al hammachuk hem chatumim:
Vediftera. en hammachuk shello nikkar. diftera, demaliach vekamiach velo afitz:

Vachachamim machshirin. begittin bilvad. disvira lehu ede mesira karte, vehaedim shehagget nimsar bifnehem hem ikkar haggerushin, lo ede chatima. aval bishar shetarot desamchinan aede chatima, modim chachamim sheen nichtavim lo al neyar machuk velo al diftera. vahalacha kachachamim:
Baggat haelyona. makom sheotzrim sham:
Vehattachtona. bor al pene haggat shehayyayin yored letocho:
Temea. chullin temeim yesh bah, ureuyin lo bime tumato, o lemi sheeno ochel chullin betohora, veim tippol letocho hatteruma hava leh medumma tame, veaf lakkohen lo chazya:
Sheim yecholim lehatztzil mimmenna reviit. im yachol lechazzer achar kelim ulehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora kodem shettered kullah vetittamme:

Yatztzil. yechazzer achar kelim veyatztzil, veaf al pi shebbetoch kach sheyyechazzer achar kelim tered min hatteruma lachullin shebbattachtona veyippasdu hachullin, lo yetamme hatteruma beyadayim lehatztzil hachullin, kevan sheyyachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit hallog betohora, shehu davar chashuv:

Veim lav. shello yimtza keli tahor, vesof sof kullah letuma azla, beha pelige, derabbi yehoshua savar yetammeenna bayyad, lehatztzil et hachullin, kidkatane sefa veal zo veal zo amar rabbi yehoshua vechulei. verabbi eliezer savar af al gav desof sof kullah letuma azla, lo yetammeenna bayyad lehatztzil hachullin. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Shehi metammea et boalah. tumat shiva. degabbe nidda chetiv (sham) utehi niddatah alav vetame shivat yamim, uchetiv nammi gabbe zava (sham) kime niddatah tihye temea hi. vedarshinan tihye temea, lerabbot et boalah. hi, hi metammea et boalah veen hazzav metamme et ma shebboel tumat shiva, ella tumat magga umassa:

Lemala min hazzava metzora. dimtzora ose mishkav umoshav kezava, vechamur mimmenna, shehu metamme bevia, keshebba el habbayit tame kol ma shebbabbayit veaf al pi shello naga, dichtiv (sham 13) michutz lammachane moshavo, melammed shemmoshavo tame. mikkan amru metzora sheyyoshev tachat hailan vetahor over, nitma hattahor. veim tahor yoshev tachat hailan umetzora over, lo nitma hattahor. vechen babbeged hamenugga uvaeven hamenuggaat. vedavka metzora bime chilluto, aval bime safro, dehaynu leachar tiglachat vetzipporim, eno metamme bevia veeno metamme bemishkav umoshav:

Lemala min hammetzora etzem kashsheora shehu metamme tumat shiva. dichtiv (Bamidbar lo) vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii utehartem, kol hattumot sheattem mittammein bemet lo yihyu pechutim mishshiva. veaf al gav dimtzora chamur meetzem kasseora, dimtzora metamme chol asher baohel keshebba el haohel, veetzem kasseora eno metamme veohel, mikkol makom bemaala zo miha etzem kasseora chamur, shemmetamme tumat shiva. vechen kol hane lemala lemala dachashiv, lav lechol mille kaamar dechamur bashsheni min harishon, deharbe mehen yesh sheyyesh chumra varishon sheenah bashsheni, ella leotah maala shehu mone bilvad kaamar shehashsheni chamur:

Chamur mikkullam met. yesh mehen chamurim mimmet, shezzav vezava osim mishkav umoshav umetammein beeven mesama, umet eno ose mishkav umoshav veeno metamme beeven mesama, umikkol makom bemaala zo met chamur mikkullan, shemmetamme beohel. uma shemmetzora metamme bevia, en tumato ketumat ohel, deim hichnis yado levayit hamenugga, tahor, vaafillu nichnas kullo chutz mechatmo, tahor, devia bemiktzat lav shemah bia. vaafillu mechitztza matztzelet bevayit shehammetzora sham, keditnan bingaim sof perek 13 nichnas levet hakkeneset osim lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim, nichnas rishon veyotze acharon. vechol kehay gavna vemet metamme veohel. i nammi yesh chilluk ben metzora yoshev limtzora over kidfareshna leel, ma sheen ken bemet:
Batla egla arufa. lefi shemmakkirin hayu bahem mi ragil laharog:
Batlu haeshkolot. ish shehakkol bo. kelomar toratam emet mibbeli dofi:

Hallappid. keen keara shel cheres mechuddedet millematta vetochavim chiddudah berosh kunedes, uvetoch otah keara notnim chatichot beged veshemen veitran, umadlikin umagbihin lemala vehi meira lemerachok. umippene shehi mechuddedet veenah yechola laamod bifne atzmah salka datach amena shello tittamme, ka mashma lan dehoil umekom moshavah metukkan umeyuchad lehoshivah berosh hakkunedes hare zo mittammea:
