Uvet shiko shel ner. keli cheres asuy lihyot hanner yoshev umeshukka bo:
Mittamme vaavir. dachashiv ketoch littamme vaavir, af al pi sheen kol hanner meshukka bo ki im meat mimmennu:

Hammasrek shel tzartzur. keli cheres sheosim al piv sevacha kemin michbar maase reshet vehameare mimmennu metil hammayim mimmekomot harebe, verov hakkelim sheshshotin bahem mayim beeretz yishmael asuyim kach, useviv otah sevacha boltim shinnayim keshinne hammasrek, sheosim otan lenoy. veim nitla sheretz baavir otan shinnayim, pelige vah rabbi eliezer verabbanan i chashiv toch keli cheres i lo. vahalacha kachachamim dechashve la toch umetammein:

Sheyyeshallem min hayyafe al hara. kegon sheachal gerogarot, ulefi midda sheachal gerogarot yeshallem temarim, velo lefi damim, dechevan divzuza achal uvezuza meshallem, may nafka minnah sheyyeshallem min hayyafe al hara. veikka leman deamar daafillu lefi damim matzinan lememar dei achal mide delo kafatz aleh zavena meshallem mide dekafatz aleh zavena:

Lefichach. sheen yachol leshallem mimmin acher, im achal kishshuim shel teruma shel erev sheviit veen kishshuim shel otah shana metzuyim od, shekkevar nitkashshu velo chazu laachila, umin acher eno yachol leshallem, tzarich lehametin lemotzae sheviit vishallem mikkishshuin shel motzae sheviit, demishshel sheviit asur lifroa chovo, dedame lischora:

Letoch shel teruma nafla. veshel chullin mutteret. vedavka bishte kuppot achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, talinan teruma letoch teruma nafla, sheyyesh hetter lishte hakkuppot. aval achat chullin veachat tevel o maaser rishon vechayyotze vaze, lo talinan shennafla hatteruma lattevel kede lehattir hachullin, meachar shehattevel nidma veneesar, demay chazet leesor kuppa zo yoter mizzo. vechen temea utehora talinan battemea, o medummaat vesheenah medummaat talinan bammedummaat. kelala demilleta, kol hecha deachat enah mitkalkelet, talinan bah:
Achal achat mehen patur. deshemma shel chullin achal:
Vechayyevet bechalla. desafek chullin hi:
Verabbi yose poter. dechevan delo yedia hava leh kimdumma defatur min hachalla. vahalacha kerabbi yose bechol hanne telata bave dematnitin:
Achal. adam acher et hashsheniyya, patur:
Kakketanna shebbishnehen. lehakel:
Bat yisrael. shehifrisha teruma velo natna otah lakkohen vaachalatah shogeg:
Veachar kach nisset lakkohen. vahare hi reuya leechol bitruma, deeshet kohen ochelet bitruma:

Meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah. shehare im hayta otah teruma sheachla achshav beayin lo hayta chayyevet littenah lakkohen, dehi naaset kohenet benissueha, hilkach atta nammi hattashlumim hen shellah:
Meshallemet keren labbealim. kedin gozel chavero, aval hachomesh teakkev leatzmah:

Metammeim et haadam bemassa. mishshehigbiah echad mehen, ben beyado ben shehigbiho chavero al ketefo. vaafillu shello naga hu vattuma, o shehayta hattuma keshura vechevel vehigbiah hattuma al yede hachevel, kevan shehenia koved haddavar hattame beatzmo nitma haadam tumat massa letamme begadim shealav, o chol begadim vechelim shehu nogea bahen, chutz mikkele cheres, kol zeman shehattuma al gabbav. aval leachar shepparash min hattuma eno metamme chelim bingia, lefi shehannose et hattuma, leachar shepperash mimmenna eno ella rishon lattuma, veen kelim mekabbelim tuma ella meav hattuma. vaafillu vizman shehu nose et hattuma eno metamme adam uchele cheres, ella shear kelim bilvad. veen lecha tame tumat massa ella haadam bilvad, velo chelim velo ochalim umashkim, sheim hayu chelim rabbim ze al gav ze unevela o me nidda bakkeli haelyon, lo nitmeu hakkelim hattachtonim bemassa kol zeman shello nagu vannevela o veme hannidda. vechen ochalim umashkim en temeim tumat massa, degabbe tumat massa chetiv lachem, vedarshinan lachem hem metammeim bemassa veen metammeim lo chelim velo ochalim umashkim bemassa. ucheshem shehannevela metammea vemassa, kach metammea vehesset, shehesset mimmin massa hu, kegon shehaya etz munnach berosh hailan o verosh hakkotel unevela bekatze echad shel haetz uva adam vehichria bakkatze hashsheni, kevan shehigbiah hakkatze shebbo hannevela mechamat hacheraato, nitma tumat hesset, dahave chenose:

Vachasuche vegadim bemagga. kelomar menuim habbegadim mittuma i ikka magga belo massa, shehannogea bannevela o veme hannidda veeno nosam eno metamme afillu vegadim shealav, kedichtiv (Vayikra 11) hannogea benivlatam yitma ad haarev, velo nizkar sham kibbus begadim, uveme hannidda nammi chetiv (Bamidbar 19) vehannefesh hannogaat titma ad haarev. chasuche, leshon menia. kemo velo chasachta et bincha (Bereshit 22):

Boel nidda. ketiv beh (Vayikra 15) utehi niddatah alav, lamadnu shehu metamme mishkav umoshav kenidda, uchetiv batreh vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma, veen tzarich lomar, ella lefaroshe utehi niddatah alav deresha ata, vehachi kaamar, hay utehi niddatah alav sheamarti lecha, lo amarti ella leinyan sheyyihye av hattuma chenidda, ma hi metammea adam uchele cheres af hu metamme adam uchele cheres, aval laasot mishkav umoshav kol asher yishkav alav yitma hu, velo yetamme adam vechelim kemishkav hannidda shemmetamme adam vechelim, ella din rishon lattuma yesh lo shemmetamme ochalim umashkin bilvad:

Mishkav tachton kaelyon. kelomar, mishkav tachton shel boel nidda keelyono shel zav, ma elyono shel zav hayenu kelim sheal gabbe hazzav kegon eser matztzaot zo al gav zo vechullan al gabbe hazzav, ben shennaga bahen hazzav ben shello naga, temein umetammein ochalin umashkin aval lo adam vechelim, af tachtono shel boel nidda dehaynu hammatztzaot shettachtav metammein ochalim umashkin velo adam vechelim. deillu tachtono shel zav vezava venidda veyoledet, afillu eser matztzaot zo al gav zo veechad min hattemein hallalu baelyon, kullan shettachtav temein umetammein adam vechelim:

Lemala mehen zovo shel zav vechulei. mishshum dehanach dachashiv veazel metammein bechol shehen bemagga uvemassa, uvoel nidda en metamme ad sheyyissa et kullo, mishshum hachi katane lemala mehen, kelomar dehanach dachashiv hen lemala mibboel nidda, lefi shehen metammein bechol shehen, ma sheen ken bevoel nidda:
Shehem metammein bemagga uvemassa. sheshshave maggaan lemassaan, deven bemagga ben bemassa metammein adam letamme begadim vechelim chutz meadam uchele cheres:
Merkav. hattefus shel ukkaf karuy merkav. shehaukkaf atzmo sheadam rochev alav tame mishshum moshav, vehattefus shello tame mishshum merkav:

Shehu metamme tachat even mesama. even gedola ucheveda. kedichtiv (Daniel 6) vehetayit even chada vesumat al pum gubba. veim hayta even gedola al gabbe hattefus shel merkav vehazzav tofes bah, af al pi sheen kavdo shel zav nikkar al hammerkav, nitma hattefus shettachat haeven mishshum merkav:

Lemala min hammerkav mishkav. diveven mesama metamme mishkav kemo merkav, veod chamur mimmennu deshave maggao lemassao letamme adam letamme begadim. maggao vehedya chetiv beh (Vayikra 15) veish asher yigga bemishkavo yechabbes begadav. umassao, dilachar shehizkir hakkatuv din magga hammishkav vedin magga shel merkav neemar vehannose otam yechabbes begadav, alma bemishkav ben magga ben massa teunim kibbus begadim, aval bemerkav chillek hakkatuv ben magga lemassa, dichtiv (sham) vechol hammerkav asher yirkav alav hazzav yitma, veillu yechabbes begadav lo chetiv:

Veen mishkav ose mishkav. dichtiv (sham) kol hammishkav asher yishkav alav hazzav yitma, zav ose mishkav veen mishkav ose mishkav. vehilkach im naga mishkav hazzav bechelim enam ella rishon lattuma. nimtza zav lemala mimmishkav:
Chavit shiurah bigrogarot. regilim hayu lehaniach gerogarot bechavit:
Rabbi meir omer bezetim. kistam matnitin dilel. vehave setam veachar kach machaloket veen halacha kistam. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hallefas vehakkedera shiuran bezetim. lehachemir. kidfareshna leel:

Happach vehattefi. kele shemen hen. ella shehattefi piv tzar meod, lechach nikra tefi sheen yored mimmennu ella tippin tippin. utefi ditnan befirkin dilel shehu tahor, hayenu keshehitkino lechassot bo sal shel anavim kidfareshna leel:
Beshamen. hayenu kones mashke shel shemen. veen shiuro shave lemayim, deshel shemen dak, shehare cheli shemmachazik mayim o yayin eno machazik shemen:
Hatztzartzur. keli asuy lishtot bo mayim veal piv sevacha kemaase reshet shello yikkanes letocho davar ra veyittanfu hammashkin:

Shelashtan. happach vehattefi vehatztzartzur, shiuran benekev motzi zeronim, kegon haafunim. desavar rabbi shimon dilzeronim nammi avide, vahavu chemo heasuy lechach ulechach dilel dimtilin oto lechumro. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ner shiuro veshamen. bechones mashke shel shemen. distam ner leshemen avid:
Rabbi shimon omer bifruta ketanna. desavar avid nammi leannoche veh perutot, umetilin oto lechumro. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ner shennittal piv. batal shem ner mimmennu:
Veshel adama. eno mekabbel tuma kol zeman shello nitzraf bechivshan. veaf al pi shehussak pi hanner biftila haddoleket, la chashiv bechach keillu nitzraf bechivshan, vetahor:

Haddakkin shebbichle cheres. kele cheres haddakkin uketannim, ben shehen atzman enan machazikin ella chede sichat katan, ben shennishberu venisharu karkerotehen, perush, kemo karkeotehen dehaynu shulayim shekkelappe hakkarka, o nisharu dafnotehen vicholim levaddan leshev belo semicha, adayin kelim hen. veim machazikin shemen kede sichat katan, kelomar kede sichat etzba ketanna shel katan ben yomo, temein. vehachi meforash bemassechet shabbat, sichat katan, evar katan shel katan ben yomo:
Ad log. shiur ze shel sichat katan, leshivre cheli shello haya mittechillato ella log. deim haya techillato yoter millog, bainan shiur gadol lishvarav yoter mikkede sichat katan:
Millog vead sea. keli shehaya mittechillato machazik millog veyoter millog ad sea, shiur shevarav birviit hallog. uleyater missea ad seatayim, shiur shevarav bachatzi log. vechen kullam:
Ani eni noten bahem midda. lefi godel hakkeli vekatno, ella lefi hammekomot shergilin laasotan ulefi tzurat hakkelim:
Ella haddakkin shebbichle cheres vechulei. sheen lahem tzurat kederot vehem ketannim beyoter, shiur shivrehen kede sichat katan. umishshehiggiu lihyot ketavnit kederot ketannot, shiuran birviit:
Chaviyyot ludiyyot. chaviyyot shennaasot belod:
Lachmiyyot. shennaasot bevet lechem. vehen gedolot meotan shennaasot belod:
Chatzavim gedolim. kaddot gedolot kol ma sheefshar:
Happakkin haggelilim. shennaasim beeretz haggalil:
Vehechaviyyonot. chaviyyot ketannot. vehayenu dakkin shebbichle cheres:
Veen lahen defanot. dedavka hashshulayim temeot im nishar bahen kede sichat katan, aval haddefanot tehorot. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Higbihah. kedin teruma sheola beechad umea:
Hare zo mutteret. vetzarich leharim:
Ad shettirbe teruma al hachullin. dehaynu ad sheyyippelu sham chamishshim veechad shel teruma, aval mechetza al mechetza share:
Hattehorim shebbichle cheres. peshute chele cheres shehen tehorim, dichtiv behu (Vayikra 11) asher yippol mehem el tocho, et sheyyesh lo toch tame, et sheen lo toch tahor:
Tavla sheen lah lizbez. luach chalak sheen lo safa saviv:
Umachta. shechotim bah gechalim:
Perutza. sheen lah defanot:
Abbuv shel kallaim. keli cheres shekkolim bo kitniyyot al gabbe haesh. ufashut hu velo vet kibbul, umenukkav kichvara veshulav kede shettehe haur sholetet bo:
Kallaim. kemo kaluy baesh:
Vesilonot. marzevot:
Af al pi chefufin. af al pi shekkefufin mishshene tziddehen. vehu shello chakak bahen bet kibbul tzerorot:
Kavkav. keli shemmechassim bo sallim shel pat. veyesh gorsin kafkaf. shekkofin oto al gabbe hassal. vaafillu yesh lo bet kibbul, tahor. shekkol hameshammesh kafuy bichle cheres, tahor:

Vehattefi. hu keli cheres sheyyesh lo vet kibbul umekabbel tuma, dehachi mochach lekamman beidach pirka. vehay detahor hacha, mishshum dehitkino laanavim veasa bo shinnuy, mochiach dilchassot bo anavim ka bae leh velo naasa lekabbala:

Chavit shel shayyatin. kemin chavit chalula, usetuma hi veen lah pe, kede shello tehe nishkaat bammayim. venishanim aleha ulemedin lashut bah. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah bet kibbul, enah asuya lekabbala. vechol sheeno asuy lekabbala af al pi sheyyesh lo vet kibbul eno mekabbel tuma:

Vechavit defuna veshule hammachatz. machatz hu cheli gadol shel cheres, ucheen chavit asuy lo veshulav sheadam mesim yado letochah kesherotze lehagebiah hammachatz. ulefi shello naaset chavit zo lekabbala, enah mekabbelet tuma:
Defuna. temuna:
Vehammitta vehakkisse vehassafsal. kol ellu en asuyin lekabbala:

Vehassefina. af al pi sheasuya lekabbala vaafillu hi shel cheres, tehora. uvemassechet shabbat yalfinan la dichtiv (Mishlei 30) derech oniyya velev yam, ufeshita dooniyya vayyam hi, ella lomar lecha ma yam tahor af oniyya tehora:

Kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres en lo achorayim. chachamim gazru al mashkin temein sheyyetammeu chelim, veaf al pi shello nitmeu hammashkin ella mechamat sheretz, dehashta hen rishon lattuma, metammeim kelim middivre sofrim, veim nagu vaachore hakkeli nitmeu achorav velo nitma tocho. vehasheta ka mashma lan deen tumat achorayim noheget ella bichli cheres sheyyesh lo toch. aval kol sheen lo toch en lo tumat achorayim, veim nagu mashkin temeim meachorav lo nitmeu achore hakkeli:
Veim yesh alav orrim. shehabbaal mearer shehu mezuyyaf:

Yitkayyem bechotmav. im yaidu haedim al chatimat yedehem, o edim acherim yakkiru chatimatam, kasher. uvazzeman hazze, hammevi get ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutz laaretz tzarich litteno lah bifne shenayim vetzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. veim chatimat haedim nikkeret bimkom netinat hagget venitkayyem hagget bechotmav, en tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:
Veeno yachol lomar. kegon shennetano lah keshehu pikkeach velo hispik lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam ad shennitcharesh:
Sefek tuma. kegon shete chaviyyot birshut hayyachid venaga sheretz beachat mehen velo yedia lehe minnayhu, ushetehen teluyot:
Bimkom hatturpa. makom shel hefker veomedet lippased sham:

Yannichenna bemakom hammutzna. daadayin muzhar al shemiratah, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) et mishmeret terumotay, bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma tehora veachat teruma teluya, detarvayhu bau shimmur:
Rabbi yehoshua omer vechulei. desavar terumotay ketiv belo vav, veyesh em lammasoret:
Al yechaddesh bah davar. sheen tzarich leshamrah, veaf asur ligrom lah tuma. vahalacha kerabban gamliel:
Nikkure teenim. teena shennire vah nikkur, asur, shemma nikker bah nachash vehittil bah eres:
Afillu hen kikkar. kelomar shehen gedolim harebe vehannikkur mitztzad echad, lo yomar hu achal mitztzad echad, ani mitztzad acher:
Kol sheyyesh bo lecha. haeres mitarev im hallecha umitchalchel bechullo. aval bedavar yavesh chotech et hannikkur veochel et hashshear:
Uneshuchat hannachash. behema shenneshachah nachash ushechatah, asura, shehaeres mitchalchel bechol gufah:
Gistera. shever keli cheres. vedavar shennechlak lishnayim karuy gistera. uleshon gistera, gise tere:

Shennimtzet bakkivshan. velo yadinan im nishbar kodem shennitzraf bakkivshan uveshaa shennigmera melachto lo haya torat keli alav vetu lo mittamme mishshum gistera, o achar kach nishbar umittamme. vechetzad mevarrim et haddavar, roin im hayu shevareha shavin vetochah maadim, beyadua shennigmera melachtah veachar kach nishbera, umittammea, daavid lekibbul, shedderech latet gistera tachat hechavit lekabbel hammashke hannotef mimmenna:

Titros. keli shehu menukkav millematta nekavim harebe dakkim kimlo nekev machat umillemala nekev echad kimlo chush, dehaynu felech shehannashim toot bo, ucheshemmemalleim oto mayim veadam mesim etzbao vannekev millemala shello yishlot bo haruach en tippa achat yotzet min hannekavim dakkim shellematta, ucheshemmesir etzbao hammayim yotzim:
Rabbi eliezer bar tzadok metaher. lefi shennakuv bechones mashke:

Verabbi yose metamme. shekkach hu derech tashmisho, vachashiv bet kibbul hoil vehammayim omdim al yede hanachat etzba, vaafillu velo hanachat etzba en hammayim yotzim ella chemotzi ferutot meat meat tippa achar tippa, umishshum hachi la chashiv nakuv kechones mashke littaher bechach. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Chattat mikkan. perida hameforeshet lechattat letzad echad, uferida hameforeshet leola latztzad hashsheni, ushete feridot shel ken setuma baemtza:
Parach min haemtza. perida achat leyamin uferida achat lismol:
Lo hifsid kelum. deoto shemmeorav im hachattat yaase chattat, veoto sheim haola yaase ola, aval lo chattat, deshemma yaasuhu min haola hameforeshet:
Chazar laemtza. chazru min hatztzedadim echad mikkan veechad mikkan venitarvu yachad, ellu yamutu, dechattat veola nitarvu yachad. aval otan shennisharu kol echad levaddo, kerevim kol echad kedino:
Chazar. min haemtzaiyyim latztzedadim, hare chattaot veolot meoravim, veyamutu chullan:
En meviim torim keneged bene yona. ella o shenehem torim o shenehen bene yona:
Tichpol vetavi olatah ben yona. kedin hachattat. shehachattat hi ikkar, ben shehifrishattu techilla ben shehifrishattu vassof:
Holchin achar harishon. veenah mevia hashsheni ella mimmin shehifrisha varishon, ben shehaya harishon chattat ben shehaya ola. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Lo yaviu hayyorshim chattatah. dehavya chattat shemmetu vealeha. vei lo mehay taama, meviim chattat af al pi shekkarva ola techilla. veaf al gav divchol makom chattat kodemet leola, hayenu davka lemitzva aval lo leakkev:
Ose vet din. shaliach, umeshallecho:

Sheliach bet din ani. umistama bet din asu haddavar behechshero. veshaliach sheni memanne shaliach shelishi ad mea, vechullan bevet din, midditnan bematnitin en hashshaliach haacharon kulei‏ ella omer sheliach bet din ani:

Chattat veola usetuma umeforeshet. shete nashim shellakchu shelosha kinnin, zo tzericha ola veken shalem, dehaynu shete olot vechattat achat, vezo tzericha chattat veken shalem, dehaynu shete chattaot veola achat, ufershu echad min hakkinnin perida ola lazo uferida chattat lazo, veechad min hakkinnin hinnichu setuma shello fershu ezo ola veezo chattat, vehashshelishi pershu ezo ola veezo chattat, aval bealim lo nitparshu, hare chattat lazo veola lazo veken setuma veken meforeshet, vetzarich lehakeriv shene hakkinnin hallalu setam al shetehen, haolot lemala vechattaot lematta, veola lazo vechattat lazo tzarich lehakeriv leshem bealim. veim netanam hakkohen chetzyan lematta vechetzyan lemala, en keshera ella setuma, dehe minnayhu daavad ola vehe minnayhu daavad chattat, kasher, kevan shekkol ken veken haya bifne atzmo:
Mitchalleket benehem. hoil uveeruv lekachum, haachat yatza yede chattat vehaachat yatza yede ola:
Karkom. targum matzor karkomin:
Hammittarefet. vaadayin lo tava:
Liddon. bedine nefashot:
Bat yisrael lechohen. chumre metim:
Bat kohen leyisrael. chumre chayyim:
Kissuy kadde yayin vechulei. vechol hameshammesh kissuy bichle cheres, tahor, detocho ketiv, vehay lav toch dideh hu:

Vechissuy chaviyyot neyariyyot. al shem mekoman. velirvuta naktinhu, mippene shehaya lechissuy chaviyyot shellahen bet kibbul. veit degarse vehanneyarot, kelomar, hanneyarot shemmechassim bahen pi hatztzelochit:

Hallefas. kemo ilpas. machavat gedola shemmevashshelim bah basar veyarak, veosim lah kissuy shel cheres. ucheshehu nakuv eno rauy lichlum, vaafillu eno nakuv veyesh lo chiddud en yachol leshev mippene hachiddud, aval kesheeno nakuv veaf en lo chiddud, tame, sherauy lehafcho ulehoshivo, veishsha notenet betocho yarak lesanneno lehimmatzot mimmennu hammayim:
Haruneki. hayerakot leachar shennitbashshelu udevukim ze vaze venaasim guf echad nikraim runeki. vehi milla yevanit:

Hattohora bittela et hattaam. tohora sheppaska miyyisrael, bitlah taam happerot verecham. shebbizman shehayu yisrael tehorim veoskim battohora af hakkadosh baruch hu haya metaher et happerot mittaam ra vereach ra:
Maaser bitel shomen dagan. demaaser ikkere chelev, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 18) kol chelev yitzhar:

Kele etz kele or kele etzem. befarashat mattot ketiv vechol beged vechol keli or vechol maase izzim vechol keli etz titchattau, umerabbinan mivvechol maase izzim lerabbot davar habba min haizzim min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim, dehaynu kele etzem, veittakkash lichle or uchele etz. uvefarashat shemini ittakkush kele or uchele etz lesak, dichtiv mikkol keli etz o beged o or o sak. hilkach peshutehen tehorim, devainan dumeya desak demittaltel male verekan. uchele cheres af al gav difshutehen tehorim lo matze lemitne vahade hanach, mishshum dechol hane tehorim kesheen lahem bet kibbul af al pi sheyyesh lahen toch, kegon chavit shel etz sheen lah shulayim umefulleshet meever el ever tehora, uvichli cheres kehay gavna tame, mishshum divtocho tala rachamana vahare yesh lo toch af al pi sheen lo vet kibbul. ufeshutehen tehorim ditnan hacha, hayenu middeorayta, aval chachamim gazru tuma al peshute kele etz veor vaetzem, kidmuchach baggemara bava batra [daf 66]. umiddeorayta nammi enan tehorim ella mittumat met o tumat sheretz, aval temeim tumat mishkav umoshav im hen reuyin lemishkav umoshav:

Uchele zechuchit. rabbanan gazru alehen tuma, hoil utechillat beriyyatan min hachol havu chichle cheres, vachamire mikkeli cheres sheeno mekabbel tuma miggabbo, uchele zechuchit mittammein miggabban hoil venire tochan kevaran. ufeshutehen shel kele zechuchit tehorim afillu midderabbanan, daavadu rabbanan hekkera ki hechi dela lisrof alayhu teruma vekadashim:
Mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. aval lo chazru letumatan yeshana, delo gazzur rabbanan sheim asa mehem kelim chazru letumatan yeshana ella bichle mattachot bilvad:
Kele neter. kelim haasuyin meadama shechofrim mimmenna tzarif, 87 belaaz:

Mittammein umetammein baavir. im nitlet tuma baavir hakkeli, nitma hakkeli. chazar vetala ochalim baaviran, metammein et hoochalim af al pi shello nagu, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) kol asher betocho yitma. vaafillu male chardal sheeno nogea bedafnot hakkeli:

Umittammein meachorehen. kelim shechakak bet moshavam mibbachutz kederech sheosim lechosot shel kesef, ufeamim kofin otan al pihen umishtammeshin bevet kibbul shebbaachorehen. im naga tuma veoto vet kibbul, nitma hakkeli cheres. umiddelo arvinhu vetanninhu, mittammein umetammein meavirehen vaachorehen, shema minna deen mittamme meavir achorav, dela chashiv toch shel achorav toch gamur deorayta littamme meaviro, aval mittamme im naga tuma beoto chakak shel achorav:

Veen mittammein miggabbehen. dichtiv (sham) ucheli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho, mittocho hu mittamme veeno mittamme miggabbo. ushear kol hakkelim chutz mikkele cheres uchele neter en mittammein meaviran ad shettigga hattuma veatzmo shel keli, ucheshennaga hattuma veatzmo shel keli ben miggabbo ben mittocho tame. vehayenu ditnan beferek kamma dechullin, hattahor bichle cheres tame vechol hakkelim, hattahor bechol hakkelim tame vichle cheres:
Usheviratan hi tohoratan. vechullehu kelim nammi sheviratan hi tohoratan. ella chele cheres uchele neter sheviratan bilvad metaharatan, sheen lahem tohora vitvila ella vishvira bilvad:

Avot hattumot. hashsheretz. shemona sheratzim hakketuvim befarashat vayhi bayyom hashshemini, hacholed vehaachbar vechulei, hen avot hattumot letamme adam vechelim hannogim bahem bemotam, veshiuran letamme bechaadasha, shekken hachomet techillat beriyyato vechaadasha. aval haevarim en lahem shiur, afillu fachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz metammein. vedavka cheshehu lach hashsheretz metamme, veeno metamme yavesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechol asher yippol alav mehem bemotam, keen motam:

Veshichvat zera. davka shichvat zera deyisrael vegadol, aval denachri enah metammea afillu midderabbanan, dekeryo shel nachri tahor gamur. vechen shichvat zera shel katan nammi lo metammea, dichtiv (sham 15) veish ki tetze mimmennu shichvat zera, ish velo katan pachot mibben tesha shanim veyom echad, deen biato via. veshiurah laroe, bemashshehu, afillu keen chardal. velannogea, bechaadasha. vedavka shichvat zera lacha metammea, dichtiv shichvat zera, biruya lehazeria. umiddelo kachashiv tanna didan baal keri bahade avot hattumot, shema minna deeno ella rishon lattuma, vehachi tenan besof massechet zavim, baal keri kemagga sheretz, delo have ella rishon:

Uteme met. adam shennitma vemet. aval kelim shennagu vemet hen kammet atzmo, vehannogea bahen naase av hattuma. vechelim shennagu veadam shennitma vemet o veadam shennaga bechelim shennagu vemet, havu av hattuma utemeim tumat shiva chaadam, keditnan perek kamma deohalot. aval kele cheres voochalim umashkim shennagu vemet en naasim av hattuma. vedavka yisrael naase av hattuma keshennaga bemet, aval lo nachri, vechen nefel shennolad ben shemona eno mekabbel tuma im naga bemet:

Umetzora bime safro. metzora shehuchlat beechad min hannegaim venitrappe, vehuchshar betzipporim veetz erez veezov usheni tolaat vetiglachat, veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim uvashshemini mevi karbenotav, veotam shivat yamim keruyin yeme safro, umetamme adam, deneemar kibbus begadim bime chilluto veneemar kibbus begadim bime safro, ma lehallan metamme adam af kan metamme adam:

Ume chattat sheen bahem kede hazzaya. metammeu vemagga. veim yesh bahen kede hazzaya, metammeu af bemassa, letamme adam letamme begadim. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav vehannogea beme hannidda yitma ad haarev, verabbotenu lamdu shehammazze tahor, velo va hakkatuv ella litten shiur lannose shetztzarich sheyyihye vo chede hazzaa. vechillek hakkatuv ben mayim lemayim, lomar lecha mayim sheyyesh bahen kede hazzaya metammeim adam letamme begadim, vesheen bahen kede hazzaya metammeim adam letamme ochalim umashkin velo letamme vegadim:

Uchele cheres baavir. keshennafla tuma vaavir keli cheres, ben naga vakkeli ben lo naga, nitma hakkeli. veim naga hattuma vakkeli mibbachutz, lo nitma bingia zo, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho vegomer‏ yitma, mittocho nitma veeno nitma meachorav:
Veenam metammein bemassa. dechol hanach avot hattumot dachashive hacha chetiv behu hannogea velo chetiv behu hannose:

Chutz miggitte nashim. sheim yesh alav ed kuti echad, kasher. aval shenehem kutim, posel tanna kamma afillu begitte nashim. verabban (shimon ben) gamliel asa maase vehichshir afillu kesheshshenehem kutim. vehaidna degazru al hakkutim sheyyihyu kegoyim lechol divrehem, lo shena shear shetarot velo shena gitte nashim, afillu ed echad kuti, pasul:

Bearkaot shel goyim. sheheidu haedim edutam lifne hashshofet bimkom moshav mishpetehem. vehu sheyyadanu beoto shofet uveotam edim delo mekabbele shochada. vedavka beshitre halevaot veshitre mikkach umimkar, shehaedim rau bintinat hammamon. aval shitre hodaot vegitte nashim, vechol davar shehu maase bet din bearkaot shellahem, hakkol pasul:
Rabbi shimon omer kesherim. lo huzkeru bevet hammidrash lehippasel:
Ella vizman shennaasu vehedyot. al yede goyim hedyotot sheenam dayyanim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shavin lammolich velammevi. lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

Chattat shennitarva vechova. kelomar ha ditninan leel beferek kamma chattat shennitarva vechova en kasher ella minyan chattaot shebbachova, peamim sheole oto minyan lemechetza kasher umechetza pasul, ufeamim sheole lefachot mimmechetza, umefaresh veazel ketzad:
Chova shenayim bechattat mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. perush, shene kinnin chova sheyyesh bahen kiflayim bachattat, kegon shehikriv mehen ola achat venishtayyeru shete chattaot veola echat:

Mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. sheola achat hannisheret eno yachol lehakeriv shemma zehu shennikba lechattat, vechattat hameorevet eno yachol lehakeriv shemma hi haola hannisheret, hilkach eno makriv ella shete hachattaot, vehachattat hammeorevet vehaola hannisheret pesulin, vehayenu mechetza kasher umechetza pasul:

Chattat shenayim bechova minyan shebbachova kasher. perush, kegon shekkarva chattat achat min hashshene kinnin venishtayyeru shete olot vechattat echat, hare hen arba peridot im chattat shennitarva venehen, vahare eno yachol lehakeriv shete haolot shemma yikkach chattat hameorevet, vegam shete chattaot lo yakriv shemma yikkach oto shennikba leola, hilkach eno makriv ella chattat achat, hare ole oto minyan happachot shebbachova lefachot mimmechetza kasher. uchehay gavna mefarshinan nammi vechen ola shennitarva vechova:

Chattat lazo veola lazo kulei. ha nammi kae addetane leel beferek kamma, ola shennitarva vechattat o ippecha, kullan yamutu. vehane mille benimlach, aval belo nimlach al taaravto veasa ken lematta veken lemala, mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. veaf al gav dei ate leimmeloche amrinan leh lo takriv, kidtanya yamutu chullan, hasheta delo nimlach amrinan shekkol echad naasa chehilchato vechasher:
Bappulmos shel aspasyanus. chayil shehevi aspasyanus al yerushalayim:

Gazru al atrot chatanim. hayu osim lachatanim atarot meeven melach shehu tzalul keen habbedolach vetzovin otah begafrit keen tziyyurin shekkorin 100. veit dimfarshe atarot shel hadas veshel vered. ushenehem asurim, veen muttar ella atarot shel kanim:
Veal haerus. asuy kemin nafa sheddafnoteha agullot veshotchim al piha or dak umakkin alav bemakkel dak umotzi kol tzalul. uvelaaz korin lo tanburo:
Atrot kallot. keen ir asuya mizzahav:

Veshello yelammed adam et beno yevanit. perush, chachma yevanit. vehem remazim vechidot shehayu layyevanim, velo hayu makkirim bahem ella hargilim bahem. uvaggemara mefaresh tama mishshum maase shehaya (kesheyyatzu) [keshetztzaru] malche chashmonay ze al ze, hayu otan shebbifnim meshalshelim leotan shebbachutz bechol yom dinarin bakkuppa vemaalin lahen temidin. haya sham zaken echad, velaaz lahem bechachma yevanit, kol zeman shehem asukin baavoda en nimsarin beyedchem. oto hayyom shilshelu lahem dinarim bakkuppa veheelu lahem chazir. beotah shaa amru arur adam sheyyegaddel chazir, vearur adam sheyyelammed livno chachma yevanit:
Bappulmos haacharon. hu churban habbayit. veshel titus nammi hava:
Baappiryon. kemo ohel shel meilin vetallitot muzhavot:
Verabbotenu hittiru shettetze kalla baappiryon. mishshum tzeniuta. vechen halacha:
Yishshafech. veen kan mishshum ibbud teruma, mippene sheasur lishtoto, shemma shata mimmennu nachash:
Ushear kol hammashkim muttarim. sheen nachash shote mehen. ella shehaddevash vehatztzir vehammureyas veshumim ketushim, kol ellu huzkeru vaggemara leesor, shehannachash shote mehen:
Kamma yishhu. kamma yaamdu megullin:
Harachash. hannachash, ulefi sheholech al gechono karuy rachash, sheeno nire kimhallech ella kerochesh umitnanea:
Mimmakom karov. pershu vo (chullin 10:) kede sheyyetze mittachat ozen hakkeli veyishte veyachazor lechoro:

Bamme devarim amurim bechohen nimlach. appirka kamma kae. vehachi kaamrinan, bamme devarim amurim dechattat shennitarva veola shekkullam yamutu, vechen achat lazo ushetayim lazo veshalosh lazo dehammuat kasher, hane mille bechohen shebba lehimmalech velishol ech mishpatan. aval bechohen sheeno nimlach veasa ledaat atzmo ken shalem lemala leishsha achat, ola keshera vechattat pesula. veim asa ken shalem lematta, chattat keshera veola pesula. hilkach, echad lazo veechad lazo shenayim lazo kulei‏ veasa chullan lemala, mechetza kasher dehaynu olot, umechetza pasul hayenu chattaot. veim asa chullan lematta, chattaot kesherot veolot pesulot. vechol pirka kamma mayre lechattechilla, vehay pirka mayre vediavad. uveechad lazo ushenayim lazo daamaran leel benimlach hammuat kasher, hacha belo nimlach hamerubbe kasher, kevan sheasa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta. ketzad, hare shemmeechad lazo asa oto ken shel ishsha lemala umishshene kinnin shel ishsha acheret asa ferida achat mehen lemala kede sheyyihyu chetzyan lemala, venisharu shalosh peridot lematta, hare kasher shete olot lemala ushete chattaot lematta, hare shene kinnin kesherim ushelishi pasul, vezehu hamerubbe kasher. vechen shenayim lazo ushelosha lazo, min hashshene kinnim yesh arba peridot lemala, veod lakach perida achat min hashshelosha kinnin, hare chamesh peridot lemala vechamesh peridot lematta, min hechamesh peridot shel mala yesh shalosh olot, veshellematta shalosh chattaot, hare shelosha kinnin kesherim, vezehu hamerubbe kasher, umihu asara lazo umea lazo, i efshar limtzo veinyan ze, lefi shehen zugot, vetzarich lomar dehamrubbe kasher ditnan bematnitin eno chozer ella leechad lazo ushenayim lazo kulei‏ sheenan zugot, veayde ditnan leel bichhay gavna hammuat kasher, tana nammi vichhay gavna hamerubbe kasher beeno nimlach. umihu af baasara lazo umea lazo hamerubbe kasher, sheen pasul mehen ella asara kinnim, deshemma kol hakkinnim shel ishsha achat lemala venifselu hachattaot, o kullan lematta venifselu haolot, veal karchacha asara kinnim shelemim pesulim:

Et shellemala mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kevan sheasa ken shalem lemala. vehoil shekkinnim haellu lishte nashim, yaviu ken echad beshuttafut veyatnu venehen, im mishshel rishon ola lelea, tehe vaacharon chattat lelea, o ippecha. vedavka asa ken shalem lemala, aval im chillek hakkinnim perida achat lemala uferida achat lematta, hakkol kasher, sheani omer ola lemala vechattat lematta, shehakkinnim mitparshim baasiyyat kohen:

Haochel teruma shogeg meshallem keren vechomesh. kedichtiv (Vayikra 22) ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishshito alav. vehachomesh hu reviit ma sheachal, kegon im achal teruma sheshshava dinar meshallem dinar urevia, shehem ben hakkol chamishsha reviiyyot dinar, nimtza hakkeren im chumsho chamishsha. vechol chomashim haamurim battora kach hem:
Echad hashshote. yayin:

Veechad hassach. shemen. dishtiyya bichlal achila dichtiv (Devarim 14) babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar, uchetiv batreh veachalta sham. vesicha kishtiyya dichtiv (tehillim kat) vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav:
Vechomesh chumshah. sheim achal teruma veshillem keren vechomesh, vechazar veachal tashlume hachomesh, mosif chomesh al oto chomesh:
Eno meshallem teruma. shehatteruma lakkohen, vetashlume ma sheachal hem chov alav, veeno yachol lifroa chovo mimmakom acher:

Ella chullin metukkanim. shehifrishu mehen terumot umaasrot, derachamana amar (Vayikra 22) venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, davar harauy lihyot kodesh. vechomesh nammi tzarich lihyot mechullin metukkanim, dichtiv (sham) veyasaf chamishshito alav, melammed shechummesho kemoto:
Vehen naasin teruma. otan chullin metukkanim:
Vehattashlumin teruma. sheim chazar veachal beshogeg otan chullin shennishtallemu, ma shechozer umeshallem tachtehen gam hem naasin teruma:
Eno mochel. dechevan digzerat hakkatuv hi dechayyav leshallem davar harauy lihyot kodesh veeno yachol liftor atzmo bedamim, en haddavar taluy babbealim:
Utechanan. kullan bevat achat:
Ufachatu. lo amrinan chullin pachatu velo hatteruma veen kan mea veechad veasur:

Veim yadua shehachittim shel chullin yafot mishshel teruma muttar. deshel chullin hotiru veshel teruma lo hotiru, veyesh kan echad umea. veaf al gav demeikkara neesru, chazru vehutteru battechina, vaafillu lechattechilla yachol litchon kede lehattiran:
Veim mezid asur. kenasuhu rabbanan lefi shebbittel issur lechattechilla, vehu haddin lechol issurim shebbattora shebbittelan bemezid, shehen asurim:
Hammevi. nechtam chetzyo. echad min haedim chatam befanay:

Befanay nichtav chetzyo vechulei‏ pasul. vedavka chetzyo haacharon. aval befanay nichtav chetzyo harishon shehu shem haish vehaishsha vehazzeman, kasher. vechetzyo harishon nammi lo tzarich sheyyire hakketiva atzmah, ella im shama kol hakkulmos bilvad over al hanneyar bishat ketiva, tu lo tzarich:

Echad omer befanay nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul. bizman shehagget yotze mittachat yad echad mehem, deatzrechuhu rabbanan leshaliach hammevi get lememar tarvayhu. aval im hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem, kasher, sheshshenayim sheheviu get en tzarich sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam:
Shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul. bizman shehagget yotze mittachat yad echad mehem. aval im yotze mittachat yad shenehem, kasher:
Verabbi yehuda machshir. vaafillu yotze mittachat yado shel echad mehem. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ballayla venechtam bayyom kasher. shehayyom holech achar hallayla veen ze mukdam:

Bayyom venechtam ballayla pasul. shehare mukdam hu. vetikkenu chachamim zeman begittin, gezera shemma yihye nasuy im bat achoto vetizne alav, vechas aleha shello techanek venoten lah get belo zeman, ucheshemmeidim aleha bevet din motzia gittah veomeret gerusha hayiti ufenuya beotah shaa:

Verabbi shimon machshir. desavar rabbi shimon dachachamim tikkenu zeman begittin mishshum pere, sheim lo yihye zeman bagget yihye habbaal mocher veholech perot nichse melog shel ishto leachar gerushin, ucheshettitbeo baddin yomar kodem gerushin macharti. ulehachi machshir rabbi shimon benichtav bayyom venechtam ballayla af al pi shehu mukdam, desavar mishshaa shennatan enav legaresh af al pi shello geresh shuv en lo labbaal perot. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol get. kol sofrim makrin. haggedolim makrin letalmidehem, kesheyyavo get lefanecha katvehu kach. vehizkiru shem eynash bealma:
Yater mikken. velo ze bilvad shennichtav shello leshem gerushin ella lehitlammed, ella af ze shennichtav leshem gerushin gemurim venimlach, pasul:

Yater mikken hayu lo shete nashim kulei. velo ze bilvad shennichtav shello leshem gerushin shel adam ze, pasul, ella af ze shehayu lo shete nashim shennichtav leshem gerushin dehay gavra, pasul, kevan shennichtav shello leshem gerushin shel zo:
Gedola uketanna. lav davka:
Yater mikken amar lallavlar vechulei. ha ka mashma lan delo amrinan huvrar haddavar lemafrea devishat ketiva nammi dateh aha veikka gerushin dideh vedidah:
Kibbel hakkatan. hagget miyyad habbaal:
Vehigdil. kodem shemmesaro lah:

Patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach. afillu lo chazar venitpatteach, hoil vehaya patuach bishat kabbalat hagget shappir matze lemehave shaliach, deha yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. ella ayde devae lemitne sefa vechazar venishtappa, shetztzarich sheyyihye ben daat bishat netina, tana nammi resha vechazar venitpatteach. vechol pesule edut baavera, pesulin lehavi et hagget, sheen neemanim lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. veim hagget mekuyyam bechotmav, kesherim lahavio:
Hakkotev tafse gittin. sofer sherotze sheyyihyu mezummanin etzlo, sheppeamim adam ba lesachro vehu tarud bishtarot acherim:
Tzarich sheyyaniach mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom hazzeman. uvaggemara mosif af mekom hare at mutteret lechol adam:

Mippene hattakkana. hittiru lichtov tafse gittin ushetarot shello lishman mippene takkanat hassofer sheyyihyu mezummanim lo, uvilvad sheyyeshayyer toref lechatvo lishmah. vegazrinan toref shear shetarot attu toref degittin:
Rabbi yehuda fosel bechullan. degazar tofes attu toref, ushear shetarot attu gittin:
Rabbi elazar machshir bechullan. delo gazar shear shetarot attu gittin:
Chutz miggitte nashim shenneemar vechatav lah lishmah. vegazrinan tofes attu toref. vahalacha kerabbi elazar:
Shiur hammayim. lihyot asurim mishshum gilluy:
Kede shettovad bahen mara. im hayu merubbim kol kach ad sheeres hannachash yippased veyovad bahen en bahen mishshum gilluy. veyodin hayu kamma eres hannachash mattil befaam achat:
Mara. haeres shehannachash mattil karuy mara:
Bechelim kol shehen. afillu merubbin kol shehen yesh bahen mishshum gilluy keshehammayim bakkelim:

Uvakkarkaot ad arbaim sea. yesh bahem mishshum gilluy, tefe mehachi en bahen mishshum gilluy, shehaeres mitbattel bahem. veen halacha kerabbi yose. umayan hammoshech afillu kol shehu en bo mishshum gilluy. umayim megullim keshem sheasur lishtotan kach asur lehashekotan livhemto, velirchotz bahen panav yadav veraglav, ulegabbel bahen et hattit, ulehishtammesh bahen beshum tashmish:
Eser kedushshot hen. ayde deayre leel bemaalot shel tumot zo lemala mizzo, tana nammi hacha maalot shel kedushshot zo lemala mizzo:
Shemmeviin mimmenna haomer. dichtiv (Vayikra 23) uketzartem et ketzirah vahavetem et omer, ketzirah velo ketzir chutza laaretz:
Vehabbikkurim. dichtiv (Devarim 26) velakachta mereshit kol peri haadama asher tavi meartzecha:
Ushete hallechem. dichtiv (Vayikra 23) mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem:

Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna sheen perue rosh uvaale mumin nichnasim lesham. baggemara vehakkometz rabba [menachot daf 27] mochiach dechol hane maalot detane hasheta chegon hannichnas leezrat kohanim shello letzorech vechen baale mumin uferue rosh shennichnesu ben haulam velammizbeach, kullehu maalot derabbanan hen. vechach kibbaltiha merabbotay. aval rambam sevira leh dechullehu middeorayta. baale mumin dichtiv (Vayikra 21) ki chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav. uferue rosh, deamar rachamana leaharon ulevanav shehayu vammishkan (sham 10) rashechem al tifrau. veaf al pi shelleshon hattosefta mesayyea ledivre harambam, kabbalat rabbotay niret li ikkar. vehay dela chashiv tanna kamma shetuye yayin veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim bahade vaale mumim uferue rosh kedachashiv lehu rabbi yose vassefa, mishshum devaale mumin uferue rosh pesulan begufan, hilkach shilluchan chamur, aval shetuye yayin veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim pesulan mechamat davar acher, hilkach lo hechmir beshilluchan kol kach:
Ella chohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. dichtiv (sham 16) veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh bezot yavo vechulei:

Bishat haavoda. arba peamim nichnas sham, achat lehaketir ketoret, sheniyya lehazzot middam happar, shelishit lehazzot middam hassair, reviit lehotzi hakkaf vehammachta. veim nichnas chamesh peamim chayyav mita:

Uforshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketara. ben beshaa shemmaktirim ketoret bemizbach hazzahav shebbahechol, ben beshaa shekkohen gadol maktir ketoret lifnay velifnim, kol haam porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach, veen tzarich lomar min hahechol. vetanna kamma faleg adderabbi yose vesavar divshaa shemmaktirin ketoret bahechol hu defarshe mibben haulam velammizbeach, aval keshemmaktir ketoret lifnay velifnim en haam porshim ella min hahechol bilvad velo mibben haulam velammizbeach. vahalacha ketanna kamma. veeser kedushshot ditnan bematnitin vehanach achad asar ninhu, pershu haggeonim deeretz yisrael enah mimminyan hakkedushshot, lefi shebbishar kedushshot yesh bahen kavod lammakom shemmonim mimmennu ketzat tumot o shemmonim miktzat bene adam likkanes elav, veen bistam eretz yisrael kedushsha zo. vahavaat bikkurim veomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim enam kikdushshot hallalu. veit dimfarshe detanna kamma dachashiv eser kedushshot rabbi yose hi, deit leh deven haulam ulemizbeach shave lahechol bachamishsha devarim, uledideh lo havu ella eser:
Bidyo. 285 baaravi:
Sikra. tzeva adom:
Komos. seraf hailan:
Kankantom. 273 belaaz:
Al heale shel zayit. telusha:

Venoten lah et happara. sheeno yachol lekatztzetzo achar ketiva, dichtiv (Devarim 24) vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah, mi sheeno mechussar ella ketiva unetina, yatza ze shemmechussar ketiva ketzitza unetina:

Rabbi yose haggelili omer kulei. derachamana karye leget sefer, ma sefer meyuchad sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel, af kol sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel. verabbanan amre, i katav bassefer kidkeamart, hasheta dichtiv sefer, lisfirat devarim hu daata. vahalacha kachachamim:
Deme teruma. sheen dameha yekarim kechullin:
Keren vechomesh min hachullin. vehen naasin teruma, kedin kol ochel teruma bishgaga:
Vekeren deme teruma. mishshum kefel laggannav:
Terumat hekdesh. shehikdish hakkohen teruma levedek habbayit:
Shene chomashim. chad mishshum ochel teruma, vechad mishshum nehene min hahekdesh. aval kefel behekdesh lekka, dichtiv (Shemot 22) yeshallem shenayim lereehu, velo lahekdesh:
Meshammeret shel yayin. af al gav shehakkeli hattachton mechusse bamshammeret, yesh bo mishshum gilluy, shehaeres over derech hameshammeret veholech lakkeli hattachton:
Rabbi nechemya mattir. lefi shehaeres tzaf veeno over. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Haishsha. bat yisrael hannesua lechohen:
Met rabbach. virasho ven bitto miyyisrael, o vitto hannesua leyisrael:
Shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza. ufasul milleechol bitruma:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh. bechullehu:
Verabbi yehoshua poter. baggemara moke la davka beochel terumat chametz beerev pesach, mippene shezzemanno bahul, shehashshaa dechuka veomed levaer hechametz shel teruma. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Verabbi yehoshua machshir. dichtiv (Devarim 33) barech Adonai‏ chelo ufoal yadav tirtze, afillu chalal shebbo poal yadav tirtze:
Noda shehu vaal mum avodato pesula. af lerabbi yehoshua, dichtiv (Bamidbar 28) et beriti shalom, keshehu shalem velo keshehu chaser. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Tavla sheyyesh lah lizbez umachta shelema. sheyyesh lah defanot, temeim, sheyyesh lahen bet kibbul. umeresha dehattehorim shebbichle cheres have shaminan dehanach temeim, ella orcheh detanna hachi, keditnan beferek veellu terefot [daf mag] veellu chesherot, vehachi ikka tuva vammishna:
Tavla. shel cheres:
Shehi melea kearot. shehi asuya kearot kearot, vehakkearot hen miggufah umechubbarin bah:
Veim yesh lah lizbez odef. im sefat hattavla saviv odef veole lemala yoter mippihen shel kearot:

Nitmea achat mehen nitmeu chullan. dichshennichnas hashsheretz befi hakkeara kevar nichnas baavir hallizbez haodef saviv, venitmet kol hattavla, dichli cheres mittamme meaviro, ucheshennitmet hattavla chullah nitmeu chol hakkearot shehen miggufah:
Bet hattevalin. keli cheres asuy ribbuim ribbuim, latet bechol ribbua veribbua min echad shel tevalin velo yitarvu ze vaze:
Kalmarim hametoamot. keli asuy latet betocho haddeyo vehakkulmos vehakkelim hatztzerichim lassofer. veasuy gam hu ribbuim ribbuim teomim, uveartzenu mehem harebe, vekorim lahem belaaz 380:
Bet tevalin shel etz. sheasuy gam hu ribbuim ribbuim veen lo lizbez odef:

Shennitma echad mehen bemashke. derabbanan gazru al hammashkim habbaim mechamat sheretz letamme kelim, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava, shehem metammeim kelim deorayta. vedavka cheshennitma vemashke lo nitma chavero, shekkeli shennitmeu achorav bemashkim lo nitma tocho, hilkach keshennitma echad mehen bemashkin have dofen shel hattame achorav shel chavero velo nitma chavero. aval betumat sheretz deorayta dechol hecha denaga bichli etz ben meachorav ben mittocho nitma chullo, im nitma echad mehen nitma chavero, shehattuma nogaat bo meachorav. uvichli cheres deeno mekabbel tuma miggabbo ella mittocho, afillu vetumat sheretz im nitma echad mehen lo nitma chavero, detocho shel ze naase gav lachavero, ucheli cheres en mittamme miggabbo. aval keli etz mittamme miggabbo vetumat sheretz, aval lo vetumat mashkin lihyot nitma chullo:

Cholkim et avyo. dofen av verachav shebben shene haribbuim, raminan palga lehay gisa ufalga lehay gisa vetumat mashkim derabbanan, vachatzi ovi haddofen shellatztzad hattahor tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Sanhedrin. shem haddayyanim. venikraim sanhedrin shessonim haderat panim baddin:
Batal hashshir. dichtiv (Eicha 5) zekenim mishshaar shavatu bachurim minneginatam, bazzeman shebbatlu hazzekenim hayyoshvim bashshaar shehem hassanhedrin, batlu habbachurim minneginatam gam ken:
Batlu moshle meshalim. kegon mimmeshalot shualim, deamrinan besanhedrin [lach:] ki have darish rabbi meir befirka hava darish tilta shematata vetilta aggadta vetilta matle:
Hashshakdanim. shokdim al daltot bet hammidrash layla vayom, kidamrinan bivamot [63:] deamar ben azzay ma eese venafshi chashka battora:
Haddarshanim. shehaya baki bemidrash taame mikraot, kidamar [berachot 12:] velo zachiti shetteamer yetziat mitzrayim ballelot ad shedderashah ben zoma:
Batal kevod tora. shehaya noten lev lidrosh al kol kotz vekotz [menachot koach:]. vezehu kevod tora gadol, sheen bah davar levattala:
Batlu anshe maase. sheosim maasim muflaim kidamrinan betaaniyyot [ko.] yomar lachometz veyidlak, velaizzim lehavi zeevim bekarnehem:
Katnutam shel chasidim. shehayu hachasidim holchim umitkatnin, vehu haya mikketanehen vesofan:

Mishshemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken batal kevod hattora. shead shemmet hu, haya beriut baolam, vehayu lomdim tora meummad [megilla ka.], umishshemmet bat teshut koach laolam vehitchilu lilmod meyushshav. vezehu batal kevod tora:
Mishshemmet rabbi batla anava. talmidav shel rabbi hosifu vechatvu ze bammishna:
Chamotah uvat chamotah kulei. enan neemanot lomar met balah, mishshum desanyan lah umechavvenin lekalkelah:

Uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. vedavka keshehitna habbaal immah beshaa shemmasar hagget leyadah veamar lah lo titgarshi ella bevet dino shel peloni vetomri befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. vehabbet din lokchin oto miyyadah achar sheamra befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, umemannin shaliach sheyyachazor veyitten oto lah. aval ishsha sheggittah yotze mittachat yadah bechol makom shehi, hare zo megoreshet, vaafillu sheen hagget mekuyyam bechotmav, veenah tzericha shettomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

En hammedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon. lefi ma sheyyesh teruma bisa zo shel dimmua bainan mea min hachullin, velo vainan mea sein keneged kol otah sea shel dimmua, sheenah necheshevet kullah teruma leesor chullin sheniyyim:

Veen hamechummatz machmitz ella lefi cheshbon. issa shel chullin shennitchammetza bisor shel teruma hare chullah asura lezarim, veim nafal meotah issa letoch issa acheret shel chullin vechimtzatah enah oseret ella lefi cheshbon seor shel teruma shemmeorav bah, velo mittesra acharona ella im ken nafal min harishona shiur gadol kol kach sheyyesh basseor shel teruma hameorav bah kede lechammetz haacharona belo tzeruf hachullin hamedummain:

Veen mayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon. mikve sheyyesh bo esrim veechad seim me geshamim, memalle bakkatef tesha esre seim ufotkan lammikve derech hameshacha vehen tehorin. veaf al gav dishlosha luggin mayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve, hashsheiva keshera keshehi derech hameshacha vehaya sham rov shiur hammikve shehem esrim veechad seim me geshamim. vehayenu lefi cheshbon, deen hashsheuvim poslin hammikve keshehen derech hameshacha ella im ken hem esrim [seim] mayim sheuvim, sheen sham rov shiur mikve mimme geshamim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ratza lachazor bishnehen. kodem sheyyaggia leyad haishsha vehaeved:
Yachazor. veen hashshaliach yachol lizkot bahem letzarchan, dechov hu lahen, shemabbedin mezonotehen:
Vachachamim omrim begitte nashim. yachol lachazor:
Aval lo veshichrure avadim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Sheim yirtze shello lazun et avdo rashshay. hilkach ki meshachrer leh lo mafsid leh mezone. aval shello lazun et ishto eno rashshay, hilkach ki megaresh lah mafsid lah mezone:

Mippene shehu kinyano. kelomar ha dehu achil batteruma keshehu eved kohen eno ella mippene shehu kinyano shel kohen, mide dahava abbehemto shel kohen sheochelet becharshine teruma, velav mishshum mealleyuta hi, hilkach ki meshachrer leh af al pi shemmafsido milleechol batteruma en zo chova laeved:
Lo yittenu leachar mita. degitta lo have ad demate leyadah vechi mate leyadah ha met veen get leachar mita. ushetar shichrur nammi ki meta leyadeh ha met ufaka reshuteh minneh:
Yittenu leachar mita. veaf al gav delo amar mane ze, dedivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu:
Lealtar. miyyad. kasher:

Veim lav pasul. vedavka sheavad bemakom shehashshayyarot metzuyot, deikka lememar meovrim veshavim nafal. aval im avad bemakom sheen hashshayyarot metzuyot, afillu leachar zeman merubbe kasher. vaafillu avad bemakom shehashshayyarot metzuyot, im yesh laedim bo siman muvhak, kegon sheyyomru nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit, o sheyyomru meolam lo chatamnu beget beellu hashshemot ella vaze bilvad, kasher, vaafillu leachar zeman merubbe:
Bachafisa o vidluskema. amtachot shergilin latet bahem shetarot, veyesh bahen siman shehem shello:
Im makkiro kasher. milleta beanpe nafshah hi. vehachi kaamar, metzao vachafisa o vidluskema af al pi sheeno makkiro lagget, o shemmakkiro lagget af al pi shemmetzao bechol makom, kasher:

Notno lah bechezkat shehu kayyam. velo chayshinan shemma met uvatel shelichuto, deamrinan haamed davar al chezkato. aval im noda shemmet kodem shehiggia get leyadah, hagget batel, deen get leachar mita:
Makrivin otah. velo chayshinan shemma metu bealeha, vechattat shemmetu bealeha lemita omedet:
Merekem lammizrach. merekem ad sof haolam lemizracho karuy chutz laaretz, verekem atzmah niddona kemizrach haolam velo cheeretz yisrael:
Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael. vaasura leechol bitruma:

Meshallemet et hakkeren. kedin gozel et chavero, aval lo chomesh, dechohenet hi, uchetiv (Vayikra 22) vechol zar lo yochal kodesh, yatza zot sheenah zara veefshar lah shettashuv levet aviha kinureha utehe mutteret leechol bitruma:
Umitatah bisrefa. im zanta tachat balah yisrael, kedichtiv (Vayikra 21) uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot vechulei, kol shehi bat kohen, lo shena eshet kohen velo shena eshet yisrael, baesh tissaref:
Nisset leechad mikkol happesulim. kegon chalal natin umamzer, meshallemet keren vechomesh, shehare nitchallela beviato veenah reuya od leechol bitruma vahare hi chezara:

Umitatah bechenek. dichtiv uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot, mi sheruya lachazor levet aviha ilmale zenut ze hi visrefa, yatzta nivelet lefasul lah sheenah reuya lachazor levet aviha, shezzo enah bisrefa:
Vachachamim omrim vechulei. delo haveya zara ad shettehe zara mittechillatah vead sofah, vezo hoil uchevar achla bitruma enah meshallemet et hachomesh:
Umitatah bisrefa. uvat ish kohen ketiv, mikkol makom. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam. kol chutza laeretz kare medinat hayyam:

Tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. it deamre tama lefi sheen bene medinat hayyam bene tora, veen yodin shetztzarich lichtov hagget leshem haishsha, hilkach omer hashshaliach befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, umimmela shaylinan leh im nichtav lishmah, vehu omer in. veit deamre tama lefi sheen shayyarot metzuyot mishsham lechan, sheim yavo habbaal viarer lomar lo chetavtiv sheyyihyu edim metzuyin lehakkir chatimat haedim. veheeminuhu rabbanan lashshaliach kevitre, veshuv lo yoil irur habbaal:
Min harekem umin hacheger. ben kadesh uven bared, metargeminan ben rekem uven chigra:
Afillu mikkefar ludim. shehi michutza laaretz:
Lelod. shehi semucha lah vehi meeretz yisrael:
Mehegmonya lehegmonya. shene hegmonim beir achat umakpidim ze al ze:

Shiur keli cheres littaher. detu lo mekabbel tuma, veim haya tame tahor keillu nishbar kullo, detu lo chazi lemilleteh velo chashuv toch dideh. afillu hayta chavit zo meyuchedet ligrogarot veleegozim, venikkeva bemotzi zayit, tehora, kol zeman shello chazar veyichadah achar kach lekabbel bah rimmonim vechayyotze bahen, aval chazar veyichadah lekabbel bah rimmonim, temea ad shettinnakev bemotzi rimmon, umishshennikkeva bemotzi rimmon shuv enah mekabbelet tuma:
Shiuro vemashkin. benekev shekkeshemmesimin hakkeli al gabbe mashkin nichnasin hammashkin derech oto nekev letoch hakkeli, vehu nekev gadol mimmotzi mashke:

Lechach ulechach. kegon kedera shemmevashshelim bah basar, af al pi sheen mannichin bah ochel belo mashke, ulemashke lo chazya shehare nikkeva bechones mashke, afillu hachi azlinan bah lechumra, veenah tehora ad shettinnakev bemotzi zetim:
Enah medammaat. deshemma hayenu otah shel chullin:
Pannas. kemin ashashit shel cheres asuya nekavim bedafnoteha shemmehen haora yotzet, umannichim hanner betochah shello yechabbenna haruach:
Sheen lo. bet kibbul shemen. af al pi sheyyesh lo vet kibbul ner:
Tahor. shebbet kibbul ner en lo toch, ella hanner munnach alav:
Megufat hayyotzrim. keen avnayim shel cheres shehayyotzrim osim hakkelim alehen:
Et shehu foteach bah. kelomar hammegufa shehayyotzer mashlich aleha hattit umefatteach aleha beyadav tzurat hakkeli:
Tehora. lefi sheen lah safa saviv veen kan toch:

Veshehu gomer bah. vehammegufa shemmaamid aleha hakkeli leachar shennigmera tzurato yesh lo toch, ulechach hi temea. verabbotay pershu sheyyesh keli layyotzrim shennikra megufa, veyesh mehen sheppitchehen tzar veyesh sheppitchehen rachav, et shehu poteach bah, kelomar sheatid leharechiv pitchah, tehora, sheadayin lo nigmera melachta vehaveya chegalme chele cheres. veshehu gomer bah, shemmannichah kach befetach tzar, temea. umatnitin rabbi meir hi deamar kele cheres meematay mekabbelim tuma mishshaa shennigmera melachtan. velo cherabbanan deamre mishsheyyitztzarfu vakkivshan. uferush rishon nire li ikkar:
Mashpech. keli shennotnin al pi chavit o al pi hannod kesherotzin lemalleoto yayin o shemen:

Veshel rochlin. shehu katan veasuy lehachenis shemen lefakkin ketannim, umachazik log o shene luggim, veharochel meniach etzbao mittachtav keneged hannekev umoded bo shemen, umesir etzbao vehashshemen yored lechelav shel lokeach. veasuy lekabbala hu umekabbel tuma:

Rabbi akiva omer mippene shehu mattehu al tziddo. kelomar afillu eno shel midda, mashpech shel rochlim leolam [mittamme], mippene shemmattehu al tziddo lekabbel bo meat kede sheyyariach bo hallokeach, venimtza asuy lekabbala. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Hu meshallem et hakkeren. deme teruma, kedin gozel, shehare hu naasa gazlan aleha:

Vehen meshallemin et hachomesh. avon achilatan beshogeg, sheen meshallem chomesh ella ochel veshote vesach atzmo, aval hammazzik et hatteruma eno meshallem chomesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) veish ki yochal kodesh, perat lemazzik:

Hen meshallemin keren vechomesh. chullin metukkanim, veyeasu teruma, vehu meshallem lahem deme chullin shehaya tzarich lehaachilan. veikka benayhu dilrabbi meir en hammaachil meshallem ella deme teruma, ulerabbanan meshallem deme chullin:
Hare alay ken lichsheeled zachar. beyoledet aniyya askinan. deillu ashira mevia cheves lechovatah:

Vehakkohen tzarich laasot shalosh lemala. shekkan nedava shetehen olot veken shel chova ola lemala vechattat lematta, vehu lo asa chen, ella shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta, velo nimlach bah ladaat al ma heviatan, venifsela perida achat, hilkach tzericha shettavi perida acheret vetakrivennah lemala:

Mimmin echad. kelomar, bamme devarim amurim, keshehayu mimmin echad. aval hayu hashshene kinnin shehevia mishshene minim, dehaynu ken echad torim veken echad bene yona, tzericha lehavi perida achat tor uferida achat mibbene yona, kede lehashelim happerida shennifsela, delo yadinan im min hattorim im min bene yona hayta, utenan leel en meviim torim keneged bene yona kulei:
Persha nidrah. keshehevia shene kinnin lakkohen persha veamra ellu lenidri veellu lechovati:

Mimmin echad. kelomar im shene kinnin hallalu hayu mimmin echad dehaynu shenehen torim o shenehen bene yona, vehikriv mehen hakkohen shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta, en kasher ella perida achat mikkol haarba shehikriv, vehi haola shebbachova, midi dahave cheola shennitarva vechova daamaran leel en kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova, utzericha lehavi od shalosh peridot, umakriv mehen achat lematta vehi hachattat shebbachova, ushetayim lemala vehu hanneder:

Mishshene minim tavi arba. im hevia shene kinnin mishshene minim ufersha nidrah velo yada hakkohen eze shetayim mehen asa lemala veeze asa lematta, tzericha lehavi arba peridot, deshemma hashshete torim shehevia lenidrah vehen olot naasu lematta venishar aleha hanneder kullo, ushene vene yona shehen chova naasu lemala venishar aleha ben yona echad lechattat mechovatah, o shemma shene vene yona shel chova naasu lematta venishar aleha ben yona shel ola mechovatah:

Kava nidrah. kegon sheamra vishat nidrah hare alay ken mimmin peloni. ufersha nidrah dilel, lo fersha chelum bishat hanneder, ella leachar shennadra setam hare alay ken hevia meeze min sheratzta veamra ellu lenidri:

Tzericha lehavi od chamesh peridot. hacha mayre kegon shelleachar shekkava nidrah vehevia nidrah im chovatah el hakkohen asa hakkohen shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta velo yada im nidrah asa lemala vechovatah lematta im lehefech, vehi gam hi shachcha eze min kava lenidrah im torim im bene yona, tzericha lehavi od chamesh peridot, deshemma hanneder naasa lematta vehachova lemala veen kasher ella ola shebbachova bilvad venishar aleha chattat shel chova ushete olot shel hanneder, umippene sheshshachcha beeze min kava nidrah tzericha lehavi shete torim ushene vene yona velaasot arbatan lemala kede latzet yede nidrah, utzericha lehavi nammi ben yona o tor lechattat lehashelim chovatah, hare chamesh peridot. vehane mille keshehevia mittechilla nidrah vechovatah hakkol mimmin echad, aval im yada shemmittechilla hevia nidrah vechovatah mishshene minim veshachcha meeze min kava nidrah, tzericha lehavi shesh peridot, arba lehashelim nidrah dehaynu shete torim ushene vene yona kedaamaran leel, kevan sheenah yodaat beeze min kava lenidrah utzericha latzet yede shenehem, ushete torim o shene vene yona laasot echad chattat veechad ola lehashelim chovatah. vehacha lo amrinan deday lah beven yona o tor lechattat bilvad vetaale lah haola shehikriva techilla leshem chova kedaamaran leel, devishlama keshehevia mimmin echad enah tzericha lehavi leolat chovatah, mimma nafshach, im otan torin shekkava lenidrah naasa lematta shetehen, im ken chovatah lemala kullah veyatza yede chovatah meola, veim chovatah naaset ola lematta vechattat lemala, im ken nidrah nammi naaset achat lemala veachat lematta veyatza yede nidrah mittoch echad, ushete torim shehevia achshav baachat yatza yede nidrah uvaachat yede olat chovatah. veim chovatah naaset kullah lematta vehachattat keshera vehaola pesula, hashshete torim shehevia achshav beachat hishlima chovatah vehaachat hi nedava, vechattat shemmevia achshav tavi al hassafek velo teachel. veim hayu harishonim yonim tavi achshav chattatah ben yona, veola enah tzericha mimma nafshach kemo sheamarnu vattorim. aval keshehevia shene minim veshachcha eze min kava lenidrah veeze min kava lechovatah vegam shachcha ma persha, veasa hakkohen kol min umin echad lemala veechad lematta shehaya savur sheshshenehen chovot setumot, tavi arba lenidrah, shete torin ushene yonim, lefi sheenah yodaat eze min kava lenidrah, vegam shene minin [tzericha lechattat lezavvegah leolat chovatah], lefi sheenah yodaat meeze min hayta, vaanan tor keneged tor veyona keneged yona bainan:

Netanatam lakkohen veen yadua kulei. kegon shekkava nidrah vekava chovatah vehevia lakkohen ken lenidrah veken lechovatah veenah yodaat meeze min kava nidrah umeeze min kava chovatah, o im natna lakkohen shene minin o min echad vehakkohen eno yodea im asa hakkol lemala o hakkol lematta o mechetza lemala umechetza lematta, hare zo mevia arba peridot lenidrah, shete torin ushene bene yona, umevia gam ken shetayim lechovatah achat chattat veachat ola meeze mishshene minim shettirtze, umevia chattat:

Amar rabbi yehoshua zehu sheamru kulei. keshem shehakkeves chay en yotze mimmennu ella kol echad, ucheshehu met shehaya rauy sheyyifsok kolo yotzim mimmennu shiva kolot kedimfaresh veazel, hacha nammi keshennadra techilla kodem shehevia chelum lo hayta tzericha ella ken lenidrah veken lechovatah, uleachar shekkava nidrah vehevia nidrah vechovatah, lefi sheenah yodaat ma kava veen yodea hakkohen ma hikriv, tzericha lehavi arba peridot lenidrah vearba lechovatah kedaamaran:
Karnav lachatzotzrot. leshofarot. dekarinan leshippura chatzotzarta:

Af tzamro. laasot mimmennu techelet. osim mitztzamro meil shekkullo techelet veal shulav paamonim shemmashmiim kol. vetanna kamma techelet lo ka chashiv, lefi sheen hattechelet mashmia kol ella happaamonim sheal shulav saviv:
Rabbi shimon ben akashya omer. af kol ze dome lehach milleta, dichshem shekkeshehu met kolo shiva, kach zikne tora kol zeman shemmazkinim uvaim lide tashshut koach, hen mosifin chachma:
Shenneemar mesir safa leneemanim. uveamme haaretz mishtae kera, dilel minneh ketiv mesir lev rashe am haaretz:
Bishishim chachma. hayenu talmide chachamim. deillu amme haaretz, chachmat ma lahem:
Hammevi get beeretz yisrael. sheen tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:
Meshallecho veyad acher. veose shaliach meelav velo bevet din. vedavka chala:
Veim amar lo. baal lashshaliach:
Tol li hemenna chefetz peloni. keshettitten lah et hagget. lo yeshallechenu beyad acher:

Hodayat maaser. vidduy maaser, biarti hakkodesh min habbayit vegam netattiv lalevi. lefi sheezra kanas et haleviyyim shello yittenu lahem maaser kesheala min haggola uvene levi lo alu immo, vetzivva sheyyittenu hammaaser lakkohanim. veyochanan kohen gadol bittel havvidduy, shello haya yachol lomar vegam netattiv lallevi:
Bittel et hameorrim. shehayu haleviyyim bechol yom omrim al hadduchan ura lamma tishan Adonai, amar vechi yesh shena lifne hammakom, veamad uvittelan:

Et hannokfin. shehayu mesartin laegel shel karban ben karnav kede sheyyippol lo dam beenav kede shello yire vihe noach lechafto uleshachto. veamad hu uvittelo, shennire kevaal mum. vehitkin lahem tabbaot bakkarka lehachenis tzavvar habbehema letochah:
Nokfin. makkin. vedugmato [chullin 7:] en adam nokef etzbao millematta:

Haya fattish makke virushalayim. bechol hammoed. charashe nechoshet uvarzel hayu makkin bappattish laasot melechet haaved shehi mutteret bammoed. veamad hu uvittelan, mishshum deavvesha milleta tuva veikka zilzul moed:

Uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay. shehu amar livne doro keshem shetteruma gedola avon mita, kach terumat maaser vetevel avon mita. vetikken sheyyotziu min haddemay terumat maaser umaaser sheni bilvad, velo yotziu mimmennu maaser rishon velo maasar ani, sheyyecholin lomar lallevi o laani have reaya shehu tevel vetol. umittakkana zo vaelach hallokeach perot min hashshuk lo haya shoel im hen metukkanin im lav, ella miyyad mafrish mehem terumat maaser umaaser sheni veochel et hashshear, shekkol hallokeach meam haaretz perot hem bechezkat shehem demay:
Mishshemmetu neviim harishonim. kol hanneviim nikraim neviim rishonim, chutz mechaggay zecharya umalachi vechavrehen deacharonim ninhu, shehayu bevinyan bayit sheni:

Batal hashshamir. kemin tolaat, beriyyato kisora, shehayu marim oto al haavanim harshumot baddeyo vehen nivkaot meelehen, uvo pittechu avne haefod vehachoshen, dichtiv behu bemilluotam, sheyyihyu shelemot shello yechasseru bahem, ella kotev alehen bidyo umare lahem shamir al pene haddeyo bachutz:
Venofet tzufim. devash habba mimmakom sheshshemo tzifia, umeshubbach meod:
Ufasku anshe amana. anashim shemmaaminim behakkadosh baruch hu:
Ad shennafla acheret. sea acheret shel teruma:
Hare zo asura. dichmo shennaflu bevat achat dami:

Verabbi shimon mattir. keshello noda lo nefila rishona ad shennafla sheniyya mode rabbi shimon dichman denaflu bevat achat dami. ki paleg hecha denoda lo bentayim velo hispik leharim ad shennafla acheret, rabbi shimon savar kevan deomed leharim kemuram dami, veazda letaameh deit leh bealma (fesachim 13: bava kamma 76:) kol haomed lizzarek kezaruk dami, vachachamim omrim hasheta mihat lo hurema. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ze hakkelal kol makom sheatta yachol lachalok kulei. kelomar, shekkan ishsha achat eno nechlak lishnayim ella kan ishsha achat lemala vekan ishsha acheret lematta, mechetza kasher umechetza pasul:
Vechol makom kulei. kegon echad lazo ushenayim lazo, sheyyesh mechelek shel ishsha achat lemala ulematta, hamerubbe kasher kidfarishit:
Lifnim min hachoma. mechomat yerushalayim:
Sheochlim sham kadashim kallim umaaser sheni. dichtiv (Devarim 12) uvata shamma vahavetem shamma vegomer, uchetiv (sham) lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vegomer:

Har habbayit. chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma haya, uvo haya vet hammikdash banuy, umishsham matchil machane leviyya veshiuro ad shaar nikanor, mishshaar nikanor velifnim machane shechina, umehar habbayit velachutz ad chomat yerushalayim machane yisrael:

Sheen zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot nichnasim lesham. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh, shomea ani sheshshelashtan yotzim lemakom echad, talmud lomar bammetzora badad yeshev, alma eno meshullach lemakom shezzav uteme met meshullachim. uma metzora shettumato chamura chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero dichtiv (Vayikra 13) michutz lammachane moshavo, lefichach meshullach chutz lirushalayim, af zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot shettumatan chamura mittumat met, sheosot mishkav umoshav umetammeot beeven mesama, ma sheen ken betumat met, chamur shilluchan mishshilluach chaveran. nimtzeta omer, metzora meshullach chutz lirushalayim shehi keneged machane yisrael, vezavim vezavot niddot veyoldot meshullachot mehar habbayit, shehu machane leviyya, umuttarot birushalayim. teme met vaafillu met atzmo muttar behar habbayit, umeshullach mishshaar nikanor velifnim, shehu machane shechina:
Hachel. lifnim mechomat har habbayit haya chotel gavoah asara tefachim, vehu nikra soreg, velifnim mimmennu hachel eser ammot:

Sheen nachrim utemee metim nichnasim lesham. af al gav derabbanan gazzur al hannachrim sheyyihyu kezavim lechol divrehem, leinyan shilluach machanot lo gazzur alayhu ella kitmee metim. vehay ditmee metim en nichnasim min hachel velifnim, hayenu midderabbanan. demiddeorayta afillu veezrat nashim share, shekkol ze machane leviyya ad ezrat yisrael sheshsham shaar nikanor:
Ezrat nashim. lifnim min hachel hayta, orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh:

Sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham. yehoshafat uvet dino gazru al tevul yom shello yikkanes leezrat nashim, dichtiv (divrei hayamim 2 20) vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda vegomer‏ lifne hechatzer hachadasha, veamru vaggemara may hechatzer hachadasha, shechiddeshu vah devarim veamru tevul yom al yikkanes bemachane leviyya. velo vechol machane leviyya gazru, ella veezrat nashim bilvad. vegazru al tevul yom velo gazru al mechussar kippurim, lefi shettevul yom asur batteruma umechussar kippurim muttar batteruma, vechol shettumato chamura mechavero chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero:

Ezrat yisrael. lifnim meezrat nashim hayta, orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. vechen ezrat kohanim hayta orech mea sheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre, verashe fispesin hayu mavdilim ben ezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim:

Sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham. hu haddin dahave matze lemitne sheen tahor nichnas lesham ad sheyyitbol, dehachi tenan beferek amar lahen hamemunne, en adam tahor nichnas laazara ad sheyyitbol:
Vechayyavin aleha chattat. hattemeim shennichnesu sham bishgaga:
Lismicha. lismoch yado al rosh karbano. vei efshar ella vabbealim, dichtiv vesamach et yado, velo yad shelucho:
Lishchita. shehashshechita cheshera vezar. veaf al pi sheefshar bechohanim, veefshar nammi lezar lishchot beezrat yisrael, afillu hachi lo asru leyisrael likkanes beezrat kohanim lishchot hakkarban:
Velitnufa. dechohen meniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif:

Vaafillu cheresh shote vekatan. vehu sheggadol omed al gabbav veomer lo ketov leshem peloni. aval nachri veeved, afillu gadol omed al gabbav, lechattechilla lo yichtov get, mippene shehem bene daat veaddata denafshayhu avde, sheafillu gadol omer lo ketov leshem peloni hu lo yichtov ella ledaat atzmo. veim nachri veeved katvu tofes hagget, veyisrael ben daat katav hattoref shehu shem haish vehaishsha vehazzeman, shekkol ellu tzerichin lishman, hagget kasher. vechen cheresh shote vekatan deamrinan bematnitin shekkesherim lichtov et hagget, hane mille tofes, aval toref eno kasher ella sheyyichtevennu yisrael gadol uven daat:
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. delav bene dea ninhu:

Vesuma. pasul lehavi get mechutza laaretz, sheeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. aval lehavi get beeretz yisrael sheen tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, o afillu bechutz laaretz im hagget mekuyyam bechotmav, o lihyot shaliach shel ishsha lekabbel gittah, lechol ellu hassuma kasher:
Venachri. deleteh betorat gittin vekiddushin, uvemide dilnafsheh lo chaze lo matze lemeavad shelichuta leachrine:
